kai equsen iakwb qusian en tw orei kai ekalesen touV adelfouV autou kai efagon kai epion kai ekoimhqhsan en tw orei
anastaV de laban to prwi katefilhsen touV uiouV autou kai taV qugateraV autou kai euloghsen autouV kai apostrafeiV laban aphlqen eiV ton topon autou
kai iakwb aphlqen eiV thn eautou odon kai anableyaV eiden parembolhn qeou parembeblhkuian kai sunhnthsan autw oi aggeloi tou qeou
eipen de iakwb hnika eiden autouV parembolh qeou auth kai ekalesen to onoma tou topou ekeinou parembolai
apesteilen de iakwb aggelouV emprosqen autou proV hsau ton adelfon autou eiV ghn shir eiV cwran edwm
kai eneteilato autoiV legwn outwV ereite tw kuriw mou hsau outwV legei o paiV sou iakwb meta laban parwkhsa kai ecronisa ewV tou nun
kai egenonto moi boeV kai onoi kai probata kai paideV kai paidiskai kai apesteila anaggeilai tw kuriw mou hsau ina eurh o paiV sou carin enantion sou
kai anestreyan oi aggeloi proV iakwb legonteV hlqomen proV ton adelfon sou hsau kai idou autoV ercetai eiV sunanthsin soi kai tetrakosioi andreV met' autou
efobhqh de iakwb sfodra kai hporeito kai dieilen ton laon ton met' autou kai touV boaV kai ta probata eiV duo parembolaV
kai eipen iakwb ean elqh hsau eiV parembolhn mian kai ekkoyh authn estai h parembolh h deutera eiV to swzesqai
eipen de iakwb o qeoV tou patroV mou abraam kai o qeoV tou patroV mou isaak kurie o eipaV moi apotrece eiV thn ghn thV genesewV sou kai eu se poihsw
ikanoutai moi apo pashV dikaiosunhV kai apo pashV alhqeiaV hV epoihsaV tw paidi sou en gar th rabdw mou diebhn ton iordanhn touton nun de gegona eiV duo parembolaV
exelou me ek ceiroV tou adelfou mou hsau oti foboumai egw auton mhpote elqwn pataxh me kai mhtera epi teknoiV
su de eipaV kalwV eu se poihsw kai qhsw to sperma sou wV thn ammon thV qalasshV h ouk ariqmhqhsetai apo tou plhqouV
kai ekoimhqh ekei thn nukta ekeinhn kai elaben wn eferen dwra kai exapesteilen hsau tw adelfw autou
aigaV diakosiaV tragouV eikosi probata diakosia kriouV eikosi
kamhlouV qhlazousaV kai ta paidia autwn triakonta boaV tessarakonta taurouV deka onouV eikosi kai pwlouV deka
kai edwken dia ceiroV toiV paisin autou poimnion kata monaV eipen de toiV paisin autou proporeuesqe emprosqen mou kai diasthma poieite ana meson poimnhV kai poimnhV
kai eneteilato tw prwtw legwn ean soi sunanthsh hsau o adelfoV mou kai erwta se legwn tinoV ei kai pou poreuh kai tinoV tauta ta proporeuomena sou
ereiV tou paidoV sou iakwb dwra apestalken tw kuriw mou hsau kai idou autoV opisw hmwn
kai eneteilato tw prwtw kai tw deuterw kai tw tritw kai pasi toiV proporeuomenoiV opisw twn poimniwn toutwn legwn kata to rhma touto lalhsate hsau en tw eurein umaV auton

kai ereite idou o paiV sou iakwb paraginetai opisw hmwn eipen gar exilasomai to proswpon autou en toiV dwroiV toiV proporeuomenoiV autou kai meta touto oyomai to proswpon autou iswV gar prosdexetai to proswpon mou
kai pareporeuonto ta dwra kata proswpon autou autoV de ekoimhqh thn nukta ekeinhn en th parembolh
anastaV de thn nukta ekeinhn elaben taV duo gunaikaV kai taV duo paidiskaV kai ta endeka paidia autou kai diebh thn diabasin tou iabok
kai elaben autouV kai diebh ton ceimarroun kai diebibasen panta ta autou
upeleifqh de iakwb monoV kai epalaien anqrwpoV met' autou ewV prwi
eiden de oti ou dunatai proV auton kai hyato tou platouV tou mhrou autou kai enarkhsen to platoV tou mhrou iakwb en tw palaiein auton met' autou
kai eipen autw aposteilon me anebh gar o orqroV o de eipen ou mh se aposteilw ean mh me euloghshV
eipen de autw ti to onoma sou estin o de eipen iakwb
eipen de autw ou klhqhsetai eti to onoma sou iakwb alla israhl estai to onoma sou oti eniscusaV meta qeou kai meta anqrwpwn dunatoV
hrwthsen de iakwb kai eipen anaggeilon moi to onoma sou kai eipen ina ti touto erwtaV to onoma mou kai huloghsen auton ekei
kai ekalesen iakwb to onoma tou topou ekeinou eidoV qeou eidon gar qeon proswpon proV proswpon kai eswqh mou h yuch
aneteilen de autw o hlioV hnika parhlqen to eidoV tou qeou autoV de epeskazen tw mhrw autou
eneken toutou ou mh fagwsin oi uioi israhl to neuron o enarkhsen o estin epi tou platouV tou mhrou ewV thV hmeraV tauthV oti hyato tou platouV tou mhrou iakwb tou neurou kai enarkhsen
anableyaV de iakwb eiden kai idou hsau o adelfoV autou ercomenoV kai tetrakosioi andreV met' autou kai epidieilen iakwb ta paidia epi leian kai rachl kai taV duo paidiskaV
kai epoihsen taV duo paidiskaV kai touV uiouV autwn en prwtoiV kai leian kai ta paidia authV opisw kai rachl kai iwshf escatouV
autoV de prohlqen emprosqen autwn kai prosekunhsen epi thn ghn eptakiV ewV tou eggisai tou adelfou autou
kai prosedramen hsau eiV sunanthsin autw kai perilabwn auton efilhsen kai prosepesen epi ton trachlon autou kai eklausan amfoteroi
kai anableyaV eiden taV gunaikaV kai ta paidia kai eipen ti tauta soi estin o de eipen ta paidia oiV hlehsen o qeoV ton paida sou
kai proshggisan ai paidiskai kai ta tekna autwn kai prosekunhsan
kai proshggisen leia kai ta tekna authV kai prosekunhsan kai meta tauta proshggisen rachl kai iwshf kai prosekunhsan
kai eipen ti tauta soi estin pasai ai parembolai autai aiV aphnthka o de eipen ina eurh o paiV sou carin enantion sou kurie
eipen de hsau estin moi polla adelfe estw soi ta sa
eipen de iakwb ei eurhka carin enantion sou dexai ta dwra dia twn emwn ceirwn eneken toutou eidon to proswpon sou wV an tiV idoi proswpon qeou kai eudokhseiV me
labe taV eulogiaV mou aV hnegka soi oti hlehsen me o qeoV kai estin moi panta kai ebiasato auton kai elaben
kai eipen aparanteV poreusomeqa ep' euqeian
eipen de autw o kurioV mou ginwskei oti ta paidia apalwtera kai ta probata kai ai boeV loceuontai ep' eme ean oun katadiwxw autouV hmeran mian apoqanountai panta ta kthnh
proelqetw o kurioV mou emprosqen tou paidoV egw de eniscusw en th odw kata scolhn thV poreusewV thV enantion mou kai kata poda twn paidariwn ewV tou me elqein proV ton kurion mou eiV shir
eipen de hsau kataleiyw meta sou apo tou laou tou met' emou o de eipen ina ti touto ikanon oti euron carin enantion sou kurie
apestreyen de hsau en th hmera ekeinh eiV thn odon autou eiV shir
kai iakwb apairei eiV skhnaV kai epoihsen eautw ekei oikiaV kai toiV kthnesin autou epoihsen skhnaV dia touto ekalesen to onoma tou topou ekeinou skhnai
kai hlqen iakwb eiV salhm polin sikimwn h estin en gh canaan ote hlqen ek thV mesopotamiaV suriaV kai parenebalen kata proswpon thV polewV
kai ekthsato thn merida tou agrou ou esthsen ekei thn skhnhn autou para emmwr patroV sucem ekaton amnwn
kai esthsen ekei qusiasthrion kai epekalesato ton qeon israhl
exhlqen de dina h qugathr leiaV hn eteken tw iakwb katamaqein taV qugateraV twn egcwriwn
kai eiden authn sucem o uioV emmwr o corraioV o arcwn thV ghV kai labwn authn ekoimhqh met' authV kai etapeinwsen authn
kai prosescen th yuch dinaV thV qugatroV iakwb kai hgaphsen thn parqenon kai elalhsen kata thn dianoian thV parqenou auth
eipen de sucem proV emmwr ton patera autou legwn labe moi thn paidiskhn tauthn eiV gunaika
iakwb de hkousen oti emianen o uioV emmwr dinan thn qugatera autou oi de uioi autou hsan meta twn kthnwn autou en tw pediw paresiwphsen de iakwb ewV tou elqein autouV
exhlqen de emmwr o pathr sucem proV iakwb lalhsai autw
oi de uioi iakwb hlqon ek tou pediou wV de hkousan katenucqhsan oi andreV kai luphron hn autoiV sfodra oti aschmon epoihsen en israhl koimhqeiV meta thV qugatroV iakwb kai ouc outwV estai
kai elalhsen emmwr autoiV legwn sucem o uioV mou proeilato th yuch thn qugatera umwn dote oun authn autw gunaika
epigambreusasqe hmin taV qugateraV umwn dote hmin kai taV qugateraV hmwn labete toiV uioiV umwn
kai en hmin katoikeite kai h gh idou plateia enantion umwn katoikeite kai emporeuesqe ep' authV kai egkthsasqe en auth
eipen de sucem proV ton patera authV kai proV touV adelfouV authV euroimi carin enantion umwn kai o ean eiphte dwsomen
plhqunate thn fernhn sfodra kai dwsw kaqoti an eiphte moi kai dwsete moi thn paida tauthn eiV gunaika
apekriqhsan de oi uioi iakwb tw sucem kai emmwr tw patri autou meta dolou kai elalhsan autoiV oti emianan dinan thn adelfhn autwn
kai eipan autoiV sumewn kai leui oi adelfoi dinaV uioi de leiaV ou dunhsomeqa poihsai to rhma touto dounai thn adelfhn hmwn anqrwpw oV ecei akrobustian estin gar oneidoV hmin
en toutw omoiwqhsomeqa umin kai katoikhsomen en umin ean genhsqe wV hmeiV kai umeiV en tw peritmhqhnai umwn pan arsenikon
kai dwsomen taV qugateraV hmwn umin kai apo twn qugaterwn umwn lhmyomeqa hmin gunaikaV kai oikhsomen par' umin kai esomeqa wV genoV en
ean de mh eisakoushte hmwn tou peritemnesqai labonteV taV qugateraV hmwn apeleusomeqa
kai hresan oi logoi enantion emmwr kai enantion sucem tou uiou emmwr
kai ouk ecronisen o neaniskoV tou poihsai to rhma touto enekeito gar th qugatri iakwb autoV de hn endoxotatoV pantwn twn en tw oikw tou patroV autou
hlqen de emmwr kai sucem o uioV autou proV thn pulhn thV polewV autwn kai elalhsan proV touV andraV thV polewV autwn legonteV

oi anqrwpoi outoi eirhnikoi eisin meq' hmwn oikeitwsan epi thV ghV kai emporeuesqwsan authn h de gh idou plateia enantion autwn taV qugateraV autwn lhmyomeqa hmin gunaikaV kai taV qugateraV hmwn dwsomen autoiV
monon en toutw omoiwqhsontai hmin oi anqrwpoi tou katoikein meq' hmwn wste einai laon ena en tw peritemnesqai hmwn pan arsenikon kaqa kai autoi peritetmhntai
kai ta kthnh autwn kai ta uparconta autwn kai ta tetrapoda ouc hmwn estai monon en toutw omoiwqwmen autoiV kai oikhsousin meq' hmwn
kai eishkousan emmwr kai sucem tou uiou autou panteV oi ekporeuomenoi thn pulhn thV polewV autwn kai perietemonto thn sarka thV akrobustiaV autwn paV arshn

egeneto de en th hmera th trith ote hsan en tw ponw elabon oi duo uioi iakwb sumewn kai leui oi adelfoi dinaV ekastoV thn macairan autou kai eishlqon eiV thn polin asfalwV kai apekteinan pan arsenikon
ton te emmwr kai sucem ton uion autou apekteinan en stomati macairaV kai elabon thn dinan ek tou oikou tou sucem kai exhlqon
oi de uioi iakwb eishlqon epi touV traumatiaV kai dihrpasan thn polin en h emianan dinan thn adelfhn autwn
kai ta probata autwn kai touV boaV autwn kai touV onouV autwn osa te hn en th polei kai osa hn en tw pediw elabon
kai panta ta swmata autwn kai pasan thn aposkeuhn autwn kai taV gunaikaV autwn hcmalwteusan kai dihrpasan osa te hn en th polei kai osa hn en taiV oikiaiV

eipen de iakwb sumewn kai leui mishton me pepoihkate wste ponhron me einai pasin toiV katoikousin thn ghn en te toiV cananaioiV kai toiV ferezaioiV egw de oligostoV eimi en ariqmw kai sunacqenteV ep' eme sugkoyousin me kai ektribhsomai egw kai o oikoV mou
oi de eipan all' wsei pornh crhswntai th adelfh hmwn
eipen de o qeoV proV iakwb anastaV anabhqi eiV ton topon baiqhl kai oikei ekei kai poihson ekei qusiasthrion tw qew tw ofqenti soi en tw apodidraskein se apo proswpou hsau tou adelfou sou
eipen de iakwb tw oikw autou kai pasin toiV met' autou arate touV qeouV touV allotriouV touV meq' umwn ek mesou umwn kai kaqarisasqe kai allaxate taV stolaV umwn
kai anastanteV anabwmen eiV baiqhl kai poihswmen ekei qusiasthrion tw qew tw epakousanti moi en hmera qliyewV oV hn met' emou kai dieswsen me en th odw h eporeuqhn

kai exhren israhl ek sikimwn kai egeneto foboV qeou epi taV poleiV taV kuklw autwn kai ou katediwxan opisw twn uiwn israhl

kai wkodomhsen ekei qusiasthrion kai ekalesen to onoma tou topou baiqhl ekei gar epefanh autw o qeoV en tw apodidraskein auton apo proswpou hsau tou adelfou autou
apeqanen de debbwra h trofoV rebekkaV katwteron baiqhl upo thn balanon kai ekalesen iakwb to onoma authV balanoV penqouV

kai eipen autw o qeoV to onoma sou iakwb ou klhqhsetai eti iakwb all' israhl estai to onoma sou
eipen de autw o qeoV egw o qeoV sou auxanou kai plhqunou eqnh kai sunagwgai eqnwn esontai ek sou kai basileiV ek thV osfuoV sou exeleusontai
kai thn ghn hn dedwka abraam kai isaak soi dedwka authn soi estai kai tw spermati sou meta se dwsw thn ghn tauthn
anebh de o qeoV ap' autou ek tou topou ou elalhsen met' autou

kai esthsen iakwb sthlhn epi tou mnhmeiou authV auth estin sthlh mnhmeiou rachl ewV thV shmeron hmeraV

kai outoi oi basileiV oi basileusanteV en edwm pro tou basileusai basilea en israhl
kai ebasileusen en edwm balak uioV tou bewr kai onoma th polei autou dennaba
apeqanen de balak kai ebasileusen ant' autou iwbab uioV zara ek bosorraV

apeqanen de saoul kai ebasileusen ant' autou balaennwn uioV acobwr
apeqanen de balaennwn uioV acobwr kai ebasileusen ant' autou arad uioV barad kai onoma th polei autou fogwr onoma de th gunaiki autou maitebehl qugathr matraiq uiou maizoob

hgemwn elibemaV hgemwn hlaV hgemwn finwn
hgemwn kenez hgemwn qaiman hgemwn mazar
hgemwn megedihl hgemwn zafwim outoi hgemoneV edwm en taiV katwkodomhmenaiV en th gh thV kthsewV autwn outoV hsau pathr edwm
katwkei de iakwb en th gh ou parwkhsen o pathr autou en gh canaan

autai de ai geneseiV iakwb iwshf deka epta etwn hn poimainwn meta twn adelfwn autou ta probata wn neoV meta twn uiwn ballaV kai meta twn uiwn zelfaV twn gunaikwn tou patroV autou kathnegken de iwshf yogon ponhron proV israhl ton patera autwn

idonteV de oi adelfoi autou oti auton o pathr filei ek pantwn twn uiwn autou emishsan auton kai ouk edunanto lalein autw ouden eirhnikon

kai eipen mwushV tade legei kurioV peri mesaV nuktaV egw eisporeuomai eiV meson aiguptou
kai teleuthsei pan prwtotokon en gh aiguptw apo prwtotokou faraw oV kaqhtai epi tou qronou kai ewV prwtotokou thV qerapainhV thV para ton mulon kai ewV prwtotokou pantoV kthnouV
kai estai kraugh megalh kata pasan ghn aiguptou htiV toiauth ou gegonen kai toiauth ouketi prosteqhsetai
kai en pasi toiV uioiV israhl ou gruxei kuwn th glwssh autou apo anqrwpou ewV kthnouV opwV eidhV osa paradoxasei kurioV ana meson twn aiguptiwn kai tou israhl
kai katabhsontai panteV oi paideV sou outoi proV me kai prokunhsousin me legonteV exelqe su kai paV o laoV sou ou su afhgh kai meta tauta exeleusomai exhlqen de mwushV apo faraw meta qumou
eipen de kurioV proV mwushn ouk eisakousetai umwn faraw ina plhqunwn plhqunw mou ta shmeia kai ta terata en gh aiguptw
mwushV de kai aarwn epoihsan panta ta shmeia kai ta terata tauta en gh aiguptw enantion faraw esklhrunen de kurioV thn kardian faraw kai ouk hqelhsen exaposteilai touV uiouV israhl ek ghV aiguptou

o mhn outoV umin arch mhnwn prwtoV estin umin en toiV mhsin tou eniautou

ean de oligostoi wsin oi en th oikia wste mh ikanouV einai eiV probaton sullhmyetai meq' eautou ton geitona ton plhsion autou kata ariqmon yucwn ekastoV to arkoun autw sunariqmhsetai eiV probaton
probaton teleion arsen eniausion estai umin apo twn arnwn kai twn erifwn lhmyesqe
kai estai umin diatethrhmenon ewV thV tessareskaidekathV tou mhnoV toutou kai sfaxousin auto pan to plhqoV sunagwghV uiwn israhl proV esperan
kai lhmyontai apo tou aimatoV kai qhsousin epi twn duo staqmwn kai epi thn flian en toiV oikoiV en oiV ean fagwsin auta en autoiV
kai fagontai ta krea th nukti tauth opta puri kai azuma epi pikridwn edontai
ouk edesqe ap' autwn wmon oude hyhmenon en udati all' h opta puri kefalhn sun toiV posin kai toiV endosqioiV
ouk apoleiyete ap' autou ewV prwi kai ostoun ou suntriyete ap' autou ta de kataleipomena ap' autou ewV prwi en puri katakausete
outwV de fagesqe auto ai osfueV umwn periezwsmenai kai ta upodhmata en toiV posin umwn kai ai bakthriai en taiV cersin umwn kai edesqe auto meta spoudhV pasca estin kuriw
kai dieleusomai en gh aiguptw en th nukti tauth kai pataxw pan prwtotokon en gh aiguptw apo anqrwpou ewV kthnouV kai en pasi toiV qeoiV twn aiguptiwn poihsw thn ekdikhsin egw kurioV
kai estai to aima umin en shmeiw epi twn oikiwn en aiV umeiV este ekei kai oyomai to aima kai skepasw umaV kai ouk estai en umin plhgh tou ektribhnai otan paiw en gh aiguptw
kai estai h hmera umin auth mnhmosunon kai eortasete authn eorthn kuriw eiV pasaV taV geneaV umwn nomimon aiwnion eortasete authn

kai eipen ean akoh akoushV thV fwnhV kuriou tou qeou sou kai ta aresta enantion autou poihshV kai enwtish taiV entolaiV autou kai fulaxhV panta ta dikaiwmata autou pasan noson hn ephgagon toiV aiguptioiV ouk epaxw epi se egw gar eimi kurioV o iwmenoV se

kai elalhsen kurioV proV mwushn legwn

touto to rhma o sunetaxen kurioV sunagagete ap' autou ekastoV eiV touV kaqhkontaV gomor kata kefalhn kata ariqmon yucwn umwn ekastoV sun toiV suskhnioiV umwn sullexate

kai ouk eishkousan mwush alla katelipon tineV ap' autou eiV to prwi kai exezesen skwlhkaV kai epwzesen kai epikranqh ep' autoiV mwushV
kai sunelexan auto prwi prwi ekastoV to kaqhkon autw hnika de dieqermainen o hlioV ethketo
egeneto de th hmera th ekth sunelexan ta deonta dipla duo gomor tw eni eishlqosan de panteV oi arconteV thV sunagwghV kai anhggeilan mwusei

kai kateliposan ap' autou eiV to prwi kaqaper sunetaxen autoiV mwushV kai ouk epwzesen oude skwlhx egeneto en autw

ex hmeraV sullexete th de hmera th ebdomh sabbata oti ouk estai en auth

kai esabbatisen o laoV th hmera th ebdomh

eipen de mwushV touto to rhma o sunetaxen kurioV plhsate to gomor tou man eiV apoqhkhn eiV taV geneaV umwn ina idwsin ton arton on efagete umeiV en th erhmw wV exhgagen umaV kurioV ek ghV aiguptou
kai eipen mwushV proV aarwn labe stamnon crusoun ena kai embale eiV auton plhreV to gomor tou man kai apoqhseiV auto enantion tou qeou eiV diathrhsin eiV taV geneaV umwn

oi de uioi israhl efagon to man eth tessarakonta ewV hlqon eiV ghn oikoumenhn to man efagosan ewV paregenonto eiV meroV thV foinikhV
to de gomor to dekaton twn triwn metrwn hn
kai aphren pasa sunagwgh uiwn israhl ek thV erhmou sin kata parembolaV autwn dia rhmatoV kuriou kai parenebalosan en rafidin ouk hn de udwr tw law piein
kai eloidoreito o laoV proV mwushn legonteV doV hmin udwr ina piwmen kai eipen autoiV mwushV ti loidoreisqe moi kai ti peirazete kurion
ediyhsen de ekei o laoV udati kai egogguzen ekei o laoV proV mwushn legonteV ina ti touto anebibasaV hmaV ex aiguptou apokteinai hmaV kai ta tekna hmwn kai ta kthnh tw diyei

kai eipen kurioV proV mwushn proporeuou tou laou toutou labe de meta seautou apo twn presbuterwn tou laou kai thn rabdon en h epataxaV ton potamon labe en th ceiri sou kai poreush
ode egw esthka pro tou se ekei epi thV petraV en cwrhb kai pataxeiV thn petran kai exeleusetai ex authV udwr kai pietai o laoV mou epoihsen de mwushV outwV enantion twn uiwn israhl
kai epwnomasen to onoma tou topou ekeinou peirasmoV kai loidorhsiV dia thn loidorian twn uiwn israhl kai dia to peirazein kurion legontaV ei estin kurioV en hmin h ou

kai epoihsen ihsouV kaqaper eipen autw mwushV kai exelqwn paretaxato tw amalhk kai mwushV kai aarwn kai wr anebhsan epi thn korufhn tou bounou

kai etreyato ihsouV ton amalhk kai panta ton laon autou en fonw macairaV

kai wkodomhsen mwushV qusiasthrion kuriw kai epwnomasen to onoma autou kurioV mou katafugh
oti en ceiri krufaia polemei kurioV epi amalhk apo genewn eiV geneaV
hkousen de ioqor o iereuV madiam o gambroV mwush panta osa epoihsen kurioV israhl tw eautou law exhgagen gar kurioV ton israhl ex aiguptou
elaben de ioqor o gambroV mwush sepfwran thn gunaika mwush meta thn afesin authV
kai touV duo uiouV autou onoma tw eni autwn ghrsam legwn paroikoV hmhn en gh allotria
kai to onoma tou deuterou eliezer legwn o gar qeoV tou patroV mou bohqoV mou kai exeilato me ek ceiroV faraw
kai exhlqen ioqor o gambroV mwush kai oi uioi kai h gunh proV mwushn eiV thn erhmon ou parenebalen ep' orouV tou qeou
anhggelh de mwusei legonteV idou o gambroV sou ioqor paraginetai proV se kai h gunh kai oi duo uioi sou met' autou
exhlqen de mwushV eiV sunanthsin tw gambrw autou kai prosekunhsen autw kai efilhsen auton kai hspasanto allhlouV kai eishgagen auton eiV thn skhnhn

kai dihghsato mwushV tw gambrw panta osa epoihsen kurioV tw faraw kai toiV aiguptioiV eneken tou israhl kai panta ton mocqon ton genomenon autoiV en th odw kai oti exeilato autouV kurioV ek ceiroV faraw kai ek ceiroV twn aiguptiwn
exesth de ioqor epi pasi toiV agaqoiV oiV epoihsen autoiV kurioV oti exeilato autouV ek ceiroV aiguptiwn kai ek ceiroV faraw

kai elaben ioqor o gambroV mwush olokautwmata kai qusiaV tw qew paregeneto de aarwn kai panteV oi presbuteroi israhl sumfagein arton meta tou gambrou mwush enantion tou qeou

ean to rhma touto poihshV katiscusei se o qeoV kai dunhsh parasthnai kai paV o laoV outoV eiV ton eautou topon met' eirhnhV hxei

kai nun ean akoh akoushte thV emhV fwnhV kai fulaxhte thn diaqhkhn mou esesqe moi laoV periousioV apo pantwn twn eqnwn emh gar estin pasa h gh

kai eipen o qeoV proV mwushn legwn katabaV diamarturai tw law mhpote eggiswsin proV ton qeon katanohsai kai peswsin ex autwn plhqoV

kai ekqerizontwn umwn ton qerismon thV ghV umwn ou suntelesete ton qerismon umwn tou agrou ekqerisai kai ta apopiptonta tou qerismou sou ou sullexeiV
kai ton ampelwna sou ouk epanatrughseiV oude touV rwgaV tou ampelwnoV sou sullexeiV tw ptwcw kai tw proshlutw kataleiyeiV auta egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
ou kleyete ou yeusesqe ou sukofanthsei ekastoV ton plhsion
kai ouk omeisqe tw onomati mou ep' adikw kai ou bebhlwsete to onoma tou qeou umwn egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
ouk adikhseiV ton plhsion kai ouc arpaseiV kai ou mh koimhqhsetai o misqoV tou misqwtou para soi ewV prwi
ou kakwV ereiV kwfon kai apenanti tuflou ou prosqhseiV skandalon kai fobhqhsh kurion ton qeon sou egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
ou poihsete adikon en krisei ou lhmyh proswpon ptwcou oude qaumaseiV proswpon dunastou en dikaiosunh krineiV ton plhsion sou
ou poreush dolw en tw eqnei sou ouk episusthsh ef' aima tou plhsion sou egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
ou mishseiV ton adelfon sou th dianoia sou elegmw elegxeiV ton plhsion sou kai ou lhmyh di' auton amartian
kai ouk ekdikatai sou h ceir kai ou mhnieiV toiV uioiV tou laou sou kai agaphseiV ton plhsion sou wV seauton egw eimi kurioV
ton nomon mou fulaxesqe ta kthnh sou ou katoceuseiV eterozugw kai ton ampelwna sou ou kataspereiV diaforon kai imation ek duo ufasmenon kibdhlon ouk epibaleiV seautw

kai ean tiV koimhqh meta gunaikoV koithn spermatoV kai auth oiketiV diapefulagmenh anqrwpw kai auth lutroiV ou lelutrwtai h eleuqeria ouk edoqh auth episkoph estai autoiV ouk apoqanountai oti ouk aphleuqerwqh
kai prosaxei thV plhmmeleiaV autou tw kuriw para thn quran thV skhnhV tou marturiou krion plhmmeleiaV
kai exilasetai peri autou o iereuV en tw kriw thV plhmmeleiaV enanti kuriou peri thV amartiaV hV hmarten kai afeqhsetai autw h amartia hn hmarten

otan de eiselqhte eiV thn ghn hn kurioV o qeoV umwn didwsin umin kai katafuteusete pan xulon brwsimon kai perikaqarieite thn akaqarsian autou o karpoV autou tria eth estai umin aperikaqartoV ou brwqhsetai
kai tw etei tw tetartw estai paV o karpoV autou agioV ainetoV tw kuriw
en de tw etei tw pemptw fagesqe ton karpon prosqema umin ta genhmata autou egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
mh esqete epi twn orewn kai ouk oiwnieisqe oude orniqoskophsesqe
ou poihsete sisohn ek thV komhV thV kefalhV umwn oude fqereite thn oyin tou pwgwnoV umwn
kai entomidaV epi yuch ou poihsete en tw swmati umwn kai grammata stikta ou poihsete en umin egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
ou bebhlwseiV thn qugatera sou ekporneusai authn kai ouk ekporneusei h gh kai h gh plhsqhsetai anomiaV
ta sabbata mou fulaxesqe kai apo twn agiwn mou fobhqhsesqe egw eimi kurioV
ouk epakolouqhsete eggastrimuqoiV kai toiV epaoidoiV ou proskollhqhsesqe ekmianqhnai en autoiV egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
apo proswpou poliou exanasthsh kai timhseiV proswpon presbuterou kai fobhqhsh ton qeon sou egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
ean de tiV proselqh proshlutoV umin en th gh umwn ou qliyete auton
wV o autocqwn en umin estai o proshlutoV o prosporeuomenoV proV umaV kai agaphseiV auton wV seauton oti proshlutoi egenhqhte en gh aiguptw egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
ou poihsete adikon en krisei en metroiV kai en staqmioiV kai en zugoiV
zuga dikaia kai staqmia dikaia kai couV dikaioV estai umin egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn o exagagwn umaV ek ghV aiguptou
kai fulaxesqe panta ton nomon mou kai panta ta prostagmata mou kai poihsete auta egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
kai elalhsen kurioV proV mwushn legwn

kai toiV uioiV israhl lalhseiV ean tiV apo twn uiwn israhl h apo twn prosgegenhmenwn proshlutwn en israhl oV an dw tou spermatoV autou arconti qanatw qanatousqw to eqnoV to epi thV ghV liqobolhsousin auton en liqoiV
kai egw episthsw to proswpon mou epi ton anqrwpon ekeinon kai apolw auton ek tou laou autou oti tou spermatoV autou edwken arconti ina mianh ta agia mou kai bebhlwsh to onoma twn hgiasmenwn moi
ean de uperoyei uperidwsin oi autocqoneV thV ghV toiV ofqalmoiV autwn apo tou anqrwpou ekeinou en tw dounai auton tou spermatoV autou arconti tou mh apokteinai auton
kai episthsw to proswpon mou epi ton anqrwpon ekeinon kai thn suggeneian autou kai apolw auton kai pantaV touV omonoountaV autw wste ekporneuein auton eiV touV arcontaV ek tou laou autwn
kai yuch h ean epakolouqhsh eggastrimuqoiV h epaoidoiV wste ekporneusai opisw autwn episthsw to proswpon mou epi thn yuchn ekeinhn kai apolw authn ek tou laou authV
kai esesqe agioi oti agioV egw kurioV o qeoV umwn
kai fulaxesqe ta prostagmata mou kai poihsete auta egw kurioV o agiazwn umaV
anqrwpoV anqrwpoV oV an kakwV eiph ton patera autou h thn mhtera autou qanatw qanatousqw patera autou h mhtera autou kakwV eipen enocoV estai
anqrwpoV oV an moiceushtai gunaika androV h oV an moiceushtai gunaika tou plhsion qanatw qanatousqwsan o moiceuwn kai h moiceuomenh
ean tiV koimhqh meta gunaikoV tou patroV autou aschmosunhn tou patroV autou apekaluyen qanatw qanatousqwsan amfoteroi enocoi eisin
kai ean tiV koimhqh meta numfhV autou qanatw qanatousqwsan amfoteroi hsebhkasin gar enocoi eisin
kai oV an koimhqh meta arsenoV koithn gunaikoV bdelugma epoihsan amfoteroi qanatousqwsan enocoi eisin
oV ean labh gunaika kai thn mhtera authV anomhma estin en puri katakausousin auton kai autaV kai ouk estai anomia en umin
kai oV an dw koitasian autou en tetrapodi qanatw qanatousqw kai to tetrapoun apokteneite
kai gunh htiV proseleusetai proV pan kthnoV bibasqhnai authn up' autou apokteneite thn gunaika kai to kthnoV qanatw qanatousqwsan enocoi eisin

oV ean labh thn adelfhn autou ek patroV autou h ek mhtroV autou kai idh thn aschmosunhn authV kai auth idh thn aschmosunhn autou oneidoV estin exoleqreuqhsontai enwpion uiwn genouV autwn aschmosunhn adelfhV autou apekaluyen amartian komiountai

kai anhr oV an koimhqh meta gunaikoV apokaqhmenhV kai apokaluyh thn aschmosunhn authV thn phghn authV apekaluyen kai auth apekaluyen thn rusin tou aimatoV authV exoleqreuqhsontai amfoteroi ek tou genouV autwn
kai aschmosunhn adelfhV patroV sou kai adelfhV mhtroV sou ouk apokaluyeiV thn gar oikeiothta apekaluyen amartian apoisontai
oV an koimhqh meta thV suggenouV autou aschmosunhn thV suggeneiaV autou apekaluyen ateknoi apoqanountai
oV an labh thn gunaika tou adelfou autou akaqarsia estin aschmosunhn tou adelfou autou apekaluyen ateknoi apoqanountai
kai fulaxasqe panta ta prostagmata mou kai ta krimata mou kai poihsete auta kai ou mh prosocqish umin h gh eiV hn egw eisagw umaV ekei katoikein ep' authV
kai ouci poreuesqe toiV nomimoiV twn eqnwn ouV exapostellw af' umwn oti tauta panta epoihsan kai ebdeluxamhn autouV
kai eipa umin umeiV klhronomhsate thn ghn autwn kai egw dwsw umin authn en kthsei ghn reousan gala kai meli egw kurioV o qeoV umwn oV diwrisa umaV apo pantwn twn eqnwn

kai aforieite autouV ana meson twn kthnwn twn kaqarwn kai ana meson twn kthnwn twn akaqartwn kai ana meson twn peteinwn twn kaqarwn kai twn akaqartwn kai ou bdeluxete taV yucaV umwn en toiV kthnesin kai en toiV peteinoiV kai en pasin toiV erpetoiV thV ghV a egw afwrisa umin en akaqarsia
kai esesqe moi agioi oti egw agioV kurioV o qeoV umwn o aforisaV umaV apo pantwn twn eqnwn einai emoi
kai anhr h gunh oV an genhtai autwn eggastrimuqoV h epaoidoV qanatw qanatousqwsan amfoteroi liqoiV liqobolhsate autouV enocoi eisin
kai eipen kurioV proV mwushn legwn eipon toiV iereusin toiV uioiV aarwn kai ereiV proV autouV en taiV yucaiV ou mianqhsontai en tw eqnei autwn
all' h en tw oikeiw tw eggista autwn epi patri kai mhtri kai uioiV kai qugatrasin ep' adelfw
kai ep' adelfh parqenw th eggizoush autw th mh ekdedomenh andri epi toutoiV mianqhsetai
ou mianqhsetai exapina en tw law autou eiV bebhlwsin autou
kai falakrwma ou xurhqhsesqe thn kefalhn epi nekrw kai thn oyin tou pwgwnoV ou xurhsontai kai epi taV sarkaV autwn ou katatemousin entomidaV
agioi esontai tw qew autwn kai ou bebhlwsousin to onoma tou qeou autwn taV gar qusiaV kuriou dwra tou qeou autwn autoi prosferousin kai esontai agioi
gunaika pornhn kai bebhlwmenhn ou lhmyontai kai gunaika ekbeblhmenhn apo androV authV agioV estin tw kuriw qew autou
kai agiasei auton ta dwra kuriou tou qeou umwn outoV prosferei agioV estai oti agioV egw kurioV o agiazwn autouV
kai qugathr anqrwpou ierewV ean bebhlwqh tou ekporneusai to onoma tou patroV authV auth bebhloi epi puroV katakauqhsetai
kai o iereuV o megaV apo twn adelfwn autou tou epikecumenou epi thn kefalhn tou elaiou tou cristou kai teteleiwmenou endusasqai ta imatia thn kefalhn ouk apokidarwsei kai ta imatia ou diarrhxei
kai epi pash yuch teteleuthkuia ouk eiseleusetai epi patri autou oude epi mhtri autou ou mianqhsetai
kai ek twn agiwn ouk exeleusetai kai ou bebhlwsei to hgiasmenon tou qeou autou oti to agion elaion to criston tou qeou ep' autw egw kurioV
outoV gunaika parqenon ek tou genouV autou lhmyetai
chran de kai ekbeblhmenhn kai bebhlwmenhn kai pornhn tautaV ou lhmyetai all' h parqenon ek tou genouV autou lhmyetai gunaika
kai ou bebhlwsei to sperma autou en tw law autou egw kurioV o agiazwn auton
kai elalhsen kurioV proV mwushn legwn
eipon aarwn anqrwpoV ek tou genouV sou eiV taV geneaV umwn tini ean h en autw mwmoV ou proseleusetai prosferein ta dwra tou qeou autou
paV anqrwpoV w an h en autw mwmoV ou proseleusetai anqrwpoV cwloV h tufloV h koloborrin h wtotmhtoV
h anqrwpoV w estin en autw suntrimma ceiroV h suntrimma podoV
h kurtoV h efhloV h ptiloV touV ofqalmouV h anqrwpoV w an h en autw ywra agria h lichn h monorciV
paV w estin en autw mwmoV ek tou spermatoV aarwn tou ierewV ouk eggiei tou prosenegkein taV qusiaV tw qew sou oti mwmoV en autw ta dwra tou qeou ou proseleusetai prosenegkein
ta dwra tou qeou ta agia twn agiwn kai apo twn agiwn fagetai
plhn proV to katapetasma ou proseleusetai kai proV to qusiasthrion ouk eggiei oti mwmon ecei kai ou bebhlwsei to agion tou qeou autou oti egw eimi kurioV o agiazwn autouV
kai elalhsen mwushV proV aarwn kai touV uiouV autou kai proV pantaV uiouV israhl
kai elalhsen kurioV proV mwushn legwn
eipon aarwn kai toiV uioiV autou kai prosecetwsan apo twn agiwn twn uiwn israhl kai ou bebhlwsousin to onoma to agion mou osa autoi agiazousin moi egw kurioV

eipon autoiV eiV taV geneaV umwn paV anqrwpoV oV an proselqh apo pantoV tou spermatoV umwn proV ta agia osa an agiazwsin oi uioi israhl tw kuriw kai h akaqarsia autou ep' autw exoleqreuqhsetai h yuch ekeinh ap' emou egw kurioV o qeoV umwn
kai anqrwpoV ek tou spermatoV aarwn tou ierewV kai outoV lepra h gonorruhV twn agiwn ouk edetai ewV an kaqarisqh kai o aptomenoV pashV akaqarsiaV yuchV h anqrwpoV w an exelqh ex autou koith spermatoV
h ostiV an ayhtai pantoV erpetou akaqartou o mianei auton h ep' anqrwpw en w mianei auton kata pasan akaqarsian autou
yuch htiV an ayhtai autwn akaqartoV estai ewV esperaV ouk edetai apo twn agiwn ean mh loushtai to swma autou udati
kai duh o hlioV kai kaqaroV estai kai tote fagetai twn agiwn oti artoV estin autou
qnhsimaion kai qhrialwton ou fagetai mianqhnai auton en autoiV egw kurioV
kai fulaxontai ta fulagmata mou ina mh labwsin di' auta amartian kai apoqanwsin di' auta ean bebhlwswsin auta egw kurioV o qeoV o agiazwn autouV
kai paV allogenhV ou fagetai agia paroikoV ierewV h misqwtoV ou fagetai agia
ean de iereuV kthshtai yuchn egkthton arguriou outoV fagetai ek twn artwn autou kai oi oikogeneiV autou kai outoi fagontai twn artwn autou
kai qugathr anqrwpou ierewV ean genhtai andri allogenei auth twn aparcwn twn agiwn ou fagetai

kai qugathr ierewV ean genhtai chra h ekbeblhmenh sperma de mh hn auth epanastreyei epi ton oikon ton patrikon kata thn neothta authV apo twn artwn tou patroV authV fagetai kai paV allogenhV ou fagetai ap' autwn
kai anqrwpoV oV an fagh agia kata agnoian kai prosqhsei to epipempton autou ep' auto kai dwsei tw ierei to agion
kai ou bebhlwsousin ta agia twn uiwn israhl a autoi afairousin tw kuriw
kai epaxousin ef' eautouV anomian plhmmeleiaV en tw esqiein autouV ta agia autwn oti egw kurioV o agiazwn autouV
kai elalhsen kurioV proV mwushn legwn

lalhson aarwn kai toiV uioiV autou kai pash sunagwgh israhl kai ereiV proV autouV anqrwpoV anqrwpoV apo twn uiwn israhl h twn uiwn twn proshlutwn twn proskeimenwn proV autouV en israhl oV an prosenegkh ta dwra autou kata pasan omologian autwn h kata pasan airesin autwn osa an prosenegkwsin tw qew eiV olokautwma
dekta umin amwma arsena ek twn boukoliwn kai ek twn probatwn kai ek twn aigwn
panta osa an ech mwmon en autw ou prosaxousin kuriw dioti ou dekton estai umin
kai anqrwpoV oV an prosenegkh qusian swthriou tw kuriw diasteilaV euchn kata airesin h en taiV eortaiV umwn ek twn boukoliwn h ek twn probatwn amwmon estai eiV dekton paV mwmoV ouk estai en autw
tuflon h suntetrimmenon h glwssotmhton h murmhkiwnta h ywragriwnta h lichnaV econta ou prosaxousin tauta tw kuriw kai eiV karpwsin ou dwsete ap' autwn epi to qusiasthrion tw kuriw
kai moscon h probaton wtotmhton h kolobokerkon sfagia poihseiV auta seautw eiV de euchn sou ou decqhsetai
qladian kai ekteqlimmenon kai ektomian kai apespasmenon ou prosaxeiV auta tw kuriw kai epi thV ghV umwn ou poihsete
kai ek ceiroV allogenouV ou prosoisete ta dwra tou qeou umwn apo pantwn toutwn oti fqarmata estin en autoiV mwmoV en autoiV ou decqhsetai tauta umin
kai elalhsen kurioV proV mwushn legwn
moscon h probaton h aiga wV an tecqh kai estai epta hmeraV upo thn mhtera th de hmera th ogdoh kai epekeina decqhsetai eiV dwra karpwma kuriw
kai moscon h probaton authn kai ta paidia authV ou sfaxeiV en hmera mia
ean de qushV qusian euchn carmosunhV kuriw eiV dekton umin qusete auto
auth th hmera ekeinh brwqhsetai ouk apoleiyete apo twn krewn eiV to prwi egw eimi kurioV
kai fulaxete taV entolaV mou kai poihsete autaV
kai ou bebhlwsete to onoma tou agiou kai agiasqhsomai en mesw twn uiwn israhl egw kurioV o agiazwn umaV
o exagagwn umaV ek ghV aiguptou wste einai umwn qeoV egw kurioV
kai eipen kurioV proV mwushn legwn
lalhson toiV uioiV israhl kai ereiV proV autouV ai eortai kuriou aV kalesete autaV klhtaV agiaV autai eisin eortai mou
ex hmeraV poihseiV erga kai th hmera th ebdomh sabbata anapausiV klhth agia tw kuriw pan ergon ou poihseiV sabbata estin tw kuriw en pash katoikia umwn
autai ai eortai tw kuriw klhtai agiai aV kalesete autaV en toiV kairoiV autwn
en tw prwtw mhni en th tessareskaidekath hmera tou mhnoV ana meson twn esperinwn pasca tw kuriw
kai en th pentekaidekath hmera tou mhnoV toutou eorth twn azumwn tw kuriw epta hmeraV azuma edesqe
kai h hmera h prwth klhth agia estai umin pan ergon latreuton ou poihsete
kai prosaxete olokautwmata tw kuriw epta hmeraV kai h ebdomh hmera klhth agia estai umin pan ergon latreuton ou poihsete
kai elalhsen kurioV proV mwushn legwn
eipon toiV uioiV israhl kai ereiV proV autouV otan eiselqhte eiV thn ghn hn egw didwmi umin kai qerizhte ton qerismon authV kai oisete dragma aparchn tou qerismou umwn proV ton ierea
kai anoisei to dragma enanti kuriou dekton umin th epaurion thV prwthV anoisei auto o iereuV
kai poihsete en th hmera en h an ferhte to dragma probaton amwmon eniausion eiV olokautwma tw kuriw
kai thn qusian autou duo dekata semidalewV anapepoihmenhV en elaiw qusia tw kuriw osmh euwdiaV kuriw kai spondhn autou to tetarton tou in oinou
kai arton kai pefrugmena cidra nea ou fagesqe ewV eiV authn thn hmeran tauthn ewV an prosenegkhte umeiV ta dwra tw qew umwn nomimon aiwnion eiV taV geneaV umwn en pash katoikia umwn
kai ariqmhsete umeiV apo thV epaurion twn sabbatwn apo thV hmeraV hV an prosenegkhte to dragma tou epiqematoV epta ebdomadaV oloklhrouV
ewV thV epaurion thV escathV ebdomadoV ariqmhsete penthkonta hmeraV kai prosoisete qusian nean tw kuriw
apo thV katoikiaV umwn prosoisete artouV epiqema duo artouV ek duo dekatwn semidalewV esontai ezumwmenoi pefqhsontai prwtogenhmatwn tw kuriw

kai prosaxete meta twn artwn epta amnouV amwmouV eniausiouV kai moscon ena ek boukoliou kai kriouV duo amwmouV esontai olokautwma tw kuriw kai ai qusiai autwn kai ai spondai autwn qusian osmhn euwdiaV tw kuriw
kai poihsousin cimaron ex aigwn ena peri amartiaV kai duo amnouV eniausiouV eiV qusian swthriou meta twn artwn tou prwtogenhmatoV
kai epiqhsei auta o iereuV meta twn artwn tou prwtogenhmatoV epiqema enanti kuriou meta twn duo amnwn agia esontai tw kuriw tw ierei tw prosferonti auta autw estai
kai kalesete tauthn thn hmeran klhthn agia estai umin pan ergon latreuton ou poihsete en auth nomimon aiwnion eiV taV geneaV umwn en pash th katoikia umwn

kai otan qerizhte ton qerismon thV ghV umwn ou suntelesete to loipon tou qerismou tou agrou sou en tw qerizein se kai ta apopiptonta tou qerismou sou ou sullexeiV tw ptwcw kai tw proshlutw upoleiyh auta egw kurioV o qeoV umwn
kai elalhsen kurioV proV mwushn legwn
lalhson toiV uioiV israhl legwn tou mhnoV tou ebdomou mia tou mhnoV estai umin anapausiV mnhmosunon salpiggwn klhth agia estai umin
pan ergon latreuton ou poihsete kai prosaxete olokautwma kuriw
kai elalhsen kurioV proV mwushn legwn
kai th dekath tou mhnoV tou ebdomou toutou hmera exilasmou klhth agia estai umin kai tapeinwsete taV yucaV umwn kai prosaxete olokautwma tw kuriw
pan ergon ou poihsete en auth th hmera tauth estin gar hmera exilasmou auth umin exilasasqai peri umwn enanti kuriou tou qeou umwn
pasa yuch htiV mh tapeinwqhsetai en auth th hmera tauth exoleqreuqhsetai ek tou laou authV
kai pasa yuch htiV poihsei ergon en auth th hmera tauth apoleitai h yuch ekeinh ek tou laou authV
pan ergon ou poihsete nomimon aiwnion eiV taV geneaV umwn en pasaiV katoikiaiV umwn
sabbata sabbatwn estai umin kai tapeinwsete taV yucaV umwn apo enathV tou mhnoV apo esperaV ewV esperaV sabbatieite ta sabbata umwn
kai elalhsen kurioV proV mwushn legwn
lalhson toiV uioiV israhl legwn th pentekaidekath tou mhnoV tou ebdomou toutou eorth skhnwn epta hmeraV tw kuriw
kai h hmera h prwth klhth agia pan ergon latreuton ou poihsete
epta hmeraV prosaxete olokautwmata tw kuriw kai h hmera h ogdoh klhth agia estai umin kai prosaxete olokautwmata tw kuriw exodion estin pan ergon latreuton ou poihsete
autai ai eortai kuriw aV kalesete klhtaV agiaV wste prosenegkai karpwmata tw kuriw olokautwmata kai qusiaV autwn kai spondaV autwn to kaq' hmeran eiV hmeran
plhn twn sabbatwn kuriou kai plhn twn domatwn umwn kai plhn paswn twn eucwn umwn kai plhn twn ekousiwn umwn a an dwte tw kuriw

ex eth spereiV ton agron sou kai ex eth temeiV thn ampelon sou kai sunaxeiV ton karpon authV
tw de etei tw ebdomw sabbata anapausiV estai th gh sabbata tw kuriw ton agron sou ou spereiV kai thn ampelon sou ou temeiV
kai ta automata anabainonta tou agrou sou ouk ekqeriseiV kai thn stafulhn tou agiasmatoV sou ouk ektrughseiV eniautoV anapausewV estai th gh
kai estai ta sabbata thV ghV brwmata soi kai tw paidi sou kai th paidiskh sou kai tw misqwtw sou kai tw paroikw tw proskeimenw proV se

kai agiasete to etoV to penthkoston eniauton kai diabohsete afesin epi thV ghV pasin toiV katoikousin authn eniautoV afesewV shmasia auth estai umin kai apeleusetai eiV ekastoV eiV thn kthsin autou kai ekastoV eiV thn patrida autou apeleusesqe
afesewV shmasia auth to etoV to penthkoston eniautoV estai umin ou spereite oude amhsete ta automata anabainonta authV kai ou trughsete ta hgiasmena authV
oti afesewV shmasia estin agion estai umin apo twn pediwn fagesqe ta genhmata authV
en tw etei thV afesewV shmasia authV epaneleusetai ekastoV eiV thn kthsin autou
ean de apodw prasin tw plhsion sou ean kai kthsh para tou plhsion sou mh qlibetw anqrwpoV ton plhsion
kata ariqmon etwn meta thn shmasian kthsh para tou plhsion kata ariqmon eniautwn genhmatwn apodwsetai soi
kaqoti an pleion twn etwn plhqunh thn egkthsin autou kai kaqoti an elatton twn etwn elattonwsh thn kthsin autou oti ariqmon genhmatwn autou outwV apodwsetai soi
mh qlibetw anqrwpoV ton plhsion kai fobhqhsh kurion ton qeon sou egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
kai poihsete panta ta dikaiwmata mou kai pasaV taV kriseiV mou kai fulaxasqe kai poihsete auta kai katoikhsete epi thV ghV pepoiqoteV
kai dwsei h gh ta ekforia authV kai fagesqe eiV plhsmonhn kai katoikhsete pepoiqoteV ep' authV
ean de leghte ti fagomeqa en tw etei tw ebdomw toutw ean mh speirwmen mhde sunagagwmen ta genhmata hmwn
kai apostelw thn eulogian mou umin en tw etei tw ektw kai poihsei ta genhmata authV eiV ta tria eth
kai spereite to etoV to ogdoon kai fagesqe apo twn genhmatwn palaia ewV tou etouV tou enatou ewV an elqh to genhma authV fagesqe palaia palaiwn
kai h gh ou praqhsetai eiV bebaiwsin emh gar estin h gh dioti proshlutoi kai paroikoi umeiV este enantion mou
kai kata pasan ghn katascesewV umwn lutra dwsete thV ghV
ean de penhtai o adelfoV sou o meta sou kai apodwtai apo thV katascesewV autou kai elqh o agcisteuwn eggizwn eggista autou kai lutrwsetai thn prasin tou adelfou autou
ean de mh h tini o agcisteuwn kai euporhqh th ceiri kai eureqh autw to ikanon lutra autou
kai sullogieitai ta eth thV prasewV autou kai apodwsei o uperecei tw anqrwpw w apedoto eauton autw kai apeleusetai eiV thn katascesin autou
ean de mh euporhqh h ceir autou to ikanon wste apodounai autw kai estai h prasiV tw kthsamenw auta ewV tou ektou etouV thV afesewV kai exeleusetai th afesei kai apeleusetai eiV thn katascesin autou
ean de tiV apodwtai oikian oikhthn en polei teteicismenh kai estai h lutrwsiV authV ewV plhrwqh eniautoV hmerwn estai h lutrwsiV authV
ean de mh lutrwqh ewV an plhrwqh authV eniautoV oloV kurwqhsetai h oikia h ousa en polei th ecoush teicoV bebaiwV tw kthsamenw authn eiV taV geneaV autou kai ouk exeleusetai en th afesei
ai de oikiai ai en epaulesin aiV ouk estin en autaiV teicoV kuklw proV ton agron thV ghV logisqhtwsan lutrwtai dia pantoV esontai kai en th afesei exeleusontai
kai ai poleiV twn leuitwn oikiai twn polewn autwn katascesewV lutrwtai dia pantoV esontai toiV leuitaiV
kai oV an lutrwsamenoV para twn leuitwn kai exeleusetai h diaprasiV autwn oikiwn polewV katascesewV autwn en th afesei oti oikiai twn polewn twn leuitwn katascesiV autwn en mesw uiwn israhl
kai oi agroi oi afwrismenoi taiV polesin autwn ou praqhsontai oti katascesiV aiwnia touto autwn estin
ean de penhtai o adelfoV sou kai adunathsh taiV cersin para soi antilhmyh autou wV proshlutou kai paroikou kai zhsetai o adelfoV sou meta sou
ou lhmyh par' autou tokon oude epi plhqei kai fobhqhsh ton qeon sou egw kurioV kai zhsetai o adelfoV sou meta sou
to argurion sou ou dwseiV autw epi tokw kai epi pleonasmon ou dwseiV autw ta brwmata sou
egw kurioV o qeoV umwn o exagagwn umaV ek ghV aiguptou dounai umin thn ghn canaan wste einai umwn qeoV
ean de tapeinwqh o adelfoV sou para soi kai praqh soi ou douleusei soi douleian oiketou
wV misqwtoV h paroikoV estai soi ewV tou etouV thV afesewV ergatai para soi
kai exeleusetai th afesei kai ta tekna autou met' autou kai apeleusetai eiV thn genean autou eiV thn katascesin thn patrikhn apodrameitai
dioti oiketai mou eisin outoi ouV exhgagon ek ghV aiguptou ou praqhsetai en prasei oiketou
ou katateneiV auton en tw mocqw kai fobhqhsh kurion ton qeon sou
kai paiV kai paidiskh osoi an genwntai soi apo twn eqnwn osoi kuklw sou eisin ap' autwn kthsesqe doulon kai doulhn
kai apo twn uiwn twn paroikwn twn ontwn en umin apo toutwn kthsesqe kai apo twn suggenwn autwn osoi an genwntai en th gh umwn estwsan umin eiV katascesin
kai katamerieite autouV toiV teknoiV umwn meq' umaV kai esontai umin katocimoi eiV ton aiwna twn adelfwn umwn twn uiwn israhl ekastoV ton adelfon autou ou katatenei auton en toiV mocqoiV
ean de eurh h ceir tou proshlutou h tou paroikou tou para soi kai aporhqeiV o adelfoV sou praqh tw proshlutw h tw paroikw tw para soi ek genethV proshlutw
meta to praqhnai autw lutrwsiV estai autw eiV twn adelfwn autou lutrwsetai auton
adelfoV patroV autou h uioV adelfou patroV lutrwsetai auton h apo twn oikeiwn twn sarkwn autou ek thV fulhV autou lutrwsetai auton ean de euporhqeiV taiV cersin lutrwshtai eauton
kai sullogieitai proV ton kekthmenon auton apo tou etouV ou apedoto eauton autw ewV tou eniautou thV afesewV kai estai to argurion thV prasewV autou wV misqiou etoV ex etouV estai met' autou

wV misqwtoV eniauton ex eniautou estai met' autou ou katateneiV auton en tw mocqw enwpion sou
ean de mh lutrwtai kata tauta exeleusetai en tw etei thV afesewV autoV kai ta paidia autou met' autou
oti emoi oi uioi israhl oiketai paideV mou outoi eisin ouV exhgagon ek ghV aiguptou egw kurioV o qeoV umwn
ou poihsete umin autoiV ceiropoihta oude glupta oude sthlhn anasthsete umin oude liqon skopon qhsete en th gh umwn proskunhsai autw egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn
ta sabbata mou fulaxesqe kai apo twn agiwn mou fobhqhsesqe egw eimi kurioV
ean toiV prostagmasin mou poreuhsqe kai taV entolaV mou fulasshsqe kai poihshte autaV
kai dwsw ton ueton umin en kairw autou kai h gh dwsei ta genhmata authV kai ta xula twn pediwn apodwsei ton karpon autwn
kai katalhmyetai umin o alohtoV ton trughton kai o trughtoV katalhmyetai ton sporon kai fagesqe ton arton umwn eiV plhsmonhn kai katoikhsete meta asfaleiaV epi thV ghV umwn
kai polemoV ou dieleusetai dia thV ghV umwn kai dwsw eirhnhn en th gh umwn kai koimhqhsesqe kai ouk estai umaV o ekfobwn kai apolw qhria ponhra ek thV ghV umwn
kai diwxesqe touV ecqrouV umwn kai pesountai enantion umwn fonw
kai diwxontai ex umwn pente ekaton kai ekaton umwn diwxontai muriadaV kai pesountai oi ecqroi umwn enantion umwn macaira
kai epibleyw ef' umaV kai auxanw umaV kai plhqunw umaV kai sthsw thn diaqhkhn mou meq' umwn
kai fagesqe palaia kai palaia palaiwn kai palaia ek proswpou newn exoisete
kai qhsw thn diaqhkhn mou en umin kai ou bdeluxetai h yuch mou umaV
kai emperipathsw en umin kai esomai umwn qeoV kai umeiV esesqe mou laoV
egw eimi kurioV o qeoV umwn o exagagwn umaV ek ghV aiguptou ontwn umwn doulwn kai sunetriya ton desmon tou zugou umwn kai hgagon umaV meta parrhsiaV
ean de mh upakoushte mou mhde poihshte ta prostagmata mou tauta
alla apeiqhshte autoiV kai toiV krimasin mou prosocqish h yuch umwn wste umaV mh poiein pasaV taV entolaV mou wste diaskedasai thn diaqhkhn mou

kai egw poihsw outwV umin kai episusthsw ef' umaV thn aporian thn te ywran kai ton ikteron kai sfakelizontaV touV ofqalmouV umwn kai thn yuchn umwn ekthkousan kai spereite dia kenhV ta spermata umwn kai edontai oi upenantioi umwn
kai episthsw to proswpon mou ef' umaV kai peseisqe enantion twn ecqrwn umwn kai diwxontai umaV oi misounteV umaV kai feuxesqe ouqenoV diwkontoV umaV
kai ean ewV toutou mh upakoushte mou kai prosqhsw tou paideusai umaV eptakiV epi taiV amartiaiV umwn
kai suntriyw thn ubrin thV uperhfaniaV umwn kai qhsw ton ouranon umin sidhroun kai thn ghn umwn wsei calkhn
kai estai eiV kenon h iscuV umwn kai ou dwsei h gh umwn ton sporon authV kai to xulon tou agrou umwn ou dwsei ton karpon autou
kai ean meta tauta poreuhsqe plagioi kai mh boulhsqe upakouein mou prosqhsw umin plhgaV epta kata taV amartiaV umwn
kai apostelw ef' umaV ta qhria ta agria thV ghV kai katedetai umaV kai exanalwsei ta kthnh umwn kai oligostouV poihsei umaV kai erhmwqhsontai ai odoi umwn
kai epi toutoiV ean mh paideuqhte alla poreuhsqe proV me plagioi
poreusomai kagw meq' umwn qumw plagiw kai pataxw umaV kagw eptakiV anti twn amartiwn umwn
kai epaxw ef' umaV macairan ekdikousan dikhn diaqhkhV kai katafeuxesqe eiV taV poleiV umwn kai exapostelw qanaton eiV umaV kai paradoqhsesqe eiV ceiraV ecqrwn
en tw qliyai umaV sitodeia artwn kai peyousin deka gunaikeV touV artouV umwn en klibanw eni kai apodwsousin touV artouV umwn en staqmw kai fagesqe kai ou mh emplhsqhte
ean de epi toutoiV mh upakoushte mou kai poreuhsqe proV me plagioi
kai autoV poreusomai meq' umwn en qumw plagiw kai paideusw umaV egw eptakiV kata taV amartiaV umwn
kai fagesqe taV sarkaV twn uiwn umwn kai taV sarkaV twn qugaterwn umwn fagesqe
kai erhmwsw taV sthlaV umwn kai exoleqreusw ta xulina ceiropoihta umwn kai qhsw ta kwla umwn epi ta kwla twn eidwlwn umwn kai prosocqiei h yuch mou umin
kai qhsw taV poleiV umwn erhmouV kai exerhmwsw ta agia umwn kai ou mh osfranqw thV osmhV twn qusiwn umwn
kai exerhmwsw egw thn ghn umwn kai qaumasontai ep' auth oi ecqroi umwn oi enoikounteV en auth

tote eudokhsei h gh ta sabbata authV kai pasaV taV hmeraV thV erhmwsewV authV kai umeiV esesqe en th gh twn ecqrwn umwn tote sabbatiei h gh kai eudokhsei ta sabbata authV
pasaV taV hmeraV thV erhmwsewV authV sabbatiei a ouk esabbatisen en toiV sabbatoiV umwn hnika katwkeite authn

kai toiV kataleifqeisin ex umwn epaxw deilian eiV thn kardian autwn en th gh twn ecqrwn autwn kai diwxetai autouV fwnh fullou feromenou kai feuxontai wV feugonteV apo polemou kai pesountai ouqenoV diwkontoV
kai uperoyetai o adelfoV ton adelfon wsei en polemw ouqenoV katatrecontoV kai ou dunhsesqe antisthnai toiV ecqroiV umwn
kai apoleisqe en toiV eqnesin kai katedetai umaV h gh twn ecqrwn umwn
kai oi kataleifqenteV af' umwn katafqarhsontai dia taV amartiaV umwn en th gh twn ecqrwn autwn takhsontai
kai exagoreusousin taV amartiaV autwn kai taV amartiaV twn paterwn autwn oti parebhsan kai upereidon me kai oti eporeuqhsan enantion mou plagioi
kai egw eporeuqhn met' autwn en qumw plagiw kai apolw autouV en th gh twn ecqrwn autwn tote entraphsetai h kardia autwn h aperitmhtoV kai tote eudokhsousin taV amartiaV autwn
kai mnhsqhsomai thV diaqhkhV iakwb kai thV diaqhkhV isaak kai thV diaqhkhV abraam mnhsqhsomai kai thV ghV mnhsqhsomai

kai h gh egkataleifqhsetai up' autwn tote prosdexetai h gh ta sabbata authV en tw erhmwqhnai authn di' autouV kai autoi prosdexontai taV autwn anomiaV anq' wn ta krimata mou upereidon kai toiV prostagmasin mou proswcqisan th yuch autwn
kai oud' wV ontwn autwn en th gh twn ecqrwn autwn ouc upereidon autouV oude proswcqisa autoiV wste exanalwsai autouV tou diaskedasai thn diaqhkhn mou thn proV autouV oti egw eimi kurioV o qeoV autwn
kai mnhsqhsomai autwn thV diaqhkhV thV proteraV ote exhgagon autouV ek ghV aiguptou ex oikou douleiaV enanti twn eqnwn tou einai autwn qeoV egw eimi kurioV
tauta ta krimata kai ta prostagmata kai o nomoV on edwken kurioV ana meson autou kai ana meson twn uiwn israhl en tw orei sina en ceiri mwush
kai elalhsen kurioV proV mwushn legwn
lalhson toiV uioiV israhl kai ereiV autoiV oV an euxhtai euchn wste timhn thV yuchV autou tw kuriw
estai h timh tou arsenoV apo eikosaetouV ewV exhkontaetouV estai autou h timh penthkonta didracma arguriou tw staqmw tw agiw
thV de qhleiaV estai h suntimhsiV triakonta didracma
ean de apo pentaetouV ewV eikosi etwn estai h timh tou arsenoV eikosi didracma thV de qhleiaV deka didracma
apo de mhniaiou ewV pentaetouV estai h timh tou arsenoV pente didracma arguriou thV de qhleiaV tria didracma
ean de apo exhkontaetwn kai epanw ean men arsen h estai h timh pentekaideka didracma arguriou ean de qhleia deka didracma
ean de tapeinoV h th timh sthsetai enantion tou ierewV kai timhsetai auton o iereuV kaqaper iscuei h ceir tou euxamenou timhsetai auton o iereuV
ean de apo twn kthnwn twn prosferomenwn ap' autwn dwron tw kuriw oV an dw apo toutwn tw kuriw estai agion
ouk allaxei auto kalon ponhrw oude ponhron kalw ean de allasswn allaxh auto kthnoV kthnei estai auto kai to allagma agia
ean de pan kthnoV akaqarton af' wn ou prosferetai ap' autwn dwron tw kuriw sthsei to kthnoV enanti tou ierewV
kai timhsetai auto o iereuV ana meson kalou kai ana meson ponhrou kai kaqoti an timhsetai o iereuV outwV sthsetai
ean de lutroumenoV lutrwshtai auto prosqhsei to epipempton proV thn timhn autou
kai anqrwpoV oV an agiash thn oikian autou agian tw kuriw kai timhsetai authn o iereuV ana meson kalhV kai ana meson ponhraV wV an timhsetai authn o iereuV outwV staqhsetai
ean de o agiasaV authn lutrwtai thn oikian autou prosqhsei ep' auto to epipempton tou arguriou thV timhV kai estai autw
ean de apo tou agrou thV katascesewV autou agiash anqrwpoV tw kuriw kai estai h timh kata ton sporon autou korou kriqwn penthkonta didracma arguriou
ean de apo tou eniautou thV afesewV agiash ton agron autou kata thn timhn autou sthsetai
ean de escaton meta thn afesin agiash ton agron autou proslogieitai autw o iereuV to argurion epi ta eth ta epiloipa ewV eiV ton eniauton thV afesewV kai anqufaireqhsetai apo thV suntimhsewV autou

kai anesth mwushV kai eporeuqh proV daqan kai abirwn kai suneporeuqhsan met' autou panteV oi presbuteroi israhl

kai apesthsan apo thV skhnhV kore kuklw kai daqan kai abirwn exhlqon kai eisthkeisan para taV quraV twn skhnwn autwn kai ai gunaikeV autwn kai ta tekna autwn kai h aposkeuh autwn
kai eipen mwushV en toutw gnwsesqe oti kurioV apesteilen me poihsai panta ta erga tauta oti ouk ap' emautou
ei kata qanaton pantwn anqrwpwn apoqanountai outoi ei kai kat' episkeyin pantwn anqrwpwn episkoph estai autwn ouci kurioV apestalken me

all' h en fasmati deixei kurioV kai anoixasa h gh to stoma authV katapietai autouV kai touV oikouV autwn kai taV skhnaV autwn kai panta osa estin autoiV kai katabhsontai zwnteV eiV adou kai gnwsesqe oti parwxunan oi anqrwpoi outoi ton kurion
wV de epausato lalwn pantaV touV logouV toutouV erragh h gh upokatw autwn
kai hnoicqh h gh kai katepien autouV kai touV oikouV autwn kai pantaV touV anqrwpouV touV ontaV meta kore kai ta kthnh autwn
kai katebhsan autoi kai osa estin autwn zwnta eiV adou kai ekaluyen autouV h gh kai apwlonto ek mesou thV sunagwghV
kai paV israhl oi kuklw autwn efugon apo thV fwnhV autwn oti legonteV mhpote katapih hmaV h gh

ta pureia twn amartwlwn toutwn en taiV yucaiV autwn kai poihson auta lepidaV elataV periqema tw qusiasthriw oti proshnecqhsan enanti kuriou kai hgiasqhsan kai egenonto eiV shmeion toiV uioiV israhl

kai egoggusan oi uioi israhl th epaurion epi mwushn kai aarwn legonteV umeiV apektagkate ton laon kuriou
kai egeneto en tw episustrefesqai thn sunagwghn epi mwushn kai aarwn kai wrmhsan epi thn skhnhn tou marturiou kai thnde ekaluyen authn h nefelh kai wfqh h doxa kuriou
kai eishlqen mwushV kai aarwn kata proswpon thV skhnhV tou marturiou

kai elaben aarwn kaqaper elalhsen autw mwushV kai edramen eiV thn sunagwghn kai hdh enhrkto h qrausiV en tw law kai epebalen to qumiama kai exilasato peri tou laou
kai esth ana meson twn teqnhkotwn kai twn zwntwn kai ekopasen h qrausiV
kai egenonto oi teqnhkoteV en th qrausei tessareV kai deka ciliadeV kai eptakosioi cwriV twn teqnhkotwn eneken kore
kai epestreyen aarwn proV mwushn epi thn quran thV skhnhV tou marturiou kai ekopasen h qrausiV

lalhson toiV uioiV israhl kai labe par' autwn rabdon rabdon kat' oikouV patriwn para pantwn twn arcontwn autwn kat' oikouV patriwn autwn dwdeka rabdouV kai ekastou to onoma autou epigrayon epi thV rabdou autou

kai qhseiV autaV en th skhnh tou marturiou katenanti tou marturiou en oiV gnwsqhsomai soi ekei
kai estai o anqrwpoV on ean eklexwmai auton h rabdoV autou ekblasthsei kai perielw ap' emou ton goggusmon twn uiwn israhl a autoi gogguzousin ef' umin

kai elalhsen mwushV toiV uioiV israhl kai edwkan autw panteV oi arconteV autwn rabdon tw arconti tw eni rabdon kata arconta kat' oikouV patriwn autwn dwdeka rabdouV kai h rabdoV aarwn ana meson twn rabdwn autwn
kai apeqhken mwushV taV rabdouV enanti kuriou en th skhnh tou marturiou
kai egeneto th epaurion kai eishlqen mwushV kai aarwn eiV thn skhnhn tou marturiou kai idou eblasthsen h rabdoV aarwn eiV oikon leui kai exhnegken blaston kai exhnqhsen anqh kai eblasthsen karua
kai exhnegken mwushV pasaV taV rabdouV apo proswpou kuriou proV pantaV uiouV israhl kai eidon kai elabon ekastoV thn rabdon autou

en tw agiw twn agiwn fagesqe auta pan arsenikon fagetai auta su kai oi uioi sou agia estai soi

kai touto estai umin aparch domatwn autwn apo pantwn twn epiqematwn twn uiwn israhl soi dedwka auta kai toiV uioiV sou kai taiV qugatrasin sou meta sou nomimon aiwnion paV kaqaroV en tw oikw sou edetai auta
pasa aparch elaiou kai pasa aparch oinou kai sitou aparch autwn osa an dwsi tw kuriw soi dedwka auta

plhn prwtotoka moscwn kai prwtotoka probatwn kai prwtotoka aigwn ou lutrwsh agia estin kai to aima autwn prosceeiV proV to qusiasthrion kai to stear anoiseiV karpwma eiV osmhn euwdiaV kuriw
kai ta krea estai soi kaqa kai to sthqunion tou epiqematoV kai kata ton braciona ton dexion soi estai

outwV afeleite kai umeiV apo twn afairematwn kuriou apo pantwn epidekatwn umwn osa ean labhte para twn uiwn israhl kai dwsete ap' autwn afairema kuriw aarwn tw ierei
apo pantwn twn domatwn umwn afeleite afairema kuriw h apo pantwn twn aparcwn to hgiasmenon ap' autou

kai apesteilen mwushV aggelouV ek kadhV proV basilea edwm legwn tade legei o adelfoV sou israhl su episth panta ton mocqon ton euronta hmaV
kai katebhsan oi patereV hmwn eiV aigupton kai parwkhsamen en aiguptw hmeraV pleiouV kai ekakwsan hmaV oi aiguptioi kai touV pateraV hmwn
kai anebohsamen proV kurion kai eishkousen kurioV thV fwnhV hmwn kai aposteilaV aggelon exhgagen hmaV ex aiguptou kai nun esmen en kadhV polei ek merouV twn oriwn sou
pareleusomeqa dia thV ghV sou ou dieleusomeqa di' agrwn oude di' ampelwnwn oude piomeqa udwr ek lakkou sou odw basilikh poreusomeqa ouk ekklinoumen dexia oude euwnuma ewV an parelqwmen ta oria sou
kai eipen proV auton edwm ou dieleush di' emou ei de mh en polemw exeleusomai eiV sunanthsin soi
kai legousin autw oi uioi israhl para to oroV pareleusomeqa ean de tou udatoV sou piwmen egw te kai ta kthnh dwsw timhn soi alla to pragma ouden estin para to oroV pareleusomeqa
o de eipen ou dieleush di' emou kai exhlqen edwm eiV sunanthsin autw en oclw barei kai en ceiri iscura
kai ouk hqelhsen edwm dounai tw israhl parelqein dia twn oriwn autou kai exeklinen israhl ap' autou

kai hkousen o cananiV basileuV arad o katoikwn kata thn erhmon hlqen gar israhl odon aqarin kai epolemhsen proV israhl kai katepronomeusan ex autwn aicmalwsian

kai eishkousen kurioV thV fwnhV israhl kai paredwken ton cananin upoceirion autou kai aneqematisen auton kai taV poleiV autou kai epekalesan to onoma tou topou ekeinou anaqema
kai aparanteV ex wr tou orouV odon epi qalassan eruqran periekuklwsan ghn edwm kai wligoyuchsen o laoV en th odw

all' outwV poihsete autoiV touV bwmouV autwn kaqeleite kai taV sthlaV autwn suntriyete kai ta alsh autwn ekkoyete kai ta glupta twn qewn autwn katakausete puri
oti laoV agioV ei kuriw tw qew sou kai se proeilato kurioV o qeoV sou einai se autw laon periousion para panta ta eqnh osa epi proswpou thV ghV
ouc oti poluplhqeite para panta ta eqnh proeilato kurioV umaV kai exelexato umaV umeiV gar este oligostoi para panta ta eqnh

alla para to agapan kurion umaV kai diathrwn ton orkon on wmosen toiV patrasin umwn exhgagen kurioV umaV en ceiri krataia kai en bracioni uyhlw kai elutrwsato ex oikou douleiaV ek ceiroV faraw basilewV aiguptou
kai gnwsh oti kurioV o qeoV sou outoV qeoV qeoV pistoV o fulasswn diaqhkhn kai eleoV toiV agapwsin auton kai toiV fulassousin taV entolaV autou eiV ciliaV geneaV
kai apodidouV toiV misousin kata proswpon exoleqreusai autouV kai ouci bradunei toiV misousin kata proswpon apodwsei autoiV
kai fulaxh taV entolaV kai ta dikaiwmata kai ta krimata tauta osa egw entellomai soi shmeron poiein
kai estai hnika an akoushte panta ta dikaiwmata tauta kai fulaxhte kai poihshte auta kai diafulaxei kurioV o qeoV sou soi thn diaqhkhn kai to eleoV o wmosen toiV patrasin umwn

kai agaphsei se kai euloghsei se kai plhqunei se kai euloghsei ta ekgona thV koiliaV sou kai ton karpon thV ghV sou ton siton sou kai ton oinon sou kai to elaion sou ta boukolia twn bown sou kai ta poimnia twn probatwn sou epi thV ghV hV wmosen kurioV toiV patrasin sou dounai soi
euloghtoV esh para panta ta eqnh ouk estai en umin agonoV oude steira kai en toiV kthnesin sou
kai perielei kurioV apo sou pasan malakian kai pasaV nosouV aiguptou taV ponhraV aV ewrakaV kai osa egnwV ouk epiqhsei epi se kai epiqhsei auta epi pantaV touV misountaV se
kai fagh panta ta skula twn eqnwn a kurioV o qeoV sou didwsin soi ou feisetai o ofqalmoV sou ep' autoiV kai ou latreuseiV toiV qeoiV autwn oti skwlon touto estin soi
ean de leghV en th dianoia sou oti polu to eqnoV touto h egw pwV dunhsomai exoleqreusai autouV
ou fobhqhsh autouV mneia mnhsqhsh osa epoihsen kurioV o qeoV sou tw faraw kai pasi toiV aiguptioiV

touV peirasmouV touV megalouV ouV eidosan oi ofqalmoi sou ta shmeia kai ta terata ta megala ekeina thn ceira thn krataian kai ton braciona ton uyhlon wV exhgagen se kurioV o qeoV sou outwV poihsei kurioV o qeoV hmwn pasin toiV eqnesin ouV su fobh apo proswpou autwn
kai taV sfhkiaV apostelei kurioV o qeoV sou eiV autouV ewV an ektribwsin oi kataleleimmenoi kai oi kekrummenoi apo sou
ou trwqhsh apo proswpou autwn oti kurioV o qeoV sou en soi qeoV megaV kai krataioV
kai katanalwsei kurioV o qeoV sou ta eqnh tauta apo proswpou sou kata mikron mikron ou dunhsh exanalwsai autouV to tacoV ina mh genhtai h gh erhmoV kai plhqunqh epi se ta qhria ta agria
kai paradwsei autouV kurioV o qeoV sou eiV taV ceiraV sou kai apolesei autouV apwleia megalh ewV an exoleqreush autouV
kai paradwsei touV basileiV autwn eiV taV ceiraV umwn kai apoleitai to onoma autwn ek tou topou ekeinou ouk antisthsetai oudeiV kata proswpon sou ewV an exoleqreushV autouV
ta glupta twn qewn autwn katakausete puri ouk epiqumhseiV argurion oude crusion ap' autwn kai ou lhmyh seautw mh ptaishV di' auto oti bdelugma kuriw tw qew sou estin
kai ouk eisoiseiV bdelugma eiV ton oikon sou kai esh anaqhma wsper touto prosocqismati prosocqieiV kai bdelugmati bdeluxh oti anaqhma estin
pasaV taV entolaV aV egw entellomai umin shmeron fulaxesqe poiein ina zhte kai poluplasiasqhte kai eiselqhte kai klhronomhshte thn ghn hn kurioV o qeoV umwn wmosen toiV patrasin umwn
kai mnhsqhsh pasan thn odon hn hgagen se kurioV o qeoV sou en th erhmw opwV an kakwsh se kai ekpeirash se kai diagnwsqh ta en th kardia sou ei fulaxh taV entolaV autou h ou

kai ekakwsen se kai elimagconhsen se kai eywmisen se to manna o ouk eidhsan oi patereV sou ina anaggeilh soi oti ouk ep' artw monw zhsetai o anqrwpoV all' epi panti rhmati tw ekporeuomenw dia stomatoV qeou zhsetai o anqrwpoV
ta imatia sou ou katetribh apo sou oi podeV sou ouk etulwqhsan idou tessarakonta eth
kai gnwsh th kardia sou oti wV ei tiV paideusai anqrwpoV ton uion autou outwV kurioV o qeoV sou paideusei se
kai fulaxh taV entolaV kuriou tou qeou sou poreuesqai en taiV odoiV autou kai fobeisqai auton
o gar kurioV o qeoV sou eisagei se eiV ghn agaqhn kai pollhn ou ceimarroi udatwn kai phgai abusswn ekporeuomenai dia twn pediwn kai dia twn orewn
gh purou kai kriqhV ampeloi sukai roai gh elaiaV elaiou kai melitoV
gh ef' hV ou meta ptwceiaV fagh ton arton sou kai ouk endehqhsh ouden ep' authV gh hV oi liqoi sidhroV kai ek twn orewn authV metalleuseiV calkon
kai fagh kai emplhsqhsh kai euloghseiV kurion ton qeon sou epi thV ghV thV agaqhV hV edwken soi
prosece seautw mh epilaqh kuriou tou qeou sou tou mh fulaxai taV entolaV autou kai ta krimata kai ta dikaiwmata autou osa egw entellomai soi shmeron
mh fagwn kai emplhsqeiV kai oikiaV kalaV oikodomhsaV kai katoikhsaV en autaiV
kai twn bown sou kai twn probatwn sou plhqunqentwn soi arguriou kai crusiou plhqunqentoV soi kai pantwn oswn soi estai plhqunqentwn soi
uywqhV th kardia kai epilaqh kuriou tou qeou sou tou exagagontoV se ek ghV aiguptou ex oikou douleiaV
tou agagontoV se dia thV erhmou thV megalhV kai thV foberaV ekeinhV ou ofiV daknwn kai skorpioV kai diya ou ouk hn udwr tou exagagontoV soi ek petraV akrotomou phghn udatoV
tou ywmisantoV se to manna en th erhmw o ouk eidhsan oi patereV sou ina kakwsh se kai ekpeirash se kai eu se poihsh ep' escatwn twn hmerwn sou
mh eiphV en th kardia sou h iscuV mou kai to kratoV thV ceiroV mou epoihsen moi thn dunamin thn megalhn tauthn
kai mnhsqhsh kuriou tou qeou sou oti autoV soi didwsin iscun tou poihsai dunamin kai ina sthsh thn diaqhkhn autou hn wmosen kurioV toiV patrasin sou wV shmeron
kai estai ean lhqh epilaqh kuriou tou qeou sou kai poreuqhV opisw qewn eterwn kai latreushV autoiV kai proskunhshV autoiV diamarturomai umin shmeron ton te ouranon kai thn ghn oti apwleia apoleisqe
kaqa kai ta loipa eqnh osa kurioV apolluei pro proswpou umwn outwV apoleisqe anq' wn ouk hkousate thV fwnhV kuriou tou qeou umwn
akoue israhl su diabaineiV shmeron ton iordanhn eiselqein klhronomhsai eqnh megala kai iscurotera mallon h umeiV poleiV megalaV kai teichreiV ewV tou ouranou
laon megan kai polun kai eumhkh uiouV enak ouV su oisqa kai su akhkoaV tiV antisthsetai kata proswpon uiwn enak

kai gnwsh shmeron oti kurioV o qeoV sou outoV proporeuetai pro proswpou sou pur katanaliskon estin outoV exoleqreusei autouV kai outoV apostreyei autouV apo proswpou sou kai apoleiV autouV kaqaper eipen soi kurioV

mh eiphV en th kardia sou en tw exanalwsai kurion ton qeon sou ta eqnh tauta apo proswpou sou legwn dia taV dikaiosunaV mou eishgagen me kurioV klhronomhsai thn ghn thn agaqhn tauthn alla dia thn asebeian twn eqnwn toutwn kurioV exoleqreusei autouV pro proswpou sou

ouci dia thn dikaiosunhn sou oude dia thn osiothta thV kardiaV sou su eisporeuh klhronomhsai thn ghn autwn alla dia thn asebeian twn eqnwn toutwn kurioV exoleqreusei autouV apo proswpou sou kai ina sthsh thn diaqhkhn autou hn wmosen toiV patrasin umwn tw abraam kai tw isaak kai tw iakwb
kai gnwsh shmeron oti ouci dia taV dikaiosunaV sou kurioV o qeoV sou didwsin soi thn ghn thn agaqhn tauthn klhronomhsai oti laoV sklhrotrachloV ei
mnhsqhti mh epilaqh osa parwxunaV kurion ton qeon sou en th erhmw af' hV hmeraV exhlqete ex aiguptou ewV hlqete eiV ton topon touton apeiqounteV dieteleite ta proV kurion
kai en cwrhb parwxunate kurion kai equmwqh kurioV ef' umin exoleqreusai umaV

anabainontoV mou eiV to oroV labein taV plakaV taV liqinaV plakaV diaqhkhV aV dieqeto kurioV proV umaV kai kateginomhn en tw orei tessarakonta hmeraV kai tessarakonta nuktaV arton ouk efagon kai udwr ouk epion
kai edwken kurioV emoi taV duo plakaV taV liqinaV gegrammenaV en tw daktulw tou qeou kai ep' autaiV egegrapto panteV oi logoi ouV elalhsen kurioV proV umaV en tw orei hmera ekklhsiaV
kai egeneto dia tessarakonta hmerwn kai tessarakonta nuktwn edwken kurioV emoi taV duo plakaV taV liqinaV plakaV diaqhkhV
kai eipen kurioV proV me anasthqi katabhqi to tacoV enteuqen oti hnomhsen o laoV sou ouV exhgageV ek ghV aiguptou parebhsan tacu ek thV odou hV eneteilw autoiV epoihsan eautoiV cwneuma
kai eipen kurioV proV me lelalhka proV se apax kai diV legwn ewraka ton laon touton kai idou laoV sklhrotrachloV estin
eason me exoleqreusai autouV kai exaleiyw to onoma autwn upokatwqen tou ouranou kai poihsw se eiV eqnoV mega kai iscuron kai polu mallon h touto
kai epistreyaV katebhn ek tou orouV kai to oroV ekaieto puri kai ai duo plakeV epi taiV dusi cersin mou
kai idwn oti hmartete enantion kuriou tou qeou umwn kai epoihsate umin eautoiV cwneuton kai parebhte apo thV odou hV eneteilato umin kurioV
kai epilabomenoV twn duo plakwn erriya autaV apo twn duo ceirwn mou kai sunetriya enantion umwn

kai edehqhn enantion kuriou deuteron kaqaper kai to proteron tessarakonta hmeraV kai tessarakonta nuktaV arton ouk efagon kai udwr ouk epion peri paswn twn amartiwn umwn wn hmartete poihsai to ponhron enantion kuriou tou qeou umwn paroxunai auton
kai ekfoboV eimi dia thn orghn kai ton qumon oti parwxunqh kurioV ef' umin exoleqreusai umaV kai eishkousen kurioV emou kai en tw kairw toutw
kai epi aarwn equmwqh kurioV sfodra exoleqreusai auton kai huxamhn kai peri aarwn en tw kairw ekeinw

kai thn amartian umwn hn epoihsate ton moscon elabon auton kai katekausa auton en puri kai sunekoya auton katalesaV sfodra ewV ou egeneto lepton kai egenhqh wsei koniortoV kai erriya ton koniorton eiV ton ceimarroun ton katabainonta ek tou orouV
kai en tw empurismw kai en tw peirasmw kai en toiV mnhmasin thV epiqumiaV paroxunonteV hte kurion ton qeon umwn

kai ote exapesteilen kurioV umaV ek kadhV barnh legwn anabhte kai klhronomhsate thn ghn hn didwmi umin kai hpeiqhsate tw rhmati kuriou tou qeou umwn kai ouk episteusate autw kai ouk eishkousate thV fwnhV autou
apeiqounteV hte ta proV kurion apo thV hmeraV hV egnwsqh umin
kai edehqhn enantion kuriou tessarakonta hmeraV kai tessarakonta nuktaV osaV edehqhn eipen gar kurioV exoleqreusai umaV

kai euxamhn proV ton qeon kai eipa kurie kurie basileu twn qewn mh exoleqreushV ton laon sou kai thn merida sou hn elutrwsw en th iscui sou th megalh ouV exhgageV ek ghV aiguptou en th iscui sou th megalh kai en th ceiri sou th krataia kai en tw bracioni sou tw uyhlw
mnhsqhti abraam kai isaak kai iakwb twn qerapontwn sou oiV wmosaV kata seautou mh epibleyhV epi thn sklhrothta tou laou toutou kai ta asebhmata kai ta amarthmata autwn

mh eipwsin oi katoikounteV thn ghn oqen exhgageV hmaV ekeiqen legonteV para to mh dunasqai kurion eisagagein autouV eiV thn ghn hn eipen autoiV kai para to mishsai autouV exhgagen autouV apokteinai en th erhmw
kai outoi laoV sou kai klhroV sou ouV exhgageV ek ghV aiguptou en th iscui sou th megalh kai en tw bracioni sou tw uyhlw
en ekeinw tw kairw eipen kurioV proV me laxeuson seautw duo plakaV liqinaV wsper taV prwtaV kai anabhqi proV me eiV to oroV kai poihseiV seautw kibwton xulinhn
kai grayw epi taV plakaV ta rhmata a hn en taiV plaxin taiV prwtaiV aV sunetriyaV kai embaleiV autaV eiV thn kibwton
kai epoihsa kibwton ek xulwn ashptwn kai elaxeusa taV duo plakaV taV liqinaV wV ai prwtai kai anebhn eiV to oroV kai ai duo plakeV epi taiV cersin mou
kai egrayen epi taV plakaV kata thn grafhn thn prwthn touV deka logouV ouV elalhsen kurioV proV umaV en tw orei ek mesou tou puroV kai edwken autaV kurioV emoi
kai epistreyaV katebhn ek tou orouV kai enebalon taV plakaV eiV thn kibwton hn epoihsa kai hsan ekei kaqa eneteilato moi kurioV
kai oi uioi israhl aphran ek bhrwq uiwn iakim misadai ekei apeqanen aarwn kai etafh ekei kai ierateusen eleazar uioV autou ant' autou
ekeiqen aphran eiV gadgad kai apo gadgad eiV etebaqa gh ceimarroi udatwn
en ekeinw tw kairw diesteilen kurioV thn fulhn thn leui airein thn kibwton thV diaqhkhV kuriou parestanai enanti kuriou leitourgein kai epeucesqai epi tw onomati autou ewV thV hmeraV tauthV
dia touto ouk estin toiV leuitaiV meriV kai klhroV en toiV adelfoiV autwn kurioV autoV klhroV autou kaqa eipen autw
kagw eisthkein en tw orei tessarakonta hmeraV kai tessarakonta nuktaV kai eishkousen kurioV emou kai en tw kairw toutw kai ouk hqelhsen kurioV exoleqreusai umaV
kai eipen kurioV proV me badize aparon enantion tou laou toutou kai eisporeuesqwsan kai klhronomeitwsan thn ghn hn wmosa toiV patrasin autwn dounai autoiV

kai nun israhl ti kurioV o qeoV sou aiteitai para sou all' h fobeisqai kurion ton qeon sou poreuesqai en pasaiV taiV odoiV autou kai agapan auton kai latreuein kuriw tw qew sou ex olhV thV kardiaV sou kai ex olhV thV yuchV sou
fulassesqai taV entolaV kuriou tou qeou sou kai ta dikaiwmata autou osa egw entellomai soi shmeron ina eu soi h
idou kuriou tou qeou sou o ouranoV kai o ouranoV tou ouranou h gh kai panta osa estin en auth
plhn touV pateraV umwn proeilato kurioV agapan autouV kai exelexato to sperma autwn met' autouV umaV para panta ta eqnh kata thn hmeran tauthn
kai peritemeisqe thn sklhrokardian umwn kai ton trachlon umwn ou sklhruneite eti
o gar kurioV o qeoV umwn outoV qeoV twn qewn kai kurioV twn kuriwn o qeoV o megaV kai iscuroV kai o foberoV ostiV ou qaumazei proswpon oud' ou mh labh dwron
poiwn krisin proshlutw kai orfanw kai chra kai agapa ton proshluton dounai autw arton kai imation
kai agaphsete ton proshluton proshlutoi gar hte en gh aiguptw
kurion ton qeon sou fobhqhsh kai autw latreuseiV kai proV auton kollhqhsh kai tw onomati autou omh
outoV kauchma sou kai outoV qeoV sou ostiV epoihsen en soi ta megala kai ta endoxa tauta a eidosan oi ofqalmoi sou
en ebdomhkonta yucaiV katebhsan oi patereV sou eiV aigupton nuni de epoihsen se kurioV o qeoV sou wsei ta astra tou ouranou tw plhqei
kai agaphseiV kurion ton qeon sou kai fulaxh ta fulagmata autou kai ta dikaiwmata autou kai taV kriseiV autou pasaV taV hmeraV
kai gnwsesqe shmeron oti ouci ta paidia umwn osoi ouk oidasin oude eidosan thn paideian kuriou tou qeou sou kai ta megaleia autou kai thn ceira thn krataian kai ton braciona ton uyhlon
kai ta shmeia autou kai ta terata autou osa epoihsen en mesw aiguptou faraw basilei aiguptou kai pash th gh autou

kai osa epoihsen thn dunamin twn aiguptiwn ta armata autwn kai thn ippon autwn wV epeklusen to udwr thV qalasshV thV eruqraV epi proswpou autwn katadiwkontwn autwn ek twn opisw umwn kai apwlesen autouV kurioV ewV thV shmeron hmeraV
kai osa epoihsen umin en th erhmw ewV hlqete eiV ton topon touton

kai osa epoihsen tw daqan kai abirwn uioiV eliab uiou roubhn ouV anoixasa h gh to stoma authV katepien autouV kai touV oikouV autwn kai taV skhnaV autwn kai pasan autwn thn upostasin thn met' autwn en mesw pantoV israhl
oti oi ofqalmoi umwn ewrakan panta ta erga kuriou ta megala osa epoihsen umin shmeron
kai fulaxesqe pasaV taV entolaV autou osaV egw entellomai soi shmeron ina zhte kai poluplasiasqhte kai eiselqonteV klhronomhshte thn ghn eiV hn umeiV diabainete ton iordanhn ekei klhronomhsai authn
ina makrohmereushte epi thV ghV hV wmosen kurioV toiV patrasin umwn dounai autoiV kai tw spermati autwn met' autouV ghn reousan gala kai meli
estin gar h gh eiV hn eisporeuh ekei klhronomhsai authn ouc wsper h gh aiguptou estin oqen ekpeporeusqe ekeiqen otan speirwsin ton sporon kai potizwsin toiV posin wsei khpon lacaneiaV
h de gh eiV hn eisporeuh ekei klhronomhsai authn gh oreinh kai pedinh ek tou uetou tou ouranou pietai udwr
gh hn kurioV o qeoV sou episkopeitai authn dia pantoV oi ofqalmoi kuriou tou qeou sou ep' authV ap' archV tou eniautou kai ewV sunteleiaV tou eniautou
ean de akoh eisakoushte pasaV taV entolaV autou osaV egw entellomai soi shmeron agapan kurion ton qeon sou kai latreuein autw ex olhV thV kardiaV sou kai ex olhV thV yuchV sou
kai dwsei ton ueton th gh sou kaq' wran proimon kai oyimon kai eisoiseiV ton siton sou kai ton oinon sou kai to elaion sou
kai dwsei cortasmata en toiV agroiV sou toiV kthnesin sou kai fagwn kai emplhsqeiV
prosece seautw mh platunqh h kardia sou kai parabhte kai latreushte qeoiV eteroiV kai proskunhshte autoiV
kai qumwqeiV orgh kurioV ef' umin kai susch ton ouranon kai ouk estai uetoV kai h gh ou dwsei ton karpon authV kai apoleisqe en tacei apo thV ghV thV agaqhV hV edwken o kurioV umin
kai embaleite ta rhmata tauta eiV thn kardian umwn kai eiV thn yuchn umwn kai afayete auta eiV shmeion epi thV ceiroV umwn kai estai asaleuton pro ofqalmwn umwn
kai didaxete auta ta tekna umwn lalein auta kaqhmenouV en oikw kai poreuomenouV en odw kai koitazomenouV kai dianistamenouV
kai grayete auta epi taV fliaV twn oikiwn umwn kai twn pulwn umwn
ina poluhmereushte kai ai hmerai twn uiwn umwn epi thV ghV hV wmosen kurioV toiV patrasin umwn dounai autoiV kaqwV ai hmerai tou ouranou epi thV ghV
kai estai ean akoh akoushte pasaV taV entolaV tautaV osaV egw entellomai soi shmeron poiein agapan kurion ton qeon hmwn kai poreuesqai en pasaiV taiV odoiV autou kai proskollasqai autw
kai ekbalei kurioV panta ta eqnh tauta apo proswpou umwn kai klhronomhsete eqnh megala kai iscurotera mallon h umeiV
panta ton topon ou ean pathsh to icnoV tou podoV umwn umin estai apo thV erhmou kai antilibanou kai apo tou potamou tou megalou potamou eufratou kai ewV thV qalasshV thV epi dusmwn estai ta oria sou
ouk antisthsetai oudeiV kata proswpon umwn ton tromon umwn kai ton fobon umwn epiqhsei kurioV o qeoV umwn epi proswpon pashV thV ghV ef' hV ean epibhte ep' authV on tropon elalhsen kurioV proV umaV
idou egw didwmi enwpion umwn shmeron eulogian kai kataran
thn eulogian ean akoushte taV entolaV kuriou tou qeou umwn aV egw entellomai umin shmeron
kai taV kataraV ean mh akoushte taV entolaV kuriou tou qeou umwn osaV egw entellomai umin shmeron kai planhqhte apo thV odou hV eneteilamhn umin poreuqenteV latreuein qeoiV eteroiV ouV ouk oidate
kai estai otan eisagagh se kurioV o qeoV sou eiV thn ghn eiV hn diabaineiV ekei klhronomhsai authn kai dwseiV thn eulogian ep' oroV garizin kai thn kataran ep' oroV gaibal
ouk idou tauta peran tou iordanou opisw odon dusmwn hliou en gh canaan to katoikoun epi dusmwn ecomenon tou golgol plhsion thV druoV thV uyhlhV
umeiV gar diabainete ton iordanhn eiselqonteV klhronomhsai thn ghn hn kurioV o qeoV umwn didwsin umin en klhrw pasaV taV hmeraV kai klhronomhsete authn kai katoikhsete en auth
kai fulaxesqe tou poiein panta ta prostagmata autou kai taV kriseiV tautaV osaV egw didwmi enwpion umwn shmeron

all' h eiV ton topon on an eklexhtai kurioV o qeoV umwn en mia twn fulwn umwn eponomasai to onoma autou ekei epiklhqhnai kai ekzhthsete kai eiseleusesqe ekei

kai diabhsesqe ton iordanhn kai katoikhsete epi thV ghV hV kurioV o qeoV umwn kataklhronomei umin kai katapausei umaV apo pantwn twn ecqrwn umwn twn kuklw kai katoikhsete meta asfaleiaV

prosece seautw mh anenegkhV ta olokautwmata sou en panti topw ou ean idhV
all' h eiV ton topon on an eklexhtai kurioV o qeoV sou auton en mia twn fulwn sou ekei anoiseiV ta olokautwmata sou kai ekei poihseiV panta osa egw entellomai soi shmeron
all' h en pash epiqumia sou quseiV kai fagh krea kata thn eulogian kuriou tou qeou sou hn edwken soi en pash polei o akaqartoV en soi kai o kaqaroV epi to auto fagetai auto wV dorkada h elafon
plhn to aima ou fagesqe epi thn ghn ekceeite auto wV udwr

ean de emplatunh kurioV o qeoV sou ta oria sou kaqaper elalhsen soi kai ereiV fagomai krea ean epiqumhsh h yuch sou wste fagein krea en pash epiqumia thV yuchV sou fagh krea

wV esqetai h dorkaV kai h elafoV outwV fagh auto o akaqartoV en soi kai o kaqaroV wsautwV edetai
prosece iscurwV tou mh fagein aima oti to aima autou yuch ou brwqhsetai h yuch meta twn krewn

ou fagh auto ina eu soi genhtai kai toiV uioiV sou meta se ean poihshV to kalon kai to areston enantion kuriou tou qeou sou
plhn ta agia sou ean genhtai soi kai taV eucaV sou labwn hxeiV eiV ton topon on an eklexhtai kurioV o qeoV sou epiklhqhnai to onoma autou ekei

ean de exoleqreush kurioV o qeoV sou ta eqnh eiV ouV su eisporeuh ekei klhronomhsai thn ghn autwn apo proswpou sou kai kataklhronomhshV autouV kai katoikhshV en th gh autwn

pan rhma o egw entellomai soi shmeron touto fulaxh poiein ou prosqhseiV ep' auto oude afeleiV ap' autou

kai elqh to shmeion h to teraV o elalhsen proV se legwn poreuqwmen kai latreuswmen qeoiV eteroiV ouV ouk oidate

opisw kuriou tou qeou umwn poreuesqe kai auton fobhqhsesqe kai taV entolaV autou fulaxesqe kai thV fwnhV autou akousesqe kai autw prosteqhsesqe

ean de parakalesh se o adelfoV sou ek patroV sou h ek mhtroV sou h o uioV sou h h qugathr sou h h gunh h en kolpw sou h o filoV o isoV thV yuchV sou laqra legwn badiswmen kai latreuswmen qeoiV eteroiV ouV ouk hdeiV su kai oi patereV sou

oti kurioV o qeoV sou euloghsen se on tropon elalhsen soi kai danieiV eqnesin polloiV su de ou danih kai arxeiV su eqnwn pollwn sou de ouk arxousin
