outwV eipen kurioV badison proV sedekian basilea iouda kai ereiV autw outwV eipen kurioV paradosei paradoqhsetai h poliV auth eiV ceiraV basilewV babulwnoV kai sullhmyetai authn kai kausei authn en puri

kai su ou mh swqhV ek ceiroV autou kai sullhmyei sullhmfqhsh kai eiV ceiraV autou doqhsh kai oi ofqalmoi sou touV ofqalmouV autou oyontai kai to stoma autou meta tou stomatoV sou lalhsei kai eiV babulwna eiseleush
alla akouson ton logon kuriou sedekia basileu iouda outwV legei kurioV
en eirhnh apoqanh kai wV eklausan touV pateraV sou touV basileusantaV proteron sou klausontai kai se kai w adwn koyontai se oti logon egw elalhsa eipen kurioV
kai elalhsen ieremiaV proV ton basilea sedekian pantaV touV logouV toutouV en ierousalhm
kai h dunamiV basilewV babulwnoV epolemei epi ierousalhm kai epi taV poleiV iouda epi laciV kai epi azhka oti autai kateleifqhsan en polesin iouda poleiV ocurai
o logoV o genomenoV proV ieremian para kuriou meta to suntelesai ton basilea sedekian diaqhkhn proV ton laon tou kalesai afesin
tou exaposteilai ekaston ton paida autou kai ekaston thn paidiskhn autou ton ebraion kai thn ebraian eleuqerouV proV to mh douleuein andra ex iouda
kai epestrafhsan panteV oi megistaneV kai paV o laoV oi eiselqonteV en th diaqhkh tou aposteilai ekaston ton paida autou kai ekaston thn paidiskhn autou
kai ewsan autouV eiV paidaV kai paidiskaV
kai egenhqh logoV kuriou proV ieremian legwn
outwV eipen kurioV o qeoV israhl egw eqemhn diaqhkhn proV touV pateraV umwn en th hmera h exeilamhn autouV ek ghV aiguptou ex oikou douleiaV legwn
otan plhrwqh ex eth aposteleiV ton adelfon sou ton ebraion oV praqhsetai soi kai ergatai soi ex eth kai exaposteleiV auton eleuqeron kai ouk hkousan mou kai ouk eklinan to ouV autwn
kai epestreyan shmeron poihsai to euqeV pro ofqalmwn mou tou kalesai afesin ekaston tou plhsion autou kai sunetelesan diaqhkhn kata proswpon mou en tw oikw ou epeklhqh to onoma mou ep' autw
kai epestreyate kai ebebhlwsate to onoma mou tou epistreyai ekaston ton paida autou kai ekaston thn paidiskhn autou ouV exapesteilate eleuqerouV th yuch autwn umin eiV paidaV kai paidiskaV

dia touto outwV eipen kurioV umeiV ouk hkousate mou tou kalesai afesin ekastoV proV ton plhsion autou idou egw kalw afesin umin eiV macairan kai eiV ton qanaton kai eiV ton limon kai dwsw umaV eiV diasporan pasaiV taiV basileiaiV thV ghV
kai dwsw touV andraV touV parelhluqotaV thn diaqhkhn mou touV mh sthsantaV thn diaqhkhn mou hn epoihsan kata proswpon mou ton moscon on epoihsan ergazesqai autw
touV arcontaV iouda kai touV dunastaV kai touV iereiV kai ton laon
kai dwsw autouV toiV ecqroiV autwn kai estai ta qnhsimaia autwn brwsiV toiV peteinoiV tou ouranou kai toiV qhrioiV thV ghV
kai ton sedekian basilea thV ioudaiaV kai touV arcontaV autwn dwsw eiV ceiraV ecqrwn autwn kai dunamiV basilewV babulwnoV toiV apotrecousin ap' autwn

idou egw suntassw fhsin kurioV kai epistreyw autouV eiV thn ghn tauthn kai polemhsousin ep' authn kai lhmyontai authn kai katakausousin authn en puri kai taV poleiV iouda kai dwsw autaV erhmouV apo katoikountwn
o logoV o genomenoV proV ieremian para kuriou en hmeraiV iwakim basilewV iouda legwn
badison eiV oikon arcabin kai axeiV autouV eiV oikon kuriou eiV mian twn aulwn kai potieiV autouV oinon
kai exhgagon ton iezonian uion ieremin uiou cabasin kai touV adelfouV autou kai touV uiouV autou kai pasan thn oikian arcabin

kai eishgagon autouV eiV oikon kuriou eiV to pastoforion uiwn ananiou uiou godoliou anqrwpou tou qeou o estin egguV tou oikou twn arcontwn twn epanw tou oikou maasaiou uiou selwm tou fulassontoV thn aulhn
kai edwka kata proswpon autwn keramion oinou kai pothria kai eipa piete oinon
kai eipan ou mh piwmen oinon oti iwnadab uioV rhcab o pathr hmwn eneteilato hmin legwn ou mh pihte oinon umeiV kai oi uioi umwn ewV aiwnoV

kai oikian ou mh oikodomhshte kai sperma ou mh speirhte kai ampelwn ouk estai umin oti en skhnaiV oikhsete pasaV taV hmeraV umwn opwV an zhshte hmeraV pollaV epi thV ghV ef' hV diatribete umeiV ep' authV
kai hkousamen thV fwnhV iwnadab tou patroV hmwn proV to mh piein oinon pasaV taV hmeraV hmwn hmeiV kai ai gunaikeV hmwn kai oi uioi hmwn kai ai qugatereV hmwn
kai proV to mh oikodomein oikiaV tou katoikein ekei kai ampelwn kai agroV kai sperma ouk egeneto hmin
kai wkhsamen en skhnaiV kai hkousamen kai epoihsamen kata panta a eneteilato hmin iwnadab o pathr hmwn
kai egenhqh ote anebh naboucodonosor epi thn ghn kai eipamen eiselqate kai eiselqwmen eiV ierousalhm apo proswpou thV dunamewV twn caldaiwn kai apo proswpou thV dunamewV twn assuriwn kai wkoumen ekei
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn
outwV legei kurioV poreuou kai eipon anqrwpw iouda kai toiV katoikousin ierousalhm ou mh labhte paideian tou akouein touV logouV mou
esthsan rhma uioi iwnadab uiou rhcab o eneteilato toiV teknoiV autou proV to mh piein oinon kai ouk epiosan kai egw elalhsa proV umaV orqrou kai elalhsa kai ouk hkousate

kai apesteila proV umaV touV paidaV mou touV profhtaV legwn apostrafhte ekastoV apo thV odou autou thV ponhraV kai beltiw poihsate ta epithdeumata umwn kai ou poreusesqe opisw qewn eterwn tou douleuein autoiV kai oikhsete epi thV ghV hV edwka umin kai toiV patrasin umwn kai ouk eklinate ta wta umwn kai ouk hkousate
kai esthsan uioi iwnadab uiou rhcab thn entolhn tou patroV autwn o de laoV outoV ouk hkousan mou
dia touto outwV eipen kurioV idou egw ferw epi ioudan kai epi touV katoikountaV ierousalhm panta ta kaka a elalhsa ep' autouV
dia touto outwV eipen kurioV epeidh hkousan uioi iwnadab uiou rhcab thn entolhn tou patroV autwn poiein kaqoti eneteilato autoiV o pathr autwn
ou mh ekliph anhr twn uiwn iwnadab uiou rhcab paresthkwV kata proswpon mou pasaV taV hmeraV thV ghV
kai en tw eniautw tw tetartw iwakim uiou iwsia basilewV iouda egenhqh logoV kuriou proV me legwn

labe seautw cartion bibliou kai grayon ep' autou pantaV touV logouV ouV ecrhmatisa proV se epi ierousalhm kai epi ioudan kai epi panta ta eqnh af' hV hmeraV lalhsantoV mou proV se af' hmerwn iwsia basilewV iouda kai ewV thV hmeraV tauthV
iswV akousetai o oikoV iouda panta ta kaka a egw logizomai poihsai autoiV ina apostreywsin apo odou autwn thV ponhraV kai ilewV esomai taiV adikiaiV autwn kai taiV amartiaiV autwn
kai ekalesen ieremiaV ton barouc uion nhriou kai egrayen apo stomatoV ieremiou pantaV touV logouV kuriou ouV ecrhmatisen proV auton eiV cartion bibliou
kai eneteilato ieremiaV tw barouc legwn egw fulassomai ou mh dunwmai eiselqein eiV oikon kuriou
kai anagnwsh en tw cartiw toutw eiV ta wta tou laou en oikw kuriou en hmera nhsteiaV kai en wsi pantoV iouda twn ercomenwn ek polewV autwn anagnwsh autoiV
iswV peseitai eleoV autwn kata proswpon kuriou kai apostreyousin ek thV odou autwn thV ponhraV oti megaV o qumoV kai h orgh kuriou hn elalhsen epi ton laon touton
kai epoihsen barouc kata panta a eneteilato autw ieremiaV tou anagnwnai en tw bibliw logouV kuriou en oikw kuriou
kai egenhqh en tw etei tw ogdow basilei iwakim tw mhni tw enatw exekklhsiasan nhsteian kata proswpon kuriou paV o laoV en ierousalhm kai oikoV iouda

kai aneginwske barouc en tw bibliw touV logouV ieremiou en oikw kuriou en oikw gamariou uiou safan tou grammatewV en th aulh th epanw en proquroiV pulhV tou oikou kuriou thV kainhV en wsi pantoV tou laou
kai hkousen micaiaV uioV gamariou uiou safan apantaV touV logouV kuriou ek tou bibliou

kai katebh eiV oikon tou basilewV eiV ton oikon tou grammatewV kai idou ekei panteV oi arconteV ekaqhnto elisama o grammateuV kai dalaiaV uioV selemiou kai elnaqan uioV akcobwr kai gamariaV uioV safan kai sedekiaV uioV ananiou kai panteV oi arconteV
kai anhggeilen autoiV micaiaV pantaV touV logouV ouV hkousen anaginwskontoV tou barouc eiV ta wta tou laou

kai apesteilan panteV oi arconteV proV barouc uion nhriou ton ioudin uion naqaniou uiou selemiou uiou cousi legonteV to cartion en w su anaginwskeiV en autw en wsi tou laou labe auto eiV thn ceira sou kai hke kai elaben barouc to cartion kai katebh proV autouV
kai eipan autw palin anagnwqi eiV ta wta hmwn kai anegnw barouc
kai egenhqh wV hkousan pantaV touV logouV sunebouleusanto ekastoV proV ton plhsion autou kai eipan anaggellonteV anaggeilwmen tw basilei apantaV touV logouV toutouV
kai ton barouc hrwthsan legonteV poqen egrayaV pantaV touV logouV toutouV
kai eipen barouc apo stomatoV autou anhggeilen moi ieremiaV pantaV touV logouV toutouV kai egrafon en bibliw
kai eipan tw barouc badison katakrubhqi su kai ieremiaV anqrwpoV mh gnwtw pou umeiV
kai eishlqon proV ton basilea eiV thn aulhn kai to cartion edwkan fulassein en oikw elisama kai anhggeilan tw basilei pantaV touV logouV
kai apesteilen o basileuV ton ioudin labein to cartion kai elaben auto ex oikou elisama kai anegnw ioudin eiV ta wta tou basilewV kai eiV ta wta pantwn twn arcontwn twn esthkotwn peri ton basilea
kai o basileuV ekaqhto en oikw ceimerinw kai escara puroV kata proswpon autou
kai egenhqh anaginwskontoV ioudin treiV selidaV kai tessaraV apetemnen autaV tw xurw tou grammatewV kai erripten eiV to pur to epi thV escaraV ewV exelipen paV o carthV eiV to pur to epi thV escaraV
kai ouk ezhthsan kai ou dierrhxan ta imatia autwn o basileuV kai oi paideV autou oi akouonteV pantaV touV logouV toutouV
kai elnaqan kai godoliaV kai gamariaV upeqento tw basilei proV to mh katakausai to cartion
kai eneteilato o basileuV tw ieremehl uiw tou basilewV kai tw saraia uiw esrihl sullabein ton barouc kai ton ieremian kai katekrubhsan
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV ieremian meta to katakausai ton basilea to cartion pantaV touV logouV ouV egrayen barouc apo stomatoV ieremiou legwn
palin labe su cartion eteron kai grayon pantaV touV logouV touV ontaV epi tou cartiou ouV katekausen o basileuV iwakim

kai ereiV outwV eipen kurioV su katekausaV to cartion touto legwn dia ti egrayaV ep' autw legwn eisporeuomenoV eisporeusetai o basileuV babulwnoV kai exoleqreusei thn ghn tauthn kai ekleiyei ap' authV anqrwpoV kai kthnh
dia touto outwV eipen kurioV epi iwakim basilea iouda ouk estai autw kaqhmenoV epi qronou dauid kai to qnhsimaion autou estai errimmenon en tw kaumati thV hmeraV kai en tw pagetw thV nuktoV

kai episkeyomai ep' auton kai epi to genoV autou kai epi touV paidaV autou kai epaxw ep' autouV kai epi touV katoikountaV ierousalhm kai epi ghn iouda panta ta kaka a elalhsa proV autouV kai ouk hkousan
kai elaben barouc cartion eteron kai egrayen ep' autw apo stomatoV ieremiou apantaV touV logouV tou bibliou ou katekausen iwakim kai eti proseteqhsan autw logoi pleioneV wV outoi
kai ebasileusen sedekiaV uioV iwsia anti iwakim on ebasileusen naboucodonosor basileuein tou iouda
kai ouk hkousen autoV kai oi paideV autou kai o laoV thV ghV touV logouV kuriou ouV elalhsen en ceiri ieremiou
kai apesteilen o basileuV sedekiaV ton iwacal uion selemiou kai ton sofonian uion maasaiou ton ierea proV ieremian legwn proseuxai dh peri hmwn proV kurion
kai ieremiaV hlqen kai dihlqen dia mesou thV polewV kai ouk edwkan auton eiV oikon thV fulakhV
kai dunamiV faraw exhlqen ex aiguptou kai hkousan oi caldaioi thn akohn autwn kai anebhsan apo ierousalhm
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV ieremian legwn
outwV eipen kurioV outwV ereiV proV basilea iouda ton aposteilanta proV se tou ekzhthsai me idou dunamiV faraw h exelqousa umin eiV bohqeian apostreyousin eiV ghn aiguptou
kai anastreyousin autoi oi caldaioi kai polemhsousin epi thn polin tauthn kai sullhmyontai authn kai kausousin authn en puri
oti outwV eipen kurioV mh upolabhte taiV yucaiV umwn legonteV apotreconteV apeleusontai af' hmwn oi caldaioi oti ou mh apelqwsin
kai ean pataxhte pasan dunamin twn caldaiwn touV polemountaV umaV kai kataleifqwsin tineV ekkekenthmenoi ekastoV en tw topw autou outoi anasthsontai kai kausousin thn polin tauthn en puri
kai egeneto ote anebh h dunamiV twn caldaiwn apo ierousalhm apo proswpou thV dunamewV faraw
exhlqen ieremiaV apo ierousalhm tou poreuqhnai eiV ghn beniamin tou agorasai ekeiqen en mesw tou laou
kai egeneto autoV en pulh beniamin kai ekei anqrwpoV par' w kateluen sarouiaV uioV selemiou uiou ananiou kai sunelaben ton ieremian legwn proV touV caldaiouV su feugeiV
kai eipen yeudoV ouk eiV touV caldaiouV egw feugw kai ouk hkousen autou kai sunelaben sarouiaV ton ieremian kai eishgagen auton proV touV arcontaV
kai epikranqhsan oi arconteV epi ieremian kai epataxan auton kai apesteilan auton eiV thn oikian iwnaqan tou grammatewV oti tauthn epoihsan eiV oikian fulakhV
kai hlqen ieremiaV eiV oikian tou lakkou kai eiV thn cereq kai ekaqisen ekei hmeraV pollaV
kai apesteilen sedekiaV kai ekalesen auton kai hrwta auton o basileuV krufaiwV eipein ei estin logoV para kuriou kai eipen estin eiV ceiraV basilewV babulwnoV paradoqhsh
kai eipen ieremiaV tw basilei ti hdikhsa se kai touV paidaV sou kai ton laon touton oti su didwV me eiV oikian fulakhV
kai pou eisin oi profhtai umwn oi profhteusanteV umin legonteV oti ou mh elqh basileuV babulwnoV epi thn ghn tauthn
kai nun kurie basileu pesetw to eleoV mou kata proswpon sou kai ti apostrefeiV me eiV oikian iwnaqan tou grammatewV kai ou mh apoqanw ekei

kai sunetaxen o basileuV kai enebalosan auton eiV oikian thV fulakhV kai edidosan autw arton ena thV hmeraV exwqen ou pessousin ewV exelipon oi artoi ek thV polewV kai ekaqisen ieremiaV en th aulh thV fulakhV
kai hkousen safatiaV uioV maqan kai godoliaV uioV pascwr kai iwacal uioV selemiou touV logouV ouV elalei ieremiaV epi ton laon legwn
outwV eipen kurioV o katoikwn en th polei tauth apoqaneitai en romfaia kai en limw kai o ekporeuomenoV proV touV caldaiouV zhsetai kai estai h yuch autou eiV eurema kai zhsetai
oti outwV eipen kurioV paradidomenh paradoqhsetai h poliV auth eiV ceiraV dunamewV basilewV babulwnoV kai sullhmyetai authn

kai eipan tw basilei anaireqhtw dh o anqrwpoV ekeinoV oti autoV ekluei taV ceiraV twn anqrwpwn twn polemountwn twn kataleipomenwn en th polei kai taV ceiraV pantoV tou laou lalwn proV autouV kata touV logouV toutouV oti o anqrwpoV outoV ou crhsmologei eirhnhn tw law toutw all' h ponhra
kai eipen o basileuV idou autoV en cersin umwn oti ouk hdunato o basileuV proV autouV
kai erriyan auton eiV ton lakkon melciou uiou tou basilewV oV hn en th aulh thV fulakhV kai ecalasan auton eiV ton lakkon kai en tw lakkw ouk hn udwr all' h borboroV kai hn en tw borborw
kai hkousen abdemelec o aiqioy kai autoV en oikia tou basilewV oti edwkan ieremian eiV ton lakkon kai o basileuV hn en th pulh beniamin
kai exhlqen proV auton kai elalhsen proV ton basilea kai eipen
eponhreusw a epoihsaV tou apokteinai ton anqrwpon touton apo proswpou tou limou oti ouk eisin eti artoi en th polei
kai eneteilato o basileuV tw abdemelec legwn labe eiV taV ceiraV sou enteuqen triakonta anqrwpouV kai anagage auton ek tou lakkou ina mh apoqanh
kai elaben abdemelec touV anqrwpouV kai eishlqen eiV thn oikian tou basilewV thn upogeion kai elaben ekeiqen palaia rakh kai palaia scoinia kai erriyen auta proV ieremian eiV ton lakkon
kai eipen tauta qeV upokatw twn scoiniwn kai epoihsen ieremiaV outwV
kai eilkusan auton toiV scoinioiV kai anhgagon auton ek tou lakkou kai ekaqisen ieremiaV en th aulh thV fulakhV
kai apesteilen o basileuV kai ekalesen auton proV eauton eiV oikian aselisi thn en oikw kuriou kai eipen autw o basileuV erwthsw se logon kai mh dh kruyhV ap' emou rhma
kai eipen ieremiaV tw basilei ean anaggeilw soi ouci qanatw me qanatwseiV kai ean sumbouleusw soi ou mh akoushV mou
kai wmosen autw o basileuV legwn zh kurioV oV epoihsen hmin thn yuchn tauthn ei apoktenw se kai ei dwsw se eiV ceiraV twn anqrwpwn toutwn
kai eipen autw ieremiaV outwV eipen kurioV ean exelqwn exelqhV proV hgemonaV basilewV babulwnoV kai zhsetai h yuch sou kai h poliV auth ou mh katakauqh en puri kai zhsh su kai h oikia sou
kai ean mh exelqhV doqhsetai h poliV auth eiV ceiraV twn caldaiwn kai kausousin authn en puri kai su ou mh swqhV
kai eipen o basileuV tw ieremia egw logon ecw twn ioudaiwn twn pefeugotwn proV touV caldaiouV mh dwsein me eiV ceiraV autwn kai katamwkhsontai mou
kai eipen ieremiaV ou mh paradwsin se akouson ton logon kuriou on egw legw proV se kai beltion estai soi kai zhsetai h yuch sou
kai ei mh qeleiV su exelqein outoV o logoV on edeixen moi kurioV

kai idou pasai ai gunaikeV ai kataleifqeisai en oikia basilewV iouda exhgonto proV arcontaV basilewV babulwnoV kai autai elegon hpathsan se kai dunhsontai soi andreV eirhnikoi sou kai katalusousin en olisqhmasin podaV sou apestreyan apo sou
kai taV gunaikaV sou kai ta tekna sou exaxousin proV touV caldaiouV kai su ou mh swqhV oti en ceiri basilewV babulwnoV sullhmfqhsh kai h poliV auth katakauqhsetai
kai eipen autw o basileuV anqrwpoV mh gnwtw ek twn logwn toutwn kai su ou mh apoqanhV

kai ean akouswsin oi arconteV oti elalhsa soi kai elqwsin proV se kai eipwsin soi anaggeilon hmin ti elalhsen soi o basileuV mh kruyhV af' hmwn kai ou mh anelwmen se kai ti elalhsen proV se o basileuV
kai ereiV autoiV riptw egw to eleoV mou kat' ofqalmouV tou basilewV proV to mh apostreyai me eiV oikian iwnaqan apoqanein ekei
kai hlqosan panteV oi arconteV proV ieremian kai hrwthsan auton kai anhggeilen autoiV kata pantaV touV logouV toutouV ouV eneteilato autw o basileuV kai apesiwphsan oti ouk hkousqh logoV kuriou
kai ekaqisen ieremiaV en th aulh thV fulakhV ewV cronou ou sunelhmfqh ierousalhm
kai egeneto en tw etei tw enatw tou sedekia basilewV iouda en tw mhni tw dekatw paregeneto naboucodonosor basileuV babulwnoV kai pasa h dunamiV autou epi ierousalhm kai epoliorkoun authn
kai en tw endekatw etei tou sedekia en tw mhni tw tetartw enath tou mhnoV erragh h poliV

kai eishlqon panteV oi hgemoneV basilewV babulwnoV kai ekaqisan en pulh th mesh nargalasar kai samagwq kai nabousacar kai nabousariV kai nagargasnaser rabamag kai oi kataloipoi hgemoneV basilewV babulwnoV
kai apesteilan kai elabon ton ieremian ex aulhV thV fulakhV kai edwkan auton proV ton godolian uion acikam uiou safan kai exhgagon auton kai ekaqisen en mesw tou laou
kai proV ieremian egeneto logoV kuriou en th aulh thV fulakhV legwn
poreuou kai eipon proV abdemelec ton aiqiopa outwV eipen kurioV o qeoV israhl idou egw ferw touV logouV mou epi thn polin tauthn eiV kaka kai ouk eiV agaqa
kai swsw se en th hmera ekeinh kai ou mh dwsw se eiV ceiraV twn anqrwpwn wn su fobh apo proswpou autwn
oti swzwn swsw se kai en romfaia ou mh peshV kai estai h yuch sou eiV eurema oti epepoiqeiV ep' emoi fhsin kurioV

o logoV o genomenoV para kuriou proV ieremian usteron meta to aposteilai auton nabouzardan ton arcimageiron ton ek daman en tw labein auton en ceiropedaiV en mesw apoikiaV iouda twn hgmenwn eiV babulwna
kai elaben auton o arcimageiroV kai eipen autw kurioV o qeoV sou elalhsen ta kaka tauta epi ton topon touton
kai epoihsen kurioV oti hmartete autw kai ouk hkousate autou thV fwnhV
idou elusa se apo twn ceiropedwn twn epi taV ceiraV sou ei kalon enantion sou elqein met' emou eiV babulwna hke kai qhsw touV ofqalmouV mou epi se

ei de mh apotrece kai anastreyon proV godolian uion acikam uiou safan on katesthsen basileuV babulwnoV en gh iouda kai oikhson met' autou en mesw tou laou en gh iouda eiV apanta ta agaqa en ofqalmoiV sou tou poreuqhnai poreuou kai edwken autw o arcimageiroV dwra kai apesteilen auton
kai hlqen proV godolian eiV masshfa kai ekaqisen en mesw tou laou tou kataleifqentoV en th gh

kai hkousan panteV oi hgemoneV thV dunamewV thV en agrw autoi kai oi andreV autwn oti katesthsen basileuV babulwnoV ton godolian en th gh kai parekateqeto autw andraV kai gunaikaV autwn ouV ouk apwkisen eiV babulwna
kai hlqen proV godolian eiV masshfa ismahl uioV naqaniou kai iwanan uioV karhe kai saraiaV uioV qanaemeq kai uioi wfe tou netwfati kai iezoniaV uioV tou mocati autoi kai oi andreV autwn
kai wmosen autoiV godoliaV kai toiV andrasin autwn legwn mh fobhqhte apo proswpou twn paidwn twn caldaiwn katoikhsate en th gh kai ergasasqe tw basilei babulwnoV kai beltion estai umin

kai idou egw kaqhmai enantion umwn eiV masshfa sthnai kata proswpon twn caldaiwn oi an elqwsin ef' umaV kai umeiV sunagagete oinon kai opwran kai sunagagete elaion kai balete eiV ta aggeia umwn kai oikhsate en taiV polesin aiV katekrathsate

kai panteV oi ioudaioi oi en gh mwab kai en uioiV ammwn kai oi en th idoumaia kai oi en pash th gh hkousan oti edwken basileuV babulwnoV kataleimma tw iouda kai oti katesthsen ep' autouV ton godolian uion acikam
kai hlqon proV godolian eiV ghn iouda eiV masshfa kai sunhgagon oinon kai opwran pollhn sfodra kai elaion
kai iwanan uioV karhe kai panteV oi hgemoneV thV dunamewV oi en toiV agroiV hlqon proV godolian eiV masshfa
kai eipan autw ei gnwsei ginwskeiV oti belisa basileuV uiwn ammwn apesteilen proV se ton ismahl pataxai sou yuchn kai ouk episteusen autoiV godoliaV

kai iwanan eipen tw godolia krufaiwV en masshfa poreusomai dh kai pataxw ton ismahl kai mhqeiV gnwtw mh pataxh sou yuchn kai diasparh paV iouda oi sunhgmenoi proV se kai apolountai oi kataloipoi iouda
kai eipen godoliaV proV iwanan mh poihshV to pragma touto oti yeudh su legeiV peri ismahl
kai egeneto tw mhni tw ebdomw hlqen ismahl uioV naqaniou uiou elasa apo genouV tou basilewV kai deka andreV met' autou proV godolian eiV masshfa kai efagon ekei arton ama
kai anesth ismahl kai oi deka andreV oi hsan met' autou kai epataxan ton godolian on katesthsen basileuV babulwnoV epi thV ghV
kai pantaV touV ioudaiouV touV ontaV met' autou en masshfa kai pantaV touV caldaiouV touV eureqentaV ekei
kai egeneto th hmera th deutera pataxantoV autou ton godolian kai anqrwpoV ouk egnw

kai hlqosan andreV apo sucem kai apo salhm kai apo samareiaV ogdohkonta andreV exurhmenoi pwgwnaV kai dierrhgmenoi ta imatia kai koptomenoi kai manaa kai libanoV en cersin autwn tou eisenegkein eiV oikon kuriou
kai exhlqen eiV apanthsin autoiV ismahl autoi eporeuonto kai eklaion kai eipen autoiV eiselqete proV godolian
kai egeneto eiselqontwn autwn eiV to meson thV polewV esfaxen autouV eiV to frear
kai deka andreV eureqhsan ekei kai eipan tw ismahl mh anelhV hmaV oti eisin hmin qhsauroi en agrw puroi kai kriqai meli kai elaion kai parhlqen kai ouk aneilen autouV en mesw twn adelfwn autwn
kai to frear eiV o erriyen ekei ismahl pantaV ouV epataxen frear mega touto estin o epoihsen o basileuV asa apo proswpou baasa basilewV israhl touto eneplhsen ismahl traumatiwn
kai apestreyen ismahl panta ton laon ton kataleifqenta eiV masshfa kai taV qugateraV tou basilewV aV parekateqeto o arcimageiroV tw godolia uiw acikam kai wceto eiV to peran uiwn ammwn
kai hkousen iwanan uioV karhe kai panteV oi hgemoneV thV dunamewV oi met' autou panta ta kaka a epoihsen ismahl
kai hgagon apan to stratopedon autwn kai wconto polemein auton kai euron auton epi udatoV pollou en gabawn
kai egeneto ote eidon paV o laoV o meta ismahl ton iwanan kai touV hgemonaV thV dunamewV thV met' autou
kai anestreyan proV iwanan
kai ismahl eswqh sun oktw anqrwpoiV kai wceto proV touV uiouV ammwn

kai elaben iwanan kai panteV oi hgemoneV thV dunamewV oi met' autou pantaV touV kataloipouV tou laou ouV apestreyen apo ismahl dunatouV andraV en polemw kai taV gunaikaV kai ta loipa kai touV eunoucouV ouV apestreyen apo gabawn
kai wconto kai ekaqisan en gabhrwq-camaam thn proV bhqleem tou poreuqhnai eiselqein eiV aigupton
apo proswpou twn caldaiwn oti efobhqhsan apo proswpou autwn oti epataxen ismahl ton godolian on katesthsen basileuV babulwnoV en th gh
kai proshlqon panteV oi hgemoneV thV dunamewV kai iwanan kai azariaV uioV maasaiou kai paV o laoV apo mikrou ewV megalou

proV ieremian ton profhthn kai eipan autw pesetw dh to eleoV hmwn kata proswpon sou kai proseuxai proV kurion ton qeon sou peri twn kataloipwn toutwn oti kateleifqhmen oligoi apo pollwn kaqwV oi ofqalmoi sou blepousin
kai anaggeilatw hmin kurioV o qeoV sou thn odon h poreusomeqa en auth kai logon on poihsomen
kai eipen autoiV ieremiaV hkousa idou egw proseuxomai proV kurion ton qeon hmwn kata touV logouV umwn kai estai o logoV on an apokriqhsetai kurioV anaggelw umin ou mh kruyw af' umwn rhma
kai autoi eipan tw ieremia estw kurioV en hmin eiV martura dikaion kai piston ei mh kata panta ton logon on an aposteilh se kurioV proV hmaV outwV poihsomen
kai ean agaqon kai ean kakon thn fwnhn kuriou tou qeou hmwn ou hmeiV apostellomen se proV auton akousomeqa ina beltion hmin genhtai oti akousomeqa thV fwnhV kuriou tou qeou hmwn
kai egenhqh meta deka hmeraV egenhqh logoV kuriou proV ieremian
kai ekalesen ton iwanan kai touV hgemonaV thV dunamewV kai panta ton laon apo mikrou ewV megalou
kai eipen autoiV outwV eipen kurioV
ean kaqisanteV kaqishte en th gh tauth oikodomhsw umaV kai ou mh kaqelw kai futeusw umaV kai ou mh ektilw oti anapepaumai epi toiV kakoiV oiV epoihsa umin
mh fobhqhte apo proswpou basilewV babulwnoV ou umeiV fobeisqe apo proswpou autou mh fobhqhte fhsin kurioV oti meq' umwn egw eimi tou exaireisqai umaV kai swzein umaV ek ceiroV autou
kai dwsw umin eleoV kai elehsw umaV kai epistreyw umaV eiV thn ghn umwn
kai ei legete umeiV ou mh kaqiswmen en th gh tauth proV to mh akousai fwnhV kuriou
oti eiV ghn aiguptou eiseleusomeqa kai ou mh idwmen polemon kai fwnhn salpiggoV ou mh akouswmen kai en artoiV ou mh peinaswmen kai ekei oikhsomen
dia touto akousate logon kuriou outwV eipen kurioV ean umeiV dwte to proswpon umwn eiV aigupton kai eiselqhte ekei katoikein
kai estai h romfaia hn umeiV fobeisqe apo proswpou authV eurhsei umaV en gh aiguptou kai o limoV ou umeiV logon ecete apo proswpou autou katalhmyetai umaV opisw umwn en aiguptw kai ekei apoqaneisqe

kai esontai panteV oi anqrwpoi kai panteV oi allogeneiV oi qenteV to proswpon autwn eiV ghn aiguptou enoikein ekei ekleiyousin en th romfaia kai en tw limw kai ouk estai autwn ouqeiV swzomenoV apo twn kakwn wn egw epagw ep' autouV

oti outwV eipen kurioV kaqwV estaxen o qumoV mou epi touV katoikountaV ierousalhm outwV staxei o qumoV mou ef' umaV eiselqontwn umwn eiV aigupton kai esesqe eiV abaton kai upoceirioi kai eiV aran kai eiV oneidismon kai ou mh idhte ouketi ton topon touton
a elalhsen kurioV ef' umaV touV kataloipouV iouda mh eiselqhte eiV aigupton kai nun gnonteV gnwsesqe
oti eponhreusasqe en yucaiV umwn aposteilanteV me legonteV proseuxai peri hmwn proV kurion kai kata panta a ean lalhsh soi kurioV poihsomen
kai ouk hkousate thV fwnhV kuriou hV apesteilen me proV umaV
kai nun en romfaia kai en limw ekleiyete en tw topw ou umeiV boulesqe eiselqein katoikein ekei
kai egenhqh wV epausato ieremiaV legwn proV ton laon pantaV touV logouV kuriou ouV apesteilen auton kurioV proV autouV pantaV touV logouV toutouV
kai eipen azariaV uioV maasaiou kai iwanan uioV karhe kai panteV oi andreV oi eipanteV tw ieremia legonteV yeudh ouk apesteilen se kurioV proV hmaV legwn mh eiselqhte eiV aigupton oikein ekei
all' h barouc uioV nhriou sumballei se proV hmaV ina dwV hmaV eiV ceiraV twn caldaiwn tou qanatwsai hmaV kai apoikisqhnai hmaV eiV babulwna
kai ouk hkousen iwanan kai panteV oi hgemoneV thV dunamewV kai paV o laoV thV fwnhV kuriou katoikhsai en gh iouda
kai elaben iwanan kai panteV oi hgemoneV thV dunamewV pantaV touV kataloipouV iouda touV apostreyantaV katoikein en th gh
touV dunatouV andraV kai taV gunaikaV kai ta nhpia kai taV qugateraV tou basilewV kai taV yucaV aV katelipen nabouzardan meta godoliou uiou acikam kai ieremian ton profhthn kai barouc uion nhriou
kai eishlqon eiV aigupton oti ouk hkousan thV fwnhV kuriou kai eishlqon eiV tafnaV
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV ieremian en tafnaV legwn
labe seautw liqouV megalouV kai katakruyon autouV en proquroiV en pulh thV oikiaV faraw en tafnaV kat' ofqalmouV andrwn iouda
kai ereiV outwV eipen kurioV idou egw apostellw kai axw naboucodonosor basilea babulwnoV kai qhsei autou ton qronon epanw twn liqwn toutwn wn katekruyaV kai arei ta opla autou ep' autouV
kai eiseleusetai kai pataxei ghn aiguptou ouV eiV qanaton eiV qanaton kai ouV eiV apoikismon eiV apoikismon kai ouV eiV romfaian eiV romfaian
kai kausei pur en oikiaiV qewn autwn kai empuriei autaV kai apoikiei autouV kai fqeiriei ghn aiguptou wsper fqeirizei poimhn to imation autou kai exeleusetai en eirhnh
kai suntriyei touV stulouV hliou polewV touV en wn kai taV oikiaV autwn katakausei en puri
o logoV o genomenoV proV ieremian apasin toiV ioudaioiV toiV katoikousin en gh aiguptw kai toiV kaqhmenoiV en magdwlw kai en tafnaV kai en gh paqourhV legwn
outwV eipen kurioV o qeoV israhl umeiV ewrakate panta ta kaka a ephgagon epi ierousalhm kai epi taV poleiV iouda kai idou eisin erhmoi apo enoikwn
apo proswpou ponhriaV autwn hV epoihsan parapikranai me poreuqenteV qumian qeoiV eteroiV oiV ouk egnwte
kai apesteila proV umaV touV paidaV mou touV profhtaV orqrou kai apesteila legwn mh poihshte to pragma thV molunsewV tauthV hV emishsa
kai ouk hkousan mou kai ouk eklinan to ouV autwn apostreyai apo twn kakwn autwn proV to mh qumian qeoiV eteroiV
kai estaxen h orgh mou kai o qumoV mou kai exekauqh en polesin iouda kai exwqen ierousalhm kai egenhqhsan eiV erhmwsin kai eiV abaton wV h hmera auth
kai nun outwV eipen kurioV pantokratwr ina ti umeiV poieite kaka megala epi yucaiV umwn ekkoyai umwn anqrwpon kai gunaika nhpion kai qhlazonta ek mesou iouda proV to mh kataleifqhnai umwn mhdena

parapikranai me en toiV ergoiV twn ceirwn umwn qumian qeoiV eteroiV en gh aiguptw eiV hn eishlqate enoikein ekei ina ekkophte kai ina genhsqe eiV kataran kai eiV oneidismon en pasin toiV eqnesin thV ghV
mh epilelhsqe umeiV twn kakwn twn paterwn umwn kai twn kakwn twn basilewn iouda kai twn kakwn twn arcontwn umwn kai twn kakwn twn gunaikwn umwn wn epoihsan en gh iouda kai exwqen ierousalhm
kai ouk epausanto ewV thV hmeraV tauthV kai ouk anteiconto twn prostagmatwn mou wn edwka kata proswpon twn paterwn autwn
dia touto outwV eipen kurioV idou egw efisthmi to proswpon mou
tou apolesai pantaV touV kataloipouV touV en aiguptw kai pesountai en romfaia kai en limw ekleiyousin apo mikrou ewV megalou kai esontai eiV oneidismon kai eiV apwleian kai eiV kataran
kai episkeyomai epi touV kaqhmenouV en gh aiguptw wV epeskeyamhn epi ierousalhm en romfaia kai en limw kai en qanatw

kai ouk estai seswsmenoV ouqeiV twn epiloipwn iouda twn paroikountwn en gh aiguptw tou epistreyai eiV ghn iouda ef' hn autoi elpizousin taiV yucaiV autwn tou epistreyai ekei ou mh epistreywsin all' h anaseswsmenoi
kai apekriqhsan tw ieremia panteV oi andreV oi gnonteV oti qumiwsin ai gunaikeV autwn qeoiV eteroiV kai pasai ai gunaikeV sunagwgh megalh kai paV o laoV oi kaqhmenoi en gh aiguptw en paqourh legonteV
o logoV on elalhsaV proV hmaV tw onomati kuriou ouk akousomen sou

oti poiounteV poihsomen panta ton logon oV exeleusetai ek tou stomatoV hmwn qumian th basilissh tou ouranou kai spendein auth spondaV kaqa epoihsamen hmeiV kai oi patereV hmwn kai oi basileiV hmwn kai oi arconteV hmwn en polesin iouda kai exwqen ierousalhm kai eplhsqhmen artwn kai egenomeqa crhstoi kai kaka ouk eidomen
kai wV dielipomen qumiwnteV th basilissh tou ouranou hlattwqhmen panteV kai en romfaia kai en limw exelipomen
kai oti hmeiV qumiwmen th basilissh tou ouranou kai espeisamen auth spondaV mh aneu twn andrwn hmwn epoihsamen auth cauwnaV kai espeisamen spondaV auth
kai eipen ieremiaV panti tw law toiV dunatoiV kai taiV gunaixin kai panti tw law toiV apokriqeisin autw logouV legwn

ouci tou qumiamatoV ou equmiasate en taiV polesin iouda kai exwqen ierousalhm umeiV kai oi patereV umwn kai oi basileiV umwn kai oi arconteV umwn kai o laoV thV ghV emnhsqh kurioV kai anebh epi thn kardian autou
kai ouk hdunato kurioV eti ferein apo proswpou ponhriaV pragmatwn umwn apo twn bdelugmatwn wn epoihsate kai egenhqh h gh umwn eiV erhmwsin kai eiV abaton kai eiV aran wV en th hmera tauth

apo proswpou wn equmiate kai wn hmartete tw kuriw kai ouk hkousate thV fwnhV kuriou kai en toiV prostagmasin autou kai en tw nomw autou kai en toiV marturioiV autou ouk eporeuqhte kai epelabeto umwn ta kaka tauta
kai eipen ieremiaV tw law kai taiV gunaixin akousate ton logon kuriou

outwV eipen kurioV o qeoV israhl umeiV gunaikeV tw stomati umwn elalhsate kai taiV cersin umwn eplhrwsate legousai poiousai poihsomen taV omologiaV hmwn aV wmologhsamen qumian th basilissh tou ouranou kai spendein auth spondaV emmeinasai enemeinate taiV omologiaiV umwn kai poiousai epoihsate

dia touto akousate logon kuriou paV iouda oi kaqhmenoi en gh aiguptw idou wmosa tw onomati mou tw megalw eipen kurioV ean genhtai eti onoma mou en tw stomati pantoV iouda eipein zh kurioV kurioV epi pash gh aiguptw
oti idou egw egrhgora ep' autouV tou kakwsai autouV kai ouk agaqwsai kai ekleiyousin paV iouda oi katoikounteV en gh aiguptw en romfaia kai en limw ewV an eklipwsin
kai oi seswsmenoi apo romfaiaV epistreyousin eiV ghn iouda oligoi ariqmw kai gnwsontai oi kataloipoi iouda oi katastanteV en gh aiguptw katoikhsai ekei logoV tinoV emmenei
kai touto umin to shmeion oti episkeyomai egw ef' umaV eiV ponhra

outwV eipen kurioV idou egw didwmi ton ouafrh basilea aiguptou eiV ceiraV ecqrou autou kai eiV ceiraV zhtountwn thn yuchn autou kaqa edwka ton sedekian basilea iouda eiV ceiraV naboucodonosor basilewV babulwnoV ecqrou autou kai zhtountoV thn yuchn autou
o logoV on elalhsen ieremiaV o profhthV proV barouc uion nhriou ote egrafen touV logouV toutouV en tw bibliw apo stomatoV ieremiou en tw eniautw tw tetartw tw iwakim uiw iwsia basilewV iouda
outwV eipen kurioV epi soi barouc
oti eipaV oimmoi oimmoi oti proseqhken kurioV kopon epi ponon moi ekoimhqhn en stenagmoiV anapausin ouc euron
eipon autw outwV eipen kurioV idou ouV egw wkodomhsa egw kaqairw kai ouV egw efuteusa egw ektillw
kai su zhteiV seautw megala mh zhthshV oti idou egw epagw kaka epi pasan sarka legei kurioV kai dwsw thn yuchn sou eiV eurema en panti topw ou ean badishV ekei
ontoV eikostou kai enoV etouV sedekiou en tw basileuein auton kai endeka eth ebasileusen en ierousalhm kai onoma th mhtri autou amitaal qugathr ieremiou ek lobena

kai egeneto en tw etei tw enatw thV basileiaV autou en mhni tw dekatw dekath tou mhnoV hlqen naboucodonosor basileuV babulwnoV kai pasa h dunamiV autou epi ierousalhm kai periecarakwsan authn kai periwkodomhsan authn tetrapedoiV liqoiV kuklw
kai hlqen h poliV eiV sunochn ewV endekatou etouV tw basilei sedekia
en th enath tou mhnoV kai esterewqh o limoV en th polei kai ouk hsan artoi tw law thV ghV

kai diekoph h poliV kai panteV oi andreV oi polemistai exhlqon nuktoV kata thn odon thV pulhV ana meson tou teicouV kai tou proteicismatoV o hn kata ton khpon tou basilewV kai oi caldaioi epi thV polewV kuklw kai eporeuqhsan odon thn eiV araba
kai katediwxen h dunamiV twn caldaiwn opisw tou basilewV kai katelabon auton en tw peran iericw kai panteV oi paideV autou diesparhsan ap' autou
kai sunelabon ton basilea kai hgagon auton proV ton basilea babulwnoV eiV deblaqa kai elalhsen autw meta krisewV
kai esfaxen basileuV babulwnoV touV uiouV sedekiou kat' ofqalmouV autou kai pantaV touV arcontaV iouda esfaxen en deblaqa
kai touV ofqalmouV sedekiou exetuflwsen kai edhsen auton en pedaiV kai hgagen auton basileuV babulwnoV eiV babulwna kai edwken auton eiV oikian mulwnoV ewV hmeraV hV apeqanen
kai en mhni pemptw dekath tou mhnoV hlqen nabouzardan o arcimageiroV o esthkwV kata proswpon tou basilewV babulwnoV eiV ierousalhm
kai eneprhsen ton oikon kuriou kai ton oikon tou basilewV kai pasaV taV oikiaV thV polewV kai pasan oikian megalhn eneprhsen en puri
kai pan teicoV ierousalhm kuklw kaqeilen h dunamiV twn caldaiwn h meta tou arcimageirou
kai touV kataloipouV tou laou katelipen o arcimageiroV eiV ampelourgouV kai eiV gewrgouV

kai idou ekei hn doxa kuriou qeou israhl kata thn orasin hn eidon en tw pediw
kai eipen proV me uie anqrwpou anableyon toiV ofqalmoiV sou proV borran kai anebleya toiV ofqalmoiV mou proV borran kai idou apo borra epi thn pulhn thn proV anatolaV
kai eipen proV me uie anqrwpou ewrakaV ti outoi poiousin anomiaV megalaV poiousin wde tou apecesqai apo twn agiwn mou kai eti oyei anomiaV meizonaV
kai eishgagen me epi ta proqura thV aulhV
kai eipen proV me uie anqrwpou oruxon kai wruxa kai idou qura mia
kai eipen proV me eiselqe kai ide taV anomiaV aV outoi poiousin wde
kai eishlqon kai eidon kai idou mataia bdelugmata kai panta ta eidwla oikou israhl diagegrammena ep' autou kuklw

kai ebdomhkonta andreV ek twn presbuterwn oikou israhl kai iezoniaV o tou safan en mesw autwn eisthkei pro proswpou autwn kai ekastoV qumiathrion autou eicen en th ceiri kai h atmiV tou qumiamatoV anebainen
kai eipen proV me uie anqrwpou ewrakaV a oi presbuteroi tou oikou israhl poiousin ekastoV autwn en tw koitwni tw kruptw autwn dioti eipan ouc ora o kurioV egkataleloipen kurioV thn ghn
kai eipen proV me eti oyei anomiaV meizonaV aV outoi poiousin
kai eishgagen me epi ta proqura thV pulhV oikou kuriou thV blepoushV proV borran kai idou ekei gunaikeV kaqhmenai qrhnousai ton qammouz
kai eipen proV me uie anqrwpou ewrakaV kai eti oyei epithdeumata meizona toutwn

kai eishgagen me eiV thn aulhn oikou kuriou thn eswteran kai idou epi twn proqurwn tou naou kuriou ana meson twn ailam kai ana meson tou qusiasthriou wV eikosi andreV ta opisqia autwn proV ton naon tou kuriou kai ta proswpa autwn apenanti kai outoi proskunousin tw hliw
kai eipen proV me ewrakaV uie anqrwpou mh mikra tw oikw iouda tou poiein taV anomiaV aV pepoihkasin wde dioti eplhsan thn ghn anomiaV kai idou autoi wV mukthrizonteV
kai egw poihsw autoiV meta qumou ou feisetai o ofqalmoV mou oude mh elehsw
kai anekragen eiV ta wta mou fwnh megalh legwn hggiken h ekdikhsiV thV polewV kai ekastoV eicen ta skeuh thV exoleqreusewV en ceiri autou

kai idou ex andreV hrconto apo thV odou thV pulhV thV uyhlhV thV blepoushV proV borran kai ekastou pelux en th ceiri autou kai eiV anhr en mesw autwn endedukwV podhrh kai zwnh sapfeirou epi thV osfuoV autou kai eishlqosan kai esthsan ecomenoi tou qusiasthriou tou calkou
kai doxa qeou tou israhl anebh apo twn ceroubin h ousa ep' autwn eiV to aiqrion tou oikou kai ekalesen ton andra ton endedukota ton podhrh oV eicen epi thV osfuoV autou thn zwnhn
kai eipen proV auton dielqe meshn thn ierousalhm kai doV to shmeion epi ta metwpa twn andrwn twn katastenazontwn kai twn katwdunwmenwn epi pasaiV taiV anomiaiV taiV ginomenaiV en mesw authV
kai toutoiV eipen akouontoV mou poreuesqe opisw autou eiV thn polin kai koptete kai mh feidesqe toiV ofqalmoiV umwn kai mh elehshte

presbuteron kai neaniskon kai parqenon kai nhpia kai gunaikaV apokteinate eiV exaleiyin epi de pantaV ef' ouV estin to shmeion mh eggishte kai apo twn agiwn mou arxasqe kai hrxanto apo twn andrwn twn presbuterwn oi hsan esw en tw oikw
kai eipen proV autouV mianate ton oikon kai plhsate taV odouV nekrwn ekporeuomenoi kai koptete
kai egeneto en tw koptein autouV kai piptw epi proswpon mou kai anebohsa kai eipa oimmoi kurie exaleifeiV su touV kataloipouV tou israhl en tw ekceai se ton qumon sou epi ierousalhm

kai eipen proV me adikia tou oikou israhl kai iouda memegaluntai sfodra sfodra oti eplhsqh h gh lawn pollwn kai h poliV eplhsqh adikiaV kai akaqarsiaV oti eipan egkataleloipen kurioV thn ghn ouk efora o kurioV
kai ou feisetai mou o ofqalmoV oude mh elehsw taV odouV autwn eiV kefalaV autwn dedwka
kai idou o anhr o endedukwV ton podhrh kai ezwsmenoV th zwnh thn osfun autou kai apekrinato legwn pepoihka kaqwV eneteilw moi
kai eidon kai idou epanw tou sterewmatoV tou uper kefalhV twn ceroubin wV liqoV sapfeirou omoiwma qronou ep' autwn

kai eipen proV ton andra ton endedukota thn stolhn eiselqe eiV to meson twn trocwn twn upokatw twn ceroubin kai plhson taV drakaV sou anqrakwn puroV ek mesou twn ceroubin kai diaskorpison epi thn polin kai eishlqen enwpion mou
kai ta ceroubin eisthkei ek dexiwn tou oikou en tw eisporeuesqai ton andra kai h nefelh eplhsen thn aulhn thn eswteran
kai aphren h doxa kuriou apo twn ceroubin eiV to aiqrion tou oikou kai eplhsen ton oikon h nefelh kai h aulh eplhsqh tou feggouV thV doxhV kuriou
kai fwnh twn pterugwn twn ceroubin hkoueto ewV thV aulhV thV exwteraV wV fwnh qeou saddai lalountoV
kai egeneto en tw entellesqai auton tw andri tw endedukoti thn stolhn thn agian legwn labe pur ek mesou twn trocwn ek mesou twn ceroubin kai eishlqen kai esth ecomenoV twn trocwn
kai exeteinen thn ceira autou eiV meson tou puroV tou ontoV en mesw twn ceroubin kai elaben kai edwken eiV taV ceiraV tou endedukotoV thn stolhn thn agian kai elaben kai exhlqen
kai eidon ta ceroubin omoiwma ceirwn anqrwpwn upokatwqen twn pterugwn autwn
kai eidon kai idou trocoi tessareV eisthkeisan ecomenoi twn ceroubin trocoV eiV ecomenoV ceroub enoV kai h oyiV twn trocwn wV oyiV liqou anqrakoV
kai h oyiV autwn omoiwma en toiV tessarsin on tropon otan h trocoV en mesw trocou
en tw poreuesqai auta eiV ta tessara merh autwn eporeuonto ouk epestrefon en tw poreuesqai auta oti eiV on an topon epebleyen h arch h mia eporeuonto kai ouk epestrefon en tw poreuesqai auta
kai oi nwtoi autwn kai ai ceireV autwn kai ai pterugeV autwn kai oi trocoi plhreiV ofqalmwn kukloqen toiV tessarsin trocoiV autwn
toiV de trocoiV toutoiV epeklhqh gelgel akouontoV mou
kai hran ta ceroubin touto to zwon o eidon epi tou potamou tou cobar
kai en tw poreuesqai ta ceroubin eporeuonto oi trocoi kai outoi ecomenoi autwn kai en tw exairein ta ceroubin taV pterugaV autwn tou metewrizesqai apo thV ghV ouk epestrefon oi trocoi autwn
en tw estanai auta eisthkeisan kai en tw metewrizesqai auta emetewrizonto met' autwn dioti pneuma zwhV en autoiV hn
kai exhlqen doxa kuriou apo tou oikou kai epebh epi ta ceroubin

kai anelabon ta ceroubin taV pterugaV autwn kai emetewrisqhsan apo thV ghV enwpion emou en tw exelqein auta kai oi trocoi ecomenoi autwn kai esthsan epi ta proqura thV pulhV oikou kuriou thV apenanti kai doxa qeou israhl hn ep' autwn uperanw
touto to zwon estin o eidon upokatw qeou israhl epi tou potamou tou cobar kai egnwn oti ceroubin estin
tessara proswpa tw eni kai oktw pterugeV tw eni kai omoiwma ceirwn anqrwpou upokatwqen twn pterugwn autwn
kai omoiwsiV twn proswpwn autwn tauta ta proswpa estin a eidon upokatw thV doxhV qeou israhl epi tou potamou tou cobar kai auta ekaston kata proswpon autwn eporeuonto

kai anelaben me pneuma kai hgagen me epi thn pulhn tou oikou kuriou thn katenanti thn blepousan kata anatolaV kai idou epi twn proqurwn thV pulhV wV eikosi kai pente andreV kai eidon en mesw autwn ton iezonian ton tou ezer kai faltian ton tou banaiou touV afhgoumenouV tou laou
kai eipen kurioV proV me uie anqrwpou outoi oi andreV oi logizomenoi mataia kai bouleuomenoi boulhn ponhran en th polei tauth
oi legonteV ouci prosfatwV wkodomhntai ai oikiai auth estin o lebhV hmeiV de ta krea
dia touto profhteuson ep' autouV profhteuson uie anqrwpou
kai epesen ep' eme pneuma kuriou kai eipen proV me lege tade legei kurioV outwV eipate oikoV israhl kai ta diaboulia tou pneumatoV umwn egw epistamai
eplhqunate nekrouV umwn en th polei tauth kai eneplhsate taV odouV authV traumatiwn
dia touto tade legei kurioV touV nekrouV umwn ouV epataxate en mesw authV outoi eisin ta krea auth de o lebhV estin kai umaV exaxw ek mesou authV
romfaian fobeisqe kai romfaian epaxw ef' umaV legei kurioV
kai exaxw umaV ek mesou authV kai paradwsw umaV eiV ceiraV allotriwn kai poihsw en umin krimata
en romfaia peseisqe epi twn oriwn tou israhl krinw umaV kai epignwsesqe oti egw kurioV
auth umin ouk estai eiV lebhta kai umeiV ou mh genhsqe en mesw authV eiV krea epi twn oriwn tou israhl krinw umaV
kai epignwsesqe dioti egw kurioV

kai egeneto en tw profhteuein me kai faltiaV o tou banaiou apeqanen kai piptw epi proswpon mou kai anebohsa fwnh megalh kai eipa oimmoi oimmoi kurie eiV sunteleian su poieiV touV kataloipouV tou israhl
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn

uie anqrwpou oi adelfoi sou kai oi andreV thV aicmalwsiaV sou kai paV o oikoV tou israhl suntetelestai oiV eipan autoiV oi katoikounteV ierousalhm makran apecete apo tou kuriou hmin dedotai h gh eiV klhronomian
dia touto eipon tade legei kurioV oti apwsomai autouV eiV ta eqnh kai diaskorpiw autouV eiV pasan thn ghn kai esomai autoiV eiV agiasma mikron en taiV cwraiV ou an eiselqwsin ekei
dia touto eipon tade legei kurioV kai eisdexomai autouV ek twn eqnwn kai sunaxw autouV ek twn cwrwn ou diespeira autouV en autaiV kai dwsw autoiV thn ghn tou israhl
kai eiseleusontai ekei kai exarousin panta ta bdelugmata authV kai pasaV taV anomiaV authV ex authV
kai dwsw autoiV kardian eteran kai pneuma kainon dwsw en autoiV kai ekspasw thn kardian thn liqinhn ek thV sarkoV autwn kai dwsw autoiV kardian sarkinhn
opwV en toiV prostagmasin mou poreuwntai kai ta dikaiwmata mou fulasswntai kai poiwsin auta kai esontai moi eiV laon kai egw esomai autoiV eiV qeon
kai eiV thn kardian twn bdelugmatwn autwn kai twn anomiwn autwn wV h kardia autwn eporeueto taV odouV autwn eiV kefalaV autwn dedwka legei kurioV
kai exhran ta ceroubin taV pterugaV autwn kai oi trocoi ecomenoi autwn kai h doxa qeou israhl ep' auta uperanw autwn
kai anebh h doxa kuriou ek meshV thV polewV kai esth epi tou orouV o hn apenanti thV polewV
kai anelaben me pneuma kai hgagen me eiV ghn caldaiwn eiV thn aicmalwsian en orasei en pneumati qeou kai anebhn apo thV orasewV hV eidon
kai elalhsa proV thn aicmalwsian pantaV touV logouV tou kuriou ouV edeixen moi
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn
uie anqrwpou en mesw twn adikiwn autwn su katoikeiV oi ecousin ofqalmouV tou blepein kai ou blepousin kai wta ecousin tou akouein kai ouk akouousin dioti oikoV parapikrainwn estin
kai su uie anqrwpou poihson seautw skeuh aicmalwsiaV hmeraV enwpion autwn kai aicmalwteuqhsh ek tou topou sou eiV eteron topon enwpion autwn opwV idwsin dioti oikoV parapikrainwn estin
kai exoiseiV ta skeuh sou wV skeuh aicmalwsiaV hmeraV kat' ofqalmouV autwn kai su exeleush esperaV wV ekporeuetai aicmalwtoV
enwpion autwn dioruxon seautw eiV ton toicon kai diexeleush di' autou
enwpion autwn ep' wmwn analhmfqhsh kai kekrummenoV exeleush to proswpon sou sugkaluyeiV kai ou mh idhV thn ghn dioti teraV dedwka se tw oikw israhl
kai epoihsa outwV kata panta osa eneteilato moi kai skeuh exhnegka wV skeuh aicmalwsiaV hmeraV kai esperaV diwruxa emautw ton toicon kai kekrummenoV exhlqon ep' wmwn anelhmfqhn enwpion autwn
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me to prwi legwn
uie anqrwpou ouk eipan proV se o oikoV tou israhl oikoV o parapikrainwn ti su poieiV
eipon proV autouV tade legei kurioV kurioV o arcwn kai o afhgoumenoV en ierousalhm kai panti oikw israhl oi eisin en mesw autwn
eipon oti egw terata poiw en mesw authV on tropon pepoihka outwV estai autoiV en metoikesia kai en aicmalwsia poreusontai

kai o arcwn en mesw autwn ep' wmwn arqhsetai kai kekrummenoV exeleusetai dia tou toicou kai dioruxei tou exelqein auton di' autou to proswpon autou sugkaluyei opwV mh oraqh ofqalmw kai autoV thn ghn ouk oyetai
kai ekpetasw to diktuon mou ep' auton kai sullhmfqhsetai en th perioch mou kai axw auton eiV babulwna eiV ghn caldaiwn kai authn ouk oyetai kai ekei teleuthsei
kai pantaV touV kuklw autou touV bohqouV autou kai pantaV touV antilambanomenouV autou diasperw eiV panta anemon kai romfaian ekkenwsw opisw autwn
kai gnwsontai dioti egw kurioV en tw diaskorpisai me autouV en toiV eqnesin kai diasperw autouV en taiV cwraiV
kai upoleiyomai ex autwn andraV ariqmw ek romfaiaV kai ek limou kai ek qanatou opwV ekdihgwntai pasaV taV anomiaV autwn en toiV eqnesin ou eishlqosan ekei kai gnwsontai oti egw kurioV
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn
uie anqrwpou ton arton sou met' odunhV fagesai kai to udwr sou meta basanou kai qliyewV piesai

kai ereiV proV ton laon thV ghV tade legei kurioV toiV katoikousin ierousalhm epi thV ghV tou israhl touV artouV autwn met' endeiaV fagontai kai to udwr autwn meta afanismou piontai opwV afanisqh h gh sun plhrwmati authV en asebeia gar panteV oi katoikounteV en auth
kai ai poleiV autwn ai katoikoumenai exerhmwqhsontai kai h gh eiV afanismon estai kai epignwsesqe dioti egw kurioV
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn
uie anqrwpou tiV umin h parabolh auth epi thV ghV tou israhl legonteV makran ai hmerai apolwlen orasiV

dia touto eipon proV autouV tade legei kurioV apostreyw thn parabolhn tauthn kai ouketi mh eipwsin thn parabolhn tauthn oikoV tou israhl oti lalhseiV proV autouV hggikasin ai hmerai kai logoV pashV orasewV
oti ouk estai eti pasa orasiV yeudhV kai manteuomenoV ta proV carin en mesw twn uiwn israhl
dioti egw kurioV lalhsw touV logouV mou lalhsw kai poihsw kai ou mh mhkunw eti oti en taiV hmeraiV umwn oikoV o parapikrainwn lalhsw logon kai poihsw legei kurioV
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn
uie anqrwpou idou oikoV israhl o parapikrainwn legonteV legousin h orasiV hn outoV ora eiV hmeraV pollaV kai eiV kairouV makrouV outoV profhteuei
dia touto eipon proV autouV tade legei kurioV ou mh mhkunwsin ouketi panteV oi logoi mou ouV an lalhsw lalhsw kai poihsw legei kurioV
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn
uie anqrwpou profhteuson epi touV profhtaV tou israhl kai profhteuseiV kai ereiV proV autouV akousate logon kuriou
tade legei kurioV ouai toiV profhteuousin apo kardiaV autwn kai to kaqolou mh blepousin
oi profhtai sou israhl wV alwpekeV en taiV erhmoiV
ouk esthsan en sterewmati kai sunhgagon poimnia epi ton oikon tou israhl ouk anesthsan oi legonteV en hmera kuriou
bleponteV yeudh manteuomenoi mataia oi legonteV legei kurioV kai kurioV ouk apestalken autouV kai hrxanto tou anasthsai logon
ouc orasin yeudh ewrakate kai manteiaV mataiaV eirhkate
dia touto eipon tade legei kurioV anq' wn oi logoi umwn yeudeiV kai ai manteiai umwn mataiai dia touto idou egw ef' umaV legei kurioV

kai ektenw thn ceira mou epi touV profhtaV touV orwntaV yeudh kai touV apofqeggomenouV mataia en paideia tou laou mou ouk esontai oude en grafh oikou israhl ou grafhsontai kai eiV thn ghn tou israhl ouk eiseleusontai kai gnwsontai dioti egw kurioV
anq' wn ton laon mou eplanhsan legonteV eirhnh eirhnh kai ouk hn eirhnh kai outoV oikodomei toicon kai autoi aleifousin auton ei peseitai
eipon proV touV aleifontaV peseitai kai estai uetoV katakluzwn kai dwsw liqouV petrobolouV eiV touV endesmouV autwn kai pesountai kai pneuma exairon kai raghsetai
kai idou peptwken o toicoV kai ouk erousin proV umaV pou estin h aloifh umwn hn hleiyate
dia touto tade legei kurioV kai rhxw pnohn exairousan meta qumou kai uetoV katakluzwn en orgh mou estai kai touV liqouV touV petrobolouV en qumw epaxw eiV sunteleian
kai kataskayw ton toicon on hleiyate kai peseitai kai qhsw auton epi thn ghn kai apokalufqhsetai ta qemelia autou kai peseitai kai suntelesqhsesqe met' elegcwn kai epignwsesqe dioti egw kurioV
kai suntelesw ton qumon mou epi ton toicon kai epi touV aleifontaV auton kai peseitai kai eipa proV umaV ouk estin o toicoV oude oi aleifonteV auton
profhtai tou israhl oi profhteuonteV epi ierousalhm kai oi orwnteV auth eirhnhn kai eirhnh ouk estin legei kurioV
kai su uie anqrwpou sthrison to proswpon sou epi taV qugateraV tou laou sou taV profhteuousaV apo kardiaV autwn kai profhteuson ep' autaV

kai ereiV tade legei kurioV ouai taiV surraptousaiV proskefalaia epi panta agkwna ceiroV kai poiousaiV epibolaia epi pasan kefalhn pashV hlikiaV tou diastrefein yucaV ai yucai diestrafhsan tou laou mou kai yucaV periepoiounto

kai ebebhloun me proV ton laon mou eneken drakoV kriqwn kai eneken klasmatwn artou tou apokteinai yucaV aV ouk edei apoqanein kai tou peripoihsasqai yucaV aV ouk edei zhsai en tw apofqeggesqai umaV law eisakouonti mataia apofqegmata

dia touto tade legei kurioV kurioV idou egw epi ta proskefalaia umwn ef' a umeiV sustrefete ekei yucaV kai diarrhxw auta apo twn bracionwn umwn kai exapostelw taV yucaV aV umeiV ekstrefete taV yucaV autwn eiV diaskorpismon
kai diarrhxw ta epibolaia umwn kai rusomai ton laon mou ek ceiroV umwn kai ouketi esontai en cersin umwn eiV sustrofhn kai epignwsesqe dioti egw kurioV
anq' wn diestrefete kardian dikaiou adikwV kai egw ou diestrefon auton kai tou katiscusai ceiraV anomou to kaqolou mh apostreyai apo thV odou autou thV ponhraV kai zhsai auton
dia touto yeudh ou mh idhte kai manteiaV ou mh manteushsqe eti kai rusomai ton laon mou ek ceiroV umwn kai gnwsesqe oti egw kurioV
kai hlqon proV me andreV ek twn presbuterwn tou israhl kai ekaqisan pro proswpou mou
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn
uie anqrwpou oi andreV outoi eqento ta dianohmata autwn epi taV kardiaV autwn kai thn kolasin twn adikiwn autwn eqhkan pro proswpou autwn ei apokrinomenoV apokriqw autoiV

dia touto lalhson autoiV kai ereiV proV autouV tade legei kurioV anqrwpoV anqrwpoV ek tou oikou israhl oV an qh ta dianohmata autou epi thn kardian autou kai thn kolasin thV adikiaV autou taxh pro proswpou autou kai elqh proV ton profhthn egw kurioV apokriqhsomai autw en oiV enecetai h dianoia autou
opwV plagiash ton oikon tou israhl kata taV kardiaV autwn taV aphllotriwmenaV ap' emou en toiV enqumhmasin autwn
dia touto eipon proV ton oikon tou israhl tade legei kurioV kurioV epistrafhte kai apostreyate apo twn epithdeumatwn umwn kai apo paswn twn asebeiwn umwn kai epistreyate ta proswpa umwn

dioti anqrwpoV anqrwpoV ek tou oikou israhl kai ek twn proshlutwn twn proshluteuontwn en tw israhl oV an apallotriwqh ap' emou kai qhtai ta enqumhmata autou epi thn kardian autou kai thn kolasin thV adikiaV autou taxh pro proswpou autou kai elqh proV ton profhthn tou eperwthsai auton en emoi egw kurioV apokriqhsomai autw en w enecetai en autw
kai sthriw to proswpon mou epi ton anqrwpon ekeinon kai qhsomai auton eiV erhmon kai eiV afanismon kai exarw auton ek mesou tou laou mou kai epignwsesqe oti egw kurioV
kai o profhthV ean planhqh kai lalhsh egw kurioV peplanhka ton profhthn ekeinon kai ektenw thn ceira mou ep' auton kai afaniw auton ek mesou tou laou mou israhl
kai lhmyontai thn adikian autwn kata to adikhma tou eperwtwntoV kai kata to adikhma omoiwV tw profhth estai

kai epoihsa opwV to onoma mou to parapan mh bebhlwqh enwpion twn eqnwn wn autoi eisin en mesw autwn en oiV egnwsqhn proV autouV enwpion autwn tou exagagein autouV ek ghV aiguptou
kai exhgagon autouV ek ghV aiguptou kai hgagon autouV eiV thn erhmon
kai edwka autoiV ta prostagmata mou kai ta dikaiwmata mou egnwrisa autoiV osa poihsei auta anqrwpoV kai zhsetai en autoiV

kai parepikranan me kai ta tekna autwn en toiV prostagmasin mou ouk eporeuqhsan kai ta dikaiwmata mou ouk efulaxanto tou poiein auta a poihsei anqrwpoV kai zhsetai en autoiV kai ta sabbata mou ebebhloun kai eipa tou ekceai ton qumon mou ep' autouV en th erhmw tou suntelesai thn orghn mou ep' autouV
kai epoihsa opwV to onoma mou to parapan mh bebhlwqh enwpion twn eqnwn wn exhgagon autouV kat' ofqalmouV autwn

dia touto lalhson proV ton oikon tou israhl uie anqrwpou kai ereiV proV autouV tade legei kurioV ewV toutou parwrgisan me oi patereV umwn en toiV paraptwmasin autwn en oiV parepeson eiV eme

dia touto eipon proV ton oikon tou israhl tade legei kurioV ei en taiV anomiaiV twn paterwn umwn umeiV miainesqe kai opisw twn bdelugmatwn autwn umeiV ekporneuete

kai en taiV aparcaiV twn domatwn umwn en toiV aforismoiV umeiV miainesqe en pasin toiV enqumhmasin umwn ewV thV shmeron hmeraV kai egw apokriqw umin oikoV tou israhl zw egw legei kurioV ei apokriqhsomai umin kai ei anabhsetai epi to pneuma umwn touto
kai ouk estai on tropon umeiV legete esomeqa wV ta eqnh kai wV ai fulai thV ghV tou latreuein xuloiV kai liqoiV
dia touto zw egw legei kurioV en ceiri krataia kai en bracioni uyhlw kai en qumw kecumenw basileusw ef' umaV
kai exaxw umaV ek twn lawn kai eisdexomai umaV ek twn cwrwn ou dieskorpisqhte en autaiV en ceiri krataia kai en bracioni uyhlw kai en qumw kecumenw

en tw eipai me tw dikaiw outoV pepoiqen epi th dikaiosunh autou kai poihsh anomian pasai ai dikaiosunai autou ou mh anamnhsqwsin en th adikia autou h epoihsen en auth apoqaneitai
kai en tw eipai me tw asebei qanatw qanatwqhsh kai apostreyh apo thV amartiaV autou kai poihsh krima kai dikaiosunhn
kai enecurasma apodw kai arpagma apoteish en prostagmasin zwhV diaporeuhtai tou mh poihsai adikon zwh zhsetai kai ou mh apoqanh
pasai ai amartiai autou aV hmarten ou mh anamnhsqwsin oti krima kai dikaiosunhn epoihsen en autoiV zhsetai
kai erousin oi uioi tou laou sou ouk euqeia h odoV tou kuriou kai auth h odoV autwn ouk euqeia
en tw apostreyai dikaion apo thV dikaiosunhV autou kai poihsh anomiaV kai apoqaneitai en autaiV
kai en tw apostreyai ton amartwlon apo thV anomiaV autou kai poihsh krima kai dikaiosunhn en autoiV autoV zhsetai
kai touto estin o eipate ouk euqeia h odoV kuriou ekaston en taiV odoiV autou krinw umaV oikoV israhl
kai egenhqh en tw dwdekatw etei en tw dwdekatw mhni pempth tou mhnoV thV aicmalwsiaV hmwn hlqen o anaswqeiV proV me apo ierousalhm legwn ealw h poliV
kai egenhqh ep' eme ceir kuriou esperaV prin elqein auton kai hnoixen mou to stoma ewV hlqen proV me to prwi kai anoicqen mou to stoma ou sunesceqh eti
kai egenhqh logoV kuriou proV me legwn
uie anqrwpou oi katoikounteV taV hrhmwmenaV epi thV ghV tou israhl legousin eiV hn abraam kai katescen thn ghn kai hmeiV pleiouV esmen hmin dedotai h gh eiV katascesin
dia touto eipon autoiV tade legei kurioV kurioV

zw egw ei mhn oi en taiV hrhmwmenaiV macaira pesountai kai oi epi proswpou tou pediou toiV qhrioiV tou agrou doqhsontai eiV katabrwma kai touV en taiV teteicismenaiV kai touV en toiV sphlaioiV qanatw apoktenw
kai dwsw thn ghn erhmon kai apoleitai h ubriV thV iscuoV authV kai erhmwqhsetai ta orh tou israhl dia to mh einai diaporeuomenon
kai gnwsontai oti egw eimi kurioV kai poihsw thn ghn autwn erhmon kai erhmwqhsetai dia panta ta bdelugmata autwn a epoihsan

kai su uie anqrwpou oi uioi tou laou sou oi lalounteV peri sou para ta teich kai en toiV pulwsi twn oikiwn kai lalousin anqrwpoV tw adelfw autou legonteV sunelqwmen kai akouswmen ta ekporeuomena para kuriou
ercontai proV se wV sumporeuetai laoV kai kaqhntai enantion sou kai akouousin ta rhmata sou kai auta ou mh poihsousin oti yeudoV en tw stomati autwn kai opisw twn miasmatwn h kardia autwn
kai ginh autoiV wV fwnh yalthriou hdufwnou euarmostou kai akousontai sou ta rhmata kai ou mh poihsousin auta
kai hnika an elqh erousin idou hkei kai gnwsontai oti profhthV hn en mesw autwn
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn
uie anqrwpou profhteuson epi touV poimenaV tou israhl profhteuson kai eipon toiV poimesi tade legei kurioV kurioV w poimeneV israhl mh boskousin poimeneV eautouV ou ta probata boskousin oi poimeneV
idou to gala katesqete kai ta eria periballesqe kai to pacu sfazete kai ta probata mou ou boskete

to hsqenhkoV ouk eniscusate kai to kakwV econ ouk eswmatopoihsate kai to suntetrimmenon ou katedhsate kai to planwmenon ouk epestreyate kai to apolwloV ouk ezhthsate kai to iscuron kateirgasasqe mocqw
kai diesparh ta probata mou dia to mh einai poimenaV kai egenhqh eiV katabrwma pasi toiV qhrioiV tou agrou
kai diesparh mou ta probata en panti orei kai epi pan bounon uyhlon kai epi proswpou pashV thV ghV diesparh kai ouk hn o ekzhtwn oude o apostrefwn
dia touto poimeneV akousate logon kuriou

zw egw legei kurioV kurioV ei mhn anti tou genesqai ta probata mou eiV pronomhn kai genesqai ta probata mou eiV katabrwma pasi toiV qhrioiV tou pediou para to mh einai poimenaV kai ouk exezhthsan oi poimeneV ta probata mou kai eboskhsan oi poimeneV eautouV ta de probata mou ouk eboskhsan
anti toutou poimeneV

tade legei kurioV kurioV idou egw epi touV poimenaV kai ekzhthsw ta probata mou ek twn ceirwn autwn kai apostreyw autouV tou mh poimainein ta probata mou kai ou boskhsousin eti oi poimeneV auta kai exeloumai ta probata mou ek tou stomatoV autwn kai ouk esontai autoiV eti eiV katabrwma
dioti tade legei kurioV idou egw ekzhthsw ta probata mou kai episkeyomai auta

wsper zhtei o poimhn to poimnion autou en hmera otan h gnofoV kai nefelh en mesw probatwn diakecwrismenwn outwV ekzhthsw ta probata mou kai apelasw auta apo pantoV topou ou diesparhsan ekei en hmera nefelhV kai gnofou
kai exaxw autouV ek twn eqnwn kai sunaxw autouV apo twn cwrwn kai eisaxw autouV eiV thn ghn autwn kai boskhsw autouV epi ta orh israhl kai en taiV faragxin kai en pash katoikia thV ghV
en nomh agaqh boskhsw autouV kai en tw orei tw uyhlw israhl esontai ai mandrai autwn ekei koimhqhsontai kai ekei anapausontai en trufh agaqh kai en nomh pioni boskhqhsontai epi twn orewn israhl
egw boskhsw ta probata mou kai egw anapausw auta kai gnwsontai oti egw eimi kurioV tade legei kurioV kurioV
to apolwloV zhthsw kai to planwmenon epistreyw kai to suntetrimmenon katadhsw kai to ekleipon eniscusw kai to iscuron fulaxw kai boskhsw auta meta krimatoV
kai umeiV probata tade legei kurioV kurioV idou egw diakrinw ana meson probatou kai probatou kriwn kai tragwn
kai ouc ikanon umin oti thn kalhn nomhn enemesqe kai ta kataloipa thV nomhV umwn katepateite toiV posin umwn kai to kaqesthkoV udwr epinete kai to loipon toiV posin umwn etarassete
kai ta probata mou ta pathmata twn podwn umwn enemonto kai to tetaragmenon udwr upo twn podwn umwn epinon
dia touto tade legei kurioV kurioV idou egw diakrinw ana meson probatou iscurou kai ana meson probatou asqenouV
epi taiV pleuraiV kai toiV wmoiV umwn diwqeisqe kai toiV kerasin umwn ekeratizete kai pan to ekleipon exeqlibete
kai swsw ta probata mou kai ou mh wsin eti eiV pronomhn kai krinw ana meson kriou proV krion
kai anasthsw ep' autouV poimena ena kai poimanei autouV ton doulon mou dauid kai estai autwn poimhn
kai egw kurioV esomai autoiV eiV qeon kai dauid en mesw autwn arcwn egw kurioV elalhsa
kai diaqhsomai tw dauid diaqhkhn eirhnhV kai afaniw qhria ponhra apo thV ghV kai katoikhsousin en th erhmw kai upnwsousin en toiV drumoiV
kai dwsw autouV perikuklw tou orouV mou kai dwsw ton ueton umin ueton eulogiaV

kai ta xula ta en tw pediw dwsei ton karpon autwn kai h gh dwsei thn iscun authV kai katoikhsousin epi thV ghV autwn en elpidi eirhnhV kai gnwsontai oti egw eimi kurioV en tw suntriyai me ton zugon autwn kai exeloumai autouV ek ceiroV twn katadoulwsamenwn autouV
kai ouk esontai eti en pronomh toiV eqnesin kai ta qhria thV ghV ouketi mh fagwsin autouV kai katoikhsousin en elpidi kai ouk estai o ekfobwn autouV
kai anasthsw autoiV futon eirhnhV kai ouketi esontai apollumenoi limw epi thV ghV kai ou mh enegkwsin eti oneidismon eqnwn
kai gnwsontai oti egw eimi kurioV o qeoV autwn kai autoi laoV mou oikoV israhl legei kurioV
probata mou kai probata poimniou mou este kai egw kurioV o qeoV umwn legei kurioV kurioV
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn
uie anqrwpou epistreyon to proswpon sou ep' oroV shir kai profhteuson ep' auto
kai eipon tade legei kurioV kurioV idou egw epi se oroV shir kai ektenw thn ceira mou epi se kai dwsw se erhmon kai erhmwqhsh
kai taiV polesin sou erhmian poihsw kai su erhmoV esh kai gnwsh oti egw eimi kurioV
anti tou genesqai se ecqran aiwnian kai enekaqisaV tw oikw israhl dolw en ceiri ecqrwn macaira en kairw adikiaV ep' escatw
dia touto zw egw legei kurioV kurioV ei mhn eiV aima hmarteV kai aima se diwxetai
kai dwsw to oroV shir eiV erhmon kai hrhmwmenon kai apolw ap' autou anqrwpouV kai kthnh
kai emplhsw twn traumatiwn sou touV bounouV kai taV faraggaV sou kai en pasi toiV pedioiV sou tetraumatismenoi macaira pesountai en soi
erhmian aiwnion qhsomai se kai ai poleiV sou ou mh katoikhqwsin eti kai gnwsh oti egw eimi kurioV
dia to eipein se ta duo eqnh kai ai duo cwrai emai esontai kai klhronomhsw autaV kai kurioV ekei estin
dia touto zw egw legei kurioV kai poihsw soi kata thn ecqran sou kai gnwsqhsomai soi hnika an krinw se
kai gnwsh oti egw eimi kurioV hkousa thV fwnhV twn blasfhmiwn sou oti eipaV ta orh israhl erhma hmin dedotai eiV katabrwma
kai emegalorhmonhsaV ep' eme tw stomati sou egw hkousa
tade legei kurioV en th eufrosunh pashV thV ghV erhmon poihsw se
erhmon esh oroV shir kai pasa h idoumaia exanalwqhsetai kai gnwsh oti egw eimi kurioV o qeoV autwn
kai su uie anqrwpou profhteuson epi ta orh israhl kai eipon toiV oresin tou israhl akousate logon kuriou
tade legei kurioV kurioV anq' wn eipen o ecqroV ef' umaV euge erhma aiwnia eiV katascesin hmin egenhqh

dia touto profhteuson kai eipon tade legei kurioV kurioV anti tou atimasqhnai umaV kai mishqhnai umaV upo twn kuklw umwn tou einai umaV eiV katascesin toiV kataloipoiV eqnesin kai anebhte lalhma glwssh kai eiV oneidisma eqnesin

dia touto orh israhl akousate logon kuriou tade legei kurioV toiV oresin kai toiV bounoiV kai taiV faragxin kai toiV ceimarroiV kai toiV exhrhmwmenoiV kai hfanismenoiV kai taiV polesin taiV egkataleleimmenaiV ai egenonto eiV pronomhn kai eiV katapathma toiV kataleifqeisin eqnesin perikuklw

dia touto tade legei kurioV kurioV ei mhn en puri qumou mou elalhsa epi ta loipa eqnh kai epi thn idoumaian pasan oti edwkan thn ghn mou eautoiV eiV katascesin met' eufrosunhV atimasanteV yucaV tou afanisai en pronomh

dia touto profhteuson epi thn ghn tou israhl kai eipon toiV oresin kai toiV bounoiV kai taiV faragxin kai taiV napaiV tade legei kurioV idou egw en tw zhlw mou kai en tw qumw mou elalhsa anti tou oneidismouV eqnwn enegkai umaV
dia touto egw arw thn ceira mou epi ta eqnh ta perikuklw umwn outoi thn atimian autwn lhmyontai
umwn de orh israhl thn stafulhn kai ton karpon umwn katafagetai o laoV mou oti eggizousin tou elqein
oti idou egw ef' umaV kai epibleyw ef' umaV kai katergasqhsesqe kai sparhsesqe
kai plhqunw ef' umaV anqrwpouV pan oikon israhl eiV teloV kai katoikhqhsontai ai poleiV kai h hrhmwmenh oikodomhqhsetai
kai plhqunw ef' umaV anqrwpouV kai kthnh kai katoikiw umaV wV to en arch umwn kai eu poihsw umaV wsper ta emprosqen umwn kai gnwsesqe oti egw eimi kurioV
kai gennhsw ef' umaV anqrwpouV ton laon mou israhl kai klhronomhsousin umaV kai esesqe autoiV eiV katascesin kai ou mh prosteqhte eti ateknwqhnai ap' autwn
tade legei kurioV kurioV anq' wn eipan soi katesqousa anqrwpouV ei kai hteknwmenh upo tou eqnouV sou egenou
dia touto anqrwpouV ouketi fagesai kai to eqnoV sou ouk ateknwseiV eti legei kurioV kurioV
kai ouk akousqhsetai ouketi ef' umaV atimia eqnwn kai oneidismouV lawn ou mh anenegkhte legei kurioV kurioV
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn

uie anqrwpou oikoV israhl katwkhsen epi thV ghV autwn kai emianan authn en th odw autwn kai en toiV eidwloiV autwn kai en taiV akaqarsiaiV autwn kata thn akaqarsian thV apokaqhmenhV egenhqh h odoV autwn pro proswpou mou
kai execea ton qumon mou ep' autouV
kai diespeira autouV eiV ta eqnh kai elikmhsa autouV eiV taV cwraV kata thn odon autwn kai kata thn amartian autwn ekrina autouV
kai eishlqosan eiV ta eqnh ou eishlqosan ekei kai ebebhlwsan to onoma mou to agion en tw legesqai autouV laoV kuriou outoi kai ek thV ghV autou exelhluqasin
kai efeisamhn autwn dia to onoma mou to agion o ebebhlwsan oikoV israhl en toiV eqnesin ou eishlqosan ekei
dia touto eipon tw oikw israhl tade legei kurioV ouc umin egw poiw oikoV israhl all' h dia to onoma mou to agion o ebebhlwsate en toiV eqnesin ou eishlqete ekei
kai agiasw to onoma mou to mega to bebhlwqen en toiV eqnesin o ebebhlwsate en mesw autwn kai gnwsontai ta eqnh oti egw eimi kurioV en tw agiasqhnai me en umin kat' ofqalmouV autwn
kai lhmyomai umaV ek twn eqnwn kai aqroisw umaV ek paswn twn gaiwn kai eisaxw umaV eiV thn ghn umwn
kai ranw ef' umaV udwr kaqaron kai kaqarisqhsesqe apo paswn twn akaqarsiwn umwn kai apo pantwn twn eidwlwn umwn kai kaqariw umaV
kai dwsw umin kardian kainhn kai pneuma kainon dwsw en umin kai afelw thn kardian thn liqinhn ek thV sarkoV umwn kai dwsw umin kardian sarkinhn
kai to pneuma mou dwsw en umin kai poihsw ina en toiV dikaiwmasin mou poreuhsqe kai ta krimata mou fulaxhsqe kai poihshte
kai katoikhsete epi thV ghV hV edwka toiV patrasin umwn kai esesqe moi eiV laon kagw esomai umin eiV qeon
kai swsw umaV ek paswn twn akaqarsiwn umwn kai kalesw ton siton kai plhqunw auton kai ou dwsw ef' umaV limon
kai plhqunw ton karpon tou xulou kai ta genhmata tou agrou opwV mh labhte oneidismon limou en toiV eqnesin
kai mnhsqhsesqe taV odouV umwn taV ponhraV kai ta epithdeumata umwn ta mh agaqa kai prosocqieite kata proswpon autwn en taiV anomiaiV umwn kai epi toiV bdelugmasin umwn
ou di' umaV egw poiw legei kurioV kurioV gnwston estai umin aiscunqhte kai entraphte ek twn odwn umwn oikoV israhl
tade legei kurioV en hmera h kaqariw umaV ek paswn twn anomiwn umwn kai katoikiw taV poleiV kai oikodomhqhsontai ai erhmoi
kai h gh h hfanismenh ergasqhsetai anq' wn oti hfanismenh egenhqh kat' ofqalmouV pantoV parodeuontoV
kai erousin h gh ekeinh h hfanismenh egenhqh wV khpoV trufhV kai ai poleiV ai erhmoi kai hfanismenai kai kateskammenai ocurai ekaqisan
kai gnwsontai ta eqnh osa an kataleifqwsin kuklw umwn oti egw kurioV wkodomhsa taV kaqhrhmenaV kai katefuteusa taV hfanismenaV egw kurioV elalhsa kai poihsw
tade legei kurioV eti touto zhthqhsomai tw oikw israhl tou poihsai autoiV plhqunw autouV wV probata anqrwpouV
wV probata agia wV probata ierousalhm en taiV eortaiV authV outwV esontai ai poleiV ai erhmoi plhreiV probatwn anqrwpwn kai gnwsontai oti egw kurioV
kai egeneto ep' eme ceir kuriou kai exhgagen me en pneumati kurioV kai eqhken me en mesw tou pediou kai touto hn meston ostewn anqrwpinwn
kai perihgagen me ep' auta kukloqen kuklw kai idou polla sfodra epi proswpou tou pediou xhra sfodra
kai eipen proV me uie anqrwpou ei zhsetai ta osta tauta kai eipa kurie su episth tauta
kai eipen proV me profhteuson epi ta osta tauta kai ereiV autoiV ta osta ta xhra akousate logon kuriou
tade legei kurioV toiV osteoiV toutoiV idou egw ferw eiV umaV pneuma zwhV
kai dwsw ef' umaV neura kai anaxw ef' umaV sarkaV kai ektenw ef' umaV derma kai dwsw pneuma mou eiV umaV kai zhsesqe kai gnwsesqe oti egw eimi kurioV
kai eprofhteusa kaqwV eneteilato moi kai egeneto en tw eme profhteusai kai idou seismoV kai proshgage ta osta ekateron proV thn armonian autou
kai eidon kai idou ep' auta neura kai sarkeV efuonto kai anebainen ep' auta derma epanw kai pneuma ouk hn en autoiV
kai eipen proV me profhteuson uie anqrwpou profhteuson epi to pneuma kai eipon tw pneumati tade legei kurioV ek twn tessarwn pneumatwn elqe kai emfushson eiV touV nekrouV toutouV kai zhsatwsan
kai eprofhteusa kaqoti eneteilato moi kai eishlqen eiV autouV to pneuma kai ezhsan kai esthsan epi twn podwn autwn sunagwgh pollh sfodra
kai elalhsen kurioV proV me legwn uie anqrwpou ta osta tauta paV oikoV israhl estin kai autoi legousin xhra gegonen ta osta hmwn apolwlen h elpiV hmwn diapefwnhkamen
dia touto profhteuson kai eipon tade legei kurioV idou egw anoigw umwn ta mnhmata kai anaxw umaV ek twn mnhmatwn umwn kai eisaxw umaV eiV thn ghn tou israhl
kai gnwsesqe oti egw eimi kurioV en tw anoixai me touV tafouV umwn tou anagagein me ek twn tafwn ton laon mou
kai dwsw to pneuma mou eiV umaV kai zhsesqe kai qhsomai umaV epi thn ghn umwn kai gnwsesqe oti egw kurioV lelalhka kai poihsw legei kurioV
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn

uie anqrwpou labe seautw rabdon kai grayon ep' authn ton ioudan kai touV uiouV israhl touV proskeimenouV ep' auton kai rabdon deuteran lhmyh seautw kai grayeiV authn tw iwshf rabdon efraim kai pantaV touV uiouV israhl touV prosteqentaV proV auton
kai sunayeiV autaV proV allhlaV sautw eiV rabdon mian tou dhsai autaV kai esontai en th ceiri sou
kai estai otan legwsin proV se oi uioi tou laou sou ouk anaggeleiV hmin ti estin tauta soi

kai dwsw autouV eiV eqnoV en en th gh mou kai en toiV oresin israhl kai arcwn eiV estai autwn kai ouk esontai eti eiV duo eqnh oude mh diaireqwsin ouketi eiV duo basileiaV
ina mh miainwntai eti en toiV eidwloiV autwn kai rusomai autouV apo paswn twn anomiwn autwn wn hmartosan en autaiV kai kaqariw autouV kai esontai moi eiV laon kai egw kurioV esomai autoiV eiV qeon

kai katoikhsousin epi thV ghV autwn hn egw dedwka tw doulw mou iakwb ou katwkhsan ekei oi patereV autwn kai katoikhsousin ep' authV autoi kai dauid o douloV mou arcwn autwn estai eiV ton aiwna
kai diaqhsomai autoiV diaqhkhn eirhnhV diaqhkh aiwnia estai met' autwn kai qhsw ta agia mou en mesw autwn eiV ton aiwna
kai estai h kataskhnwsiV mou en autoiV kai esomai autoiV qeoV kai autoi mou esontai laoV

kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn

kai sunaxw se kai pasan thn dunamin sou ippouV kai ippeiV endedumenouV qwrakaV pantaV sunagwgh pollh peltai kai perikefalaiai kai macairai
persai kai aiqiopeV kai libueV panteV perikefalaiaiV kai peltaiV

kata to fwV tou en arch peripatou kai ta proV noton kata proswpon tou notou kata proswpon tou apoloipou kai kata proswpon tou diorizontoV exedrai

twn exedrwn twn proV noton kai kata ta qurwmata ap' archV tou peripatou wV epi fwV diasthmatoV kalamou kai kat' anatolaV tou eisporeuesqai di' autwn

kai sunetelesqh h diametrhsiV tou oikou eswqen kai exhgagen me kaq' odon thV pulhV thV blepoushV proV anatolaV kai diemetrhsen to upodeigma tou oikou kukloqen en diataxei
kai esth kata nwtou thV pulhV thV blepoushV kata anatolaV kai diemetrhsen pentakosiouV en tw kalamw tou metrou
kai epestreyen proV borran kai diemetrhsen to kata proswpon tou borra phceiV pentakosiouV en tw kalamw tou metrou
kai epestreyen proV qalassan kai diemetrhsen to kata proswpon thV qalasshV pentakosiouV en tw kalamw tou metrou
kai epestreyen proV noton kai diemetrhsen katenanti tou notou pentakosiouV en tw kalamw tou metrou

kai hgagen me epi thn pulhn thn blepousan kata anatolaV kai exhgagen me
kai idou doxa qeou israhl hrceto kata thn odon thV pulhV thV blepoushV proV anatolaV kai fwnh thV parembolhV wV fwnh diplasiazontwn pollwn kai h gh exelampen wV feggoV apo thV doxhV kukloqen
kai h orasiV hn eidon kata thn orasin hn eidon ote eiseporeuomhn tou crisai thn polin kai h orasiV tou armatoV ou eidon kata thn orasin hn eidon epi tou potamou tou cobar kai piptw epi proswpon mou
kai doxa kuriou eishlqen eiV ton oikon kata thn odon thV pulhV thV blepoushV kata anatolaV
kai anelaben me pneuma kai eishgagen me eiV thn aulhn thn eswteran kai idou plhrhV doxhV kuriou o oikoV
kai esthn kai idou fwnh ek tou oikou lalountoV proV me kai o anhr eisthkei ecomenoV mou

kai eipen proV me ewrakaV uie anqrwpou ton topon tou qronou mou kai ton topon tou icnouV twn podwn mou en oiV kataskhnwsei to onoma mou en mesw oikou israhl ton aiwna kai ou bebhlwsousin ouketi oikoV israhl to onoma to agion mou autoi kai oi hgoumenoi autwn en th porneia autwn kai en toiV fonoiV twn hgoumenwn en mesw autwn

en tw tiqenai autouV to proquron mou en toiV proquroiV autwn kai taV fliaV mou ecomenaV twn fliwn autwn kai edwkan ton toicon mou wV sunecomenon emou kai autwn kai ebebhlwsan to onoma to agion mou en taiV anomiaiV autwn aiV epoioun kai exetriya autouV en qumw mou kai en fonw
kai nun apwsasqwsan thn porneian autwn kai touV fonouV twn hgoumenwn autwn ap' emou kai kataskhnwsw en mesw autwn ton aiwna
kai su uie anqrwpou deixon tw oikw israhl ton oikon kai kopasousin apo twn amartiwn autwn kai thn orasin autou kai thn diataxin autou

kai autoi lhmyontai thn kolasin autwn peri pantwn wn epoihsan kai diagrayeiV ton oikon kai taV exodouV autou kai thn upostasin autou kai panta ta prostagmata autou kai panta ta nomima autou gnwrieiV autoiV kai diagrayeiV enantion autwn kai fulaxontai panta ta dikaiwmata mou kai panta ta prostagmata mou kai poihsousin auta
kai thn diagrafhn tou oikou epi thV korufhV tou orouV panta ta oria autou kukloqen agia agiwn
kai tauta ta metra tou qusiasthriou en phcei tou phceoV kai palaisthV kolpwma baqoV epi phcun kai phcuV to euroV kai geisoV epi to ceiloV autou kukloqen spiqamhV kai touto to uyoV tou qusiasthriou

ek baqouV thV archV tou koilwmatoV autou proV to ilasthrion to mega to upokatwqen phcwn duo kai to euroV phceoV kai apo tou ilasthriou tou mikrou epi to ilasthrion to mega phceiV tessareV kai euroV phcuV
kai to arihl phcwn tessarwn kai apo tou arihl kai uperanw twn keratwn phcuV
kai to arihl phcwn dwdeka mhkouV epi phceiV dwdeka platouV tetragwnon epi ta tessara merh autou

kai to ilasthrion phcwn deka tessarwn to mhkoV epi phceiV deka tessaraV to euroV epi tessara merh autou kai to geisoV autw kukloqen kukloumenon autw hmisu phceoV kai to kuklwma autou phcuV kukloqen kai oi klimakthreV autou bleponteV kat' anatolaV
kai eipen proV me uie anqrwpou tade legei kurioV o qeoV israhl tauta ta prostagmata tou qusiasthriou en hmera poihsewV autou tou anaferein ep' autou olokautwmata kai prosceein proV auto aima
kai dwseiV toiV iereusi toiV leuitaiV toiV ek tou spermatoV saddouk toiV eggizousi proV me legei kurioV o qeoV tou leitourgein moi moscon ek bown peri amartiaV
kai lhmyontai ek tou aimatoV autou kai epiqhsousin epi ta tessara kerata tou qusiasthriou kai epi taV tessaraV gwniaV tou ilasthriou kai epi thn basin kuklw kai exilasontai auto
kai lhmyontai ton moscon ton peri amartiaV kai katakauqhsetai en tw apokecwrismenw tou oikou exwqen twn agiwn
kai th hmera th deutera lhmyontai erifouV duo aigwn amwmouV uper amartiaV kai exilasontai to qusiasthrion kaqoti exilasanto en tw moscw
kai meta to suntelesai se ton exilasmon prosoisousi moscon ek bown amwmon kai krion ek probatwn amwmon
kai prosoisete enantion kuriou kai epirriyousin oi iereiV ep' auta ala kai anoisousin auta olokautwmata tw kuriw
epta hmeraV poihseiV erifon uper amartiaV kaq' hmeran kai moscon ek bown kai krion ek probatwn amwma poihsousin
epta hmeraV kai exilasontai to qusiasthrion kai kaqariousin auto kai plhsousin ceiraV autwn
kai estai apo thV hmeraV thV ogdohV kai epekeina poihsousin oi iereiV epi to qusiasthrion ta olokautwmata umwn kai ta tou swthriou umwn kai prosdexomai umaV legei kurioV
kai epestreyen me kata thn odon thV pulhV twn agiwn thV exwteraV thV blepoushV kat' anatolaV kai auth hn kekleismenh
kai eipen kurioV proV me h pulh auth kekleismenh estai ouk anoicqhsetai kai oudeiV mh dielqh di' authV oti kurioV o qeoV tou israhl eiseleusetai di' authV kai estai kekleismenh
dioti o hgoumenoV outoV kaqhsetai en auth tou fagein arton enantion kuriou kata thn odon ailam thV pulhV eiseleusetai kai kata thn odon autou exeleusetai
kai eishgagen me kata thn odon thV pulhV thV proV borran katenanti tou oikou kai eidon kai idou plhrhV doxhV o oikoV kuriou kai piptw epi proswpon mou

kai eipen kurioV proV me uie anqrwpou taxon eiV thn kardian sou kai ide toiV ofqalmoiV sou kai toiV wsin sou akoue panta osa egw lalw meta sou kata panta ta prostagmata oikou kuriou kai kata panta ta nomima autou kai taxeiV thn kardian sou eiV thn eisodon tou oikou kata pasaV taV exodouV autou en pasi toiV agioiV
kai ereiV proV ton oikon ton parapikrainonta proV ton oikon tou israhl tade legei kurioV o qeoV ikanousqw umin apo paswn twn anomiwn umwn oikoV israhl

tou eisagagein umaV uiouV allogeneiV aperitmhtouV kardia kai aperitmhtouV sarki tou ginesqai en toiV agioiV mou kai ebebhloun auta en tw prosferein umaV artouV stear kai aima kai parebainete thn diaqhkhn mou en pasaiV taiV anomiaiV umwn
kai dietaxate tou fulassein fulakaV en toiV agioiV mou
dia touto tade legei kurioV o qeoV paV uioV allogenhV aperitmhtoV kardia kai aperitmhtoV sarki ouk eiseleusetai eiV ta agia mou en pasin uioiV allogenwn twn ontwn en mesw oikou israhl
all' h oi leuitai oitineV afhlanto ap' emou en tw planasqai ton israhl ap' emou katopisqen twn enqumhmatwn autwn kai lhmyontai adikian autwn

kai esontai en toiV agioiV mou leitourgounteV qurwroi epi twn pulwn tou oikou kai leitourgounteV tw oikw outoi sfaxousin ta olokautwmata kai taV qusiaV tw law kai outoi sthsontai enantion tou laou tou leitourgein autoiV
anq' wn eleitourgoun autoiV pro proswpou twn eidwlwn autwn kai egeneto tw oikw israhl eiV kolasin adikiaV eneka toutou hra thn ceira mou ep' autouV legei kurioV o qeoV
kai ouk eggiousi proV me tou ierateuein moi oude tou prosagein proV ta agia uiwn tou israhl oude proV ta agia twn agiwn mou kai lhmyontai atimian autwn en th planhsei h eplanhqhsan
kai katataxousin autouV fulassein fulakaV tou oikou eiV panta ta erga autou kai eiV panta osa an poihswsin

oi iereiV oi leuitai oi uioi tou saddouk oitineV efulaxanto taV fulakaV twn agiwn mou en tw planasqai oikon israhl ap' emou outoi prosaxousin proV me tou leitourgein moi kai sthsontai pro proswpou mou tou prosferein moi qusian stear kai aima legei kurioV o qeoV
outoi eiseleusontai eiV ta agia mou kai outoi proseleusontai proV thn trapezan mou tou leitourgein moi kai fulaxousin taV fulakaV mou
kai estai en tw eisporeuesqai autouV taV pulaV thV aulhV thV eswteraV stolaV linaV endusontai kai ouk endusontai erea en tw leitourgein autouV apo thV pulhV thV eswteraV aulhV
kai kidareiV linaV exousin epi taiV kefalaiV autwn kai periskelh lina exousin epi taV osfuaV autwn kai ou perizwsontai bia
