kai taV kefalaV autwn ou xurhsontai kai taV komaV autwn ou yilwsousin kaluptonteV kaluyousin taV kefalaV autwn
kai oinon ou mh piwsin paV iereuV en tw eisporeuesqai autouV eiV thn aulhn thn eswteran
kai chran kai ekbeblhmenhn ou lhmyontai eautoiV eiV gunaika all' h parqenon ek tou spermatoV israhl kai chra ean genhtai ex ierewV lhmyontai
kai ton laon mou didaxousin ana meson agiou kai bebhlou kai ana meson akaqartou kai kaqarou gnwriousin autoiV

kai epi krisin aimatoV outoi episthsontai tou diakrinein ta dikaiwmata mou dikaiwsousin kai ta krimata mou krinousin kai ta nomima mou kai ta prostagmata mou en pasaiV taiV eortaiV mou fulaxontai kai ta sabbata mou agiasousin
kai epi yuchn anqrwpou ouk eiseleusontai tou mianqhnai all' h epi patri kai epi mhtri kai epi uiw kai epi qugatri kai epi adelfw kai epi adelfh autou h ou gegonen andri mianqhsetai
kai meta to kaqarisqhnai auton epta hmeraV exariqmhsei autw
kai h an hmera eisporeuwntai eiV thn aulhn thn eswteran tou leitourgein en tw agiw prosoisousin ilasmon legei kurioV o qeoV
kai estai autoiV eiV klhronomian egw klhronomia autoiV kai katascesiV autoiV ou doqhsetai en toiV uioiV israhl oti egw katascesiV autwn
kai taV qusiaV kai ta uper amartiaV kai ta uper agnoiaV outoi fagontai kai pan aforisma en tw israhl autoiV estai
aparcai pantwn kai ta prwtotoka pantwn kai ta afairemata panta ek pantwn twn aparcwn umwn toiV iereusin estai kai ta prwtogenhmata umwn dwsete tw ierei tou qeinai eulogiaV umwn epi touV oikouV umwn

kai en tw katametreisqai umaV thn ghn en klhronomia aforieite aparchn tw kuriw agion apo thV ghV pente kai eikosi ciliadaV mhkoV kai euroV eikosi ciliadaV agion estai en pasi toiV orioiV autou kukloqen
kai estai ek toutou eiV agiasma pentakosioi epi pentakosiouV tetragwnon kukloqen kai phceiV penthkonta diasthma autw kukloqen
kai ek tauthV thV diametrhsewV diametrhseiV mhkoV pente kai eikosi ciliadaV kai euroV deka ciliadaV kai en auth estai to agiasma agia twn agiwn
apo thV ghV estai toiV iereusin toiV leitourgousin en tw agiw kai estai toiV eggizousi leitourgein tw kuriw kai estai autoiV topoV eiV oikouV afwrismenouV tw agiasmw autwn

kai outwV poihseiV en tw ebdomw mhni mia tou mhnoV lhmyh par' ekastou apomoiran kai exilasesqe ton oikon

kai qusian pemma tw moscw kai pemma tw kriw poihseiV kai elaiou to in tw pemmati

kai o afhgoumenoV en mesw autwn en tw eisporeuesqai autouV eiseleusetai met' autwn kai en tw ekporeuesqai autouV exeleusetai
kai en taiV eortaiV kai en taiV panhguresin estai to manaa pemma tw moscw kai pemma tw kriw kai toiV amnoiV kaqwV an ekpoih h ceir autou kai elaiou to in tw pemmati

akousate dh tauta oi presbuteroi kai enwtisasqe panteV oi katoikounteV thn ghn ei gegonen toiauta en taiV hmeraiV umwn h en taiV hmeraiV twn paterwn umwn
uper autwn toiV teknoiV umwn dihghsasqe kai ta tekna umwn toiV teknoiV autwn kai ta tekna autwn eiV genean eteran
ta kataloipa thV kamphV katefagen h akriV kai ta kataloipa thV akridoV katefagen o broucoV kai ta kataloipa tou broucou katefagen h erusibh
eknhyate oi mequonteV ex oinou autwn kai klausate qrhnhsate panteV oi pinonteV oinon eiV meqhn oti exhrtai ek stomatoV umwn eufrosunh kai cara
oti eqnoV anebh epi thn ghn mou iscuron kai anariqmhton oi odonteV autou odonteV leontoV kai ai mulai autou skumnou
eqeto thn ampelon mou eiV afanismon kai taV sukaV mou eiV sugklasmon ereunwn exhreunhsen authn kai erriyen eleukanen klhmata authV
qrhnhson proV me uper numfhn periezwsmenhn sakkon epi ton andra authV ton parqenikon
exhrtai qusia kai spondh ex oikou kuriou penqeite oi iereiV oi leitourgounteV qusiasthriw
oti tetalaipwrhken ta pedia penqeitw h gh oti tetalaipwrhken sitoV exhranqh oinoV wligwqh elaion
exhranqhsan oi gewrgoi qrhneite kthmata uper purou kai kriqhV oti apolwlen trughtoV ex agrou
h ampeloV exhranqh kai ai sukai wligwqhsan roa kai foinix kai mhlon kai panta ta xula tou agrou exhranqhsan oti hscunan caran oi uioi twn anqrwpwn
perizwsasqe kai koptesqe oi iereiV qrhneite oi leitourgounteV qusiasthriw eiselqate upnwsate en sakkoiV leitourgounteV qew oti apeschken ex oikou qeou umwn qusia kai spondh
agiasate nhsteian khruxate qerapeian sunagagete presbuterouV pantaV katoikountaV ghn eiV oikon qeou umwn kai kekraxate proV kurion ektenwV
oimmoi oimmoi oimmoi eiV hmeran oti egguV hmera kuriou kai wV talaipwria ek talaipwriaV hxei
katenanti twn ofqalmwn umwn brwmata exwleqreuqh ex oikou qeou umwn eufrosunh kai cara
eskirthsan damaleiV epi taiV fatnaiV autwn hfanisqhsan qhsauroi kateskafhsan lhnoi oti exhranqh sitoV
ti apoqhsomen eautoiV eklausan boukolia bown oti ouc uphrcen nomh autoiV kai ta poimnia twn probatwn hfanisqhsan
proV se kurie bohsomai oti pur anhlwsen ta wraia thV erhmou kai flox anhyen panta ta xula tou agrou
kai ta kthnh tou pediou anebleyan proV se oti exhranqhsan afeseiV udatwn kai pur katefagen ta wraia thV erhmou
salpisate salpiggi en siwn khruxate en orei agiw mou kai sugcuqhtwsan panteV oi katoikounteV thn ghn dioti parestin hmera kuriou oti egguV

hmera skotouV kai gnofou hmera nefelhV kai omiclhV wV orqroV cuqhsetai epi ta orh laoV poluV kai iscuroV omoioV autw ou gegonen apo tou aiwnoV kai met' auton ou prosteqhsetai ewV etwn eiV geneaV genewn
ta emprosqen autou pur analiskon kai ta opisw autou anaptomenh flox wV paradeisoV trufhV h gh pro proswpou autou kai ta opisqen autou pedion afanismou kai anaswzomenoV ouk estai autw
wV orasiV ippwn h oyiV autwn kai wV ippeiV outwV katadiwxontai
wV fwnh armatwn epi taV korufaV twn orewn exalountai kai wV fwnh flogoV puroV katesqioushV kalamhn kai wV laoV poluV kai iscuroV paratassomenoV eiV polemon
apo proswpou autou suntribhsontai laoi pan proswpon wV proskauma cutraV
wV machtai dramountai kai wV andreV polemistai anabhsontai epi ta teich kai ekastoV en th odw autou poreusetai kai ou mh ekklinwsin taV tribouV autwn
kai ekastoV apo tou adelfou autou ouk afexetai katabarunomenoi en toiV oploiV autwn poreusontai kai en toiV belesin autwn pesountai kai ou mh suntelesqwsin
thV polewV epilhmyontai kai epi twn teicewn dramountai kai epi taV oikiaV anabhsontai kai dia quridwn eiseleusontai wV kleptai
pro proswpou autwn sugcuqhsetai h gh kai seisqhsetai o ouranoV o hlioV kai h selhnh suskotasousin kai ta astra dusousin to feggoV autwn

kai kurioV dwsei fwnhn autou pro proswpou dunamewV autou oti pollh estin sfodra h parembolh autou oti iscura erga logwn autou dioti megalh h hmera tou kuriou megalh kai epifanhV sfodra kai tiV estai ikanoV auth
kai nun legei kurioV o qeoV umwn epistrafhte proV me ex olhV thV kardiaV umwn kai en nhsteia kai en klauqmw kai en kopetw
kai diarrhxate taV kardiaV umwn kai mh ta imatia umwn kai epistrafhte proV kurion ton qeon umwn oti elehmwn kai oiktirmwn estin makroqumoV kai polueleoV kai metanown epi taiV kakiaiV
tiV oiden ei epistreyei kai metanohsei kai upoleiyetai opisw autou eulogian qusian kai spondhn kuriw tw qew hmwn
salpisate salpiggi en siwn agiasate nhsteian khruxate qerapeian
sunagagete laon agiasate ekklhsian eklexasqe presbuterouV sunagagete nhpia qhlazonta mastouV exelqatw numfioV ek tou koitwnoV autou kai numfh ek tou pastou authV

ana meson thV krhpidoV tou qusiasthriou klausontai oi iereiV oi leitourgounteV kuriw kai erousin feisai kurie tou laou sou kai mh dwV thn klhronomian sou eiV oneidoV tou katarxai autwn eqnh opwV mh eipwsin en toiV eqnesin pou estin o qeoV autwn
kai ezhlwsen kurioV thn ghn autou kai efeisato tou laou autou
kai apekriqh kurioV kai eipen tw law autou idou egw exapostellw umin ton siton kai ton oinon kai to elaion kai emplhsqhsesqe autwn kai ou dwsw umaV ouketi eiV oneidismon en toiV eqnesi

kai ton apo borra ekdiwxw af' umwn kai exwsw auton eiV ghn anudron kai afaniw to proswpon autou eiV thn qalassan thn prwthn kai ta opisw autou eiV thn qalassan thn escathn kai anabhsetai h sapria autou kai anabhsetai o bromoV autou oti emegalunen ta erga autou
qarsei gh caire kai eufrainou oti emegalunen kurioV tou poihsai
qarseite kthnh tou pediou oti beblasthken pedia thV erhmou oti xulon hnegken ton karpon autou ampeloV kai sukh edwkan thn iscun autwn
kai ta tekna siwn cairete kai eufrainesqe epi tw kuriw qew umwn dioti edwken umin ta brwmata eiV dikaiosunhn kai brexei umin ueton proimon kai oyimon kaqwV emprosqen
kai plhsqhsontai ai alwneV sitou kai uperekcuqhsontai ai lhnoi oinou kai elaiou
kai antapodwsw umin anti twn etwn wn katefagen h akriV kai o broucoV kai h erusibh kai h kamph h dunamiV mou h megalh hn exapesteila eiV umaV
kai fagesqe esqionteV kai emplhsqhsesqe kai ainesete to onoma kuriou tou qeou umwn a epoihsen meq' umwn eiV qaumasia kai ou mh kataiscunqh o laoV mou eiV ton aiwna
kai epignwsesqe oti en mesw tou israhl egw eimi kai egw kurioV o qeoV umwn kai ouk estin eti plhn emou kai ou mh kataiscunqwsin ouketi paV o laoV mou eiV ton aiwna

kai estai meta tauta kai ekcew apo tou pneumatoV mou epi pasan sarka kai profhteusousin oi uioi umwn kai ai qugatereV umwn kai oi presbuteroi umwn enupnia enupniasqhsontai kai oi neaniskoi umwn oraseiV oyontai
kai epi touV doulouV kai epi taV doulaV en taiV hmeraiV ekeinaiV ekcew apo tou pneumatoV mou
kai dwsw terata en tw ouranw kai epi thV ghV aima kai pur kai atmida kapnou
o hlioV metastrafhsetai eiV skotoV kai h selhnh eiV aima prin elqein hmeran kuriou thn megalhn kai epifanh
kai estai paV oV an epikaleshtai to onoma kuriou swqhsetai oti en tw orei siwn kai en ierousalhm estai anaswzomenoV kaqoti eipen kurioV kai euaggelizomenoi ouV kurioV proskeklhtai
dioti idou egw en taiV hmeraiV ekeinaiV kai en tw kairw ekeinw otan epistreyw thn aicmalwsian iouda kai ierousalhm

kai sunaxw panta ta eqnh kai kataxw auta eiV thn koilada iwsafat kai diakriqhsomai proV autouV ekei uper tou laou mou kai thV klhronomiaV mou israhl oi diesparhsan en toiV eqnesin kai thn ghn mou katadieilanto
kai epi ton laon mou ebalon klhrouV kai edwkan ta paidaria pornaiV kai ta korasia epwloun anti oinou kai epinon
kai ti kai umeiV emoi turoV kai sidwn kai pasa galilaia allofulwn mh antapodoma umeiV antapodidote moi h mnhsikakeite umeiV ep' emoi oxewV kai tacewV antapodwsw to antapodoma umwn eiV kefalaV umwn
anq' wn to argurion mou kai to crusion mou elabete kai ta epilekta mou kai ta kala eishnegkate eiV touV naouV umwn
kai touV uiouV iouda kai touV uiouV ierousalhm apedosqe toiV uioiV twn ellhnwn opwV exwshte autouV ek twn oriwn autwn
idou egw exegeirw autouV ek tou topou ou apedosqe autouV ekei kai antapodwsw to antapodoma umwn eiV kefalaV umwn
kai apodwsomai touV uiouV umwn kai taV qugateraV umwn eiV ceiraV uiwn iouda kai apodwsontai autouV eiV aicmalwsian eiV eqnoV makran apecon oti kurioV elalhsen
khruxate tauta en toiV eqnesin agiasate polemon exegeirate touV machtaV prosagagete kai anabainete panteV andreV polemistai
sugkoyate ta arotra umwn eiV romfaiaV kai ta drepana umwn eiV seiromastaV o adunatoV legetw oti iscuw egw
sunaqroizesqe kai eisporeuesqe panta ta eqnh kukloqen kai sunacqhte ekei o prauV estw machthV
exegeiresqwsan kai anabainetwsan panta ta eqnh eiV thn koilada iwsafat dioti ekei kaqiw tou diakrinai panta ta eqnh kukloqen
exaposteilate drepana oti paresthken trughtoV eisporeuesqe pateite dioti plhrhV h lhnoV uperekceitai ta upolhnia oti peplhquntai ta kaka autwn
hcoi exhchsan en th koiladi thV dikhV oti egguV hmera kuriou en th koiladi thV dikhV
o hlioV kai h selhnh suskotasousin kai oi astereV dusousin feggoV autwn
o de kurioV ek siwn anakekraxetai kai ex ierousalhm dwsei fwnhn autou kai seisqhsetai o ouranoV kai h gh o de kurioV feisetai tou laou autou kai eniscusei kurioV touV uiouV israhl
kai epignwsesqe dioti egw kurioV o qeoV umwn o kataskhnwn en siwn en orei agiw mou kai estai ierousalhm poliV agia kai allogeneiV ou dieleusontai di' authV ouketi

kai estai en th hmera ekeinh apostalaxei ta orh glukasmon kai oi bounoi ruhsontai gala kai pasai ai afeseiV iouda ruhsontai udata kai phgh ex oikou kuriou exeleusetai kai potiei ton ceimarroun twn scoinwn
aiguptoV eiV afanismon estai kai h idoumaia eiV pedion afanismou estai ex adikiwn uiwn iouda anq' wn execean aima dikaion en th gh autwn
h de ioudaia eiV ton aiwna katoikhqhsetai kai ierousalhm eiV geneaV genewn
kai ekdikhsw to aima autwn kai ou mh aqwwsw kai kurioV kataskhnwsei en siwn . ______________________________________________________________________________
logoi amwV oi egenonto en nakkarim ek qekoue ouV eiden uper ierousalhm en hmeraiV oziou basilewV iouda kai en hmeraiV ieroboam tou iwaV basilewV israhl pro duo etwn tou seismou
kai eipen kurioV ek siwn efqegxato kai ex ierousalhm edwken fwnhn autou kai epenqhsan ai nomai twn poimenwn kai exhranqh h korufh tou karmhlou
kai eipen kurioV epi taiV trisin asebeiaiV damaskou kai epi taiV tessarsin ouk apostrafhsomai auton anq' wn eprizon priosin sidhroiV taV en gastri ecousaV twn en galaad
kai exapostelw pur eiV ton oikon azahl kai katafagetai qemelia uiou ader
kai suntriyw moclouV damaskou kai exoleqreusw katoikountaV ek pediou wn kai katakoyw fulhn ex andrwn carran kai aicmalwteuqhsetai laoV suriaV epiklhtoV legei kurioV
tade legei kurioV epi taiV trisin asebeiaiV gazhV kai epi taiV tessarsin ouk apostrafhsomai autouV eneken tou aicmalwteusai autouV aicmalwsian tou salwmwn tou sugkleisai eiV thn idoumaian
kai exapostelw pur epi ta teich gazhV kai katafagetai qemelia authV
kai exoleqreusw katoikountaV ex azwtou kai exarqhsetai fulh ex askalwnoV kai epaxw thn ceira mou epi akkarwn kai apolountai oi kataloipoi twn allofulwn legei kurioV
tade legei kurioV epi taiV trisin asebeiaiV turou kai epi taiV tessarsin ouk apostrafhsomai authn anq' wn sunekleisan aicmalwsian tou salwmwn eiV thn idoumaian kai ouk emnhsqhsan diaqhkhV adelfwn
kai exapostelw pur epi ta teich turou kai katafagetai qemelia authV

tade legei kurioV epi taiV trisin asebeiaiV thV idoumaiaV kai epi taiV tessarsin ouk apostrafhsomai autouV eneka tou diwxai autouV en romfaia ton adelfon autou kai elumhnato mhtran epi ghV kai hrpasen eiV marturion frikhn autou kai to ormhma autou efulaxen eiV neikoV
kai exapostelw pur eiV qaiman kai katafagetai qemelia teicewn authV
tade legei kurioV epi taiV trisin asebeiaiV uiwn ammwn kai epi taiV tessarsin ouk apostrafhsomai auton anq' wn anescizon taV en gastri ecousaV twn galaaditwn opwV emplatunwsin ta oria autwn
kai anayw pur epi ta teich rabba kai katafagetai qemelia authV meta kraughV en hmera polemou kai seisqhsetai en hmera sunteleiaV authV
kai poreusontai oi basileiV authV en aicmalwsia oi iereiV autwn kai oi arconteV autwn epi to auto legei kurioV
tade legei kurioV epi taiV trisin asebeiaiV mwab kai epi taiV tessarsin ouk apostrafhsomai auton anq' wn katekausan ta osta basilewV thV idoumaiaV eiV konian
kai exapostelw pur epi mwab kai katafagetai qemelia twn polewn authV kai apoqaneitai en adunamia mwab meta kraughV kai meta fwnhV salpiggoV
kai exoleqreusw krithn ex authV kai pantaV touV arcontaV authV apoktenw met' autou legei kurioV

tade legei kurioV epi taiV trisin asebeiaiV uiwn iouda kai epi taiV tessarsin ouk apostrafhsomai auton eneka tou apwsasqai autouV ton nomon kuriou kai ta prostagmata autou ouk efulaxanto kai eplanhsen autouV ta mataia autwn a epoihsan oiV exhkolouqhsan oi patereV autwn opisw autwn
kai exapostelw pur epi ioudan kai katafagetai qemelia ierousalhm
tade legei kurioV epi taiV trisin asebeiaiV israhl kai epi taiV tessarsin ouk apostrafhsomai auton anq' wn apedonto arguriou dikaion kai penhta eneken upodhmatwn

ta patounta epi ton coun thV ghV kai ekondulizon eiV kefalaV ptwcwn kai odon tapeinwn exeklinan kai uioV kai pathr autou eiseporeuonto proV thn authn paidiskhn opwV bebhlwswsin to onoma tou qeou autwn
kai ta imatia autwn desmeuonteV scoinioiV parapetasmata epoioun ecomena tou qusiasthriou kai oinon ek sukofantiwn epinon en tw oikw tou qeou autwn
egw de exhra ton amorraion ek proswpou autwn ou hn kaqwV uyoV kedrou to uyoV autou kai iscuroV hn wV druV kai exhra ton karpon autou epanwqen kai taV rizaV autou upokatwqen
kai egw anhgagon umaV ek ghV aiguptou kai perihgagon umaV en th erhmw tessarakonta eth tou kataklhronomhsai thn ghn twn amorraiwn
kai elabon ek twn uiwn umwn eiV profhtaV kai ek twn neaniskwn umwn eiV agiasmon mh ouk estin tauta uioi israhl legei kurioV
kai epotizete touV hgiasmenouV oinon kai toiV profhtaiV enetellesqe legonteV ou mh profhteushte
dia touto idou egw kuliw upokatw umwn on tropon kulietai h amaxa h gemousa kalamhV
kai apoleitai fugh ek dromewV kai o krataioV ou mh krathsh thV iscuoV autou kai o machthV ou mh swsh thn yuchn autou
kai o toxothV ou mh uposth kai o oxuV toiV posin autou ou mh diaswqh oude o ippeuV ou mh swsh thn yuchn autou
kai eurhsei thn kardian autou en dunasteiaiV o gumnoV diwxetai en ekeinh th hmera legei kurioV
akousate ton logon touton on elalhsen kurioV ef' umaV oikoV israhl kai kata pashV fulhV hV anhgagon ek ghV aiguptou legwn
plhn umaV egnwn ek paswn fulwn thV ghV dia touto ekdikhsw ef' umaV pasaV taV amartiaV umwn
ei poreusontai duo epi to auto kaqolou ean mh gnwriswsin eautouV
ei ereuxetai lewn ek tou drumou autou qhran ouk ecwn ei dwsei skumnoV fwnhn autou ek thV mandraV autou kaqolou ean mh arpash ti
ei peseitai orneon epi thn ghn aneu ixeutou ei scasqhsetai pagiV epi thV ghV aneu tou sullabein ti
ei fwnhsei salpigx en polei kai laoV ou ptohqhsetai ei estai kakia en polei hn kurioV ouk epoihsen
dioti ou mh poihsh kurioV o qeoV pragma ean mh apokaluyh paideian autou proV touV doulouV autou touV profhtaV
lewn ereuxetai kai tiV ou fobhqhsetai kurioV o qeoV elalhsen kai tiV ou profhteusei
apaggeilate cwraiV en assurioiV kai epi taV cwraV thV aiguptou kai eipate sunacqhte epi to oroV samareiaV kai idete qaumasta polla en mesw authV kai thn katadunasteian thn en auth
kai ouk egnw a estai enantion authV legei kurioV oi qhsaurizonteV adikian kai talaipwrian en taiV cwraiV autwn
dia touto tade legei kurioV o qeoV turoV kukloqen h gh sou erhmwqhsetai kai kataxei ek sou iscun sou kai diarpaghsontai ai cwrai sou
tade legei kurioV on tropon otan ekspash o poimhn ek stomatoV tou leontoV duo skelh h lobon wtiou outwV ekspasqhsontai oi uioi israhl oi katoikounteV en samareia katenanti fulhV kai en damaskw iereiV
akousate kai epimarturasqe tw oikw iakwb legei kurioV o qeoV o pantokratwr
dioti en th hmera otan ekdikw asebeiaV tou israhl ep' auton kai ekdikhsw epi ta qusiasthria baiqhl kai kataskafhsetai ta kerata tou qusiasthriou kai pesountai epi thn ghn
sugcew kai pataxw ton oikon ton peripteron epi ton oikon ton qerinon kai apolountai oikoi elefantinoi kai prosteqhsontai oikoi eteroi polloi legei kurioV
akousate ton logon touton damaleiV thV basanitidoV ai en tw orei thV samareiaV ai katadunasteuousai ptwcouV kai katapatousai penhtaV ai legousai toiV kurioiV autwn epidote hmin opwV piwmen
omnuei kurioV kata twn agiwn autou dioti idou hmerai ercontai ef' umaV kai lhmyontai umaV en oploiV kai touV meq' umwn eiV lebhtaV upokaiomenouV embalousin empuroi loimoi
kai exenecqhsesqe gumnai katenanti allhlwn kai aporrifhsesqe eiV to oroV to remman legei kurioV o qeoV
eishlqate eiV baiqhl kai hnomhsate kai eiV galgala eplhqunate tou asebhsai kai hnegkate eiV to prwi qusiaV umwn eiV thn trihmerian ta epidekata umwn
kai anegnwsan exw nomon kai epekalesanto omologiaV apaggeilate oti tauta hgaphsan oi uioi israhl legei kurioV o qeoV
kai egw dwsw umin gomfiasmon odontwn en pasaiV taiV polesin umwn kai endeian artwn en pasi toiV topoiV umwn kai ouk epestreyate proV me legei kurioV
kai egw anescon ex umwn ton ueton pro triwn mhnwn tou trughtou kai brexw epi polin mian epi de polin mian ou brexw meriV mia brachsetai kai meriV ef' hn ou brexw ep' authn xhranqhsetai
kai sunaqroisqhsontai duo kai treiV poleiV eiV polin mian tou piein udwr kai ou mh emplhsqwsin kai ouk epestreyate proV me legei kurioV
epataxa umaV en purwsei kai en ikterw eplhqunate khpouV umwn ampelwnaV umwn kai sukwnaV umwn kai elaiwnaV umwn katefagen h kamph kai oud' wV epestreyate proV me legei kurioV

exapesteila eiV umaV qanaton en odw aiguptou kai apekteina en romfaia touV neaniskouV umwn meta aicmalwsiaV ippwn sou kai anhgagon en puri taV parembolaV umwn en th orgh mou kai oud' wV epestreyate proV me legei kurioV
katestreya umaV kaqwV katestreyen o qeoV sodoma kai gomorra kai egenesqe wV daloV exespasmenoV ek puroV kai oud' wV epestreyate proV me legei kurioV
dia touto outwV poihsw soi israhl plhn oti outwV poihsw soi etoimazou tou epikaleisqai ton qeon sou israhl
dioti idou egw sterewn bronthn kai ktizwn pneuma kai apaggellwn eiV anqrwpouV ton criston autou poiwn orqron kai omiclhn kai epibainwn epi ta uyh thV ghV kurioV o qeoV o pantokratwr onoma autw
akousate ton logon kuriou touton on egw lambanw ef' umaV qrhnon oikoV israhl
epesen ouketi mh prosqh tou anasthnai parqenoV tou israhl esfalen epi thV ghV authV ouk estin o anasthswn authn
dioti tade legei kurioV kurioV h poliV ex hV exeporeuonto cilioi upoleifqhsontai ekaton kai ex hV exeporeuonto ekaton upoleifqhsontai deka tw oikw israhl
dioti tade legei kurioV proV ton oikon israhl ekzhthsate me kai zhsesqe
kai mh ekzhteite baiqhl kai eiV galgala mh eisporeuesqe kai epi to frear tou orkou mh diabainete oti galgala aicmalwteuomenh aicmalwteuqhsetai kai baiqhl estai wV ouc uparcousa
ekzhthsate ton kurion kai zhsate opwV mh analamyh wV pur o oikoV iwshf kai katafagetai auton kai ouk estai o sbeswn tw oikw israhl
kurioV o poiwn eiV uyoV krima kai dikaiosunhn eiV ghn eqhken

poiwn panta kai metaskeuazwn kai ektrepwn eiV to prwi skian qanatou kai hmeran eiV nukta suskotazwn o proskaloumenoV to udwr thV qalasshV kai ekcewn auto epi proswpou thV ghV kurioV o qeoV o pantokratwr onoma autw
o diairwn suntrimmon ep' iscun kai talaipwrian epi ocurwma epagwn
emishsan en pulaiV elegconta kai logon osion ebdeluxanto

dia touto anq' wn katekondulizete ptwcouV kai dwra eklekta edexasqe par' autwn oikouV xustouV wkodomhsate kai ou mh katoikhshte en autoiV ampelwnaV epiqumhtouV efuteusate kai ou mh pihte ton oinon ex autwn
oti egnwn pollaV asebeiaV umwn kai iscurai ai amartiai umwn katapatounteV dikaion lambanonteV allagmata kai penhtaV en pulaiV ekklinonteV
dia touto o suniwn en tw kairw ekeinw siwphsetai oti kairoV ponhroV estin
ekzhthsate to kalon kai mh to ponhron opwV zhshte kai estai outwV meq' umwn kurioV o qeoV o pantokratwr on tropon eipate
memishkamen ta ponhra kai hgaphkamen ta kala kai apokatasthsate en pulaiV krima opwV elehsh kurioV o qeoV o pantokratwr touV periloipouV tou iwshf
dia touto tade legei kurioV o qeoV o pantokratwr en pasaiV plateiaiV kopetoV kai en pasaiV odoiV rhqhsetai ouai ouai klhqhsetai gewrgoV eiV penqoV kai kopeton kai eiV eidotaV qrhnon
kai en pasaiV odoiV kopetoV dioti dieleusomai dia mesou sou eipen kurioV
ouai oi epiqumounteV thn hmeran kuriou ina ti auth umin h hmera tou kuriou kai auth estin skotoV kai ou fwV
on tropon otan fugh anqrwpoV ek proswpou tou leontoV kai empesh autw h arkoV kai eisphdhsh eiV ton oikon autou kai apereishtai taV ceiraV autou epi ton toicon kai dakh auton o ofiV
ouci skotoV h hmera tou kuriou kai ou fwV kai gnofoV ouk ecwn feggoV auth
memishka apwsmai eortaV umwn kai ou mh osfranqw en taiV panhguresin umwn
dioti kai ean enegkhte moi olokautwmata kai qusiaV umwn ou prosdexomai auta kai swthriou epifaneiaV umwn ouk epibleyomai
metasthson ap' emou hcon wdwn sou kai yalmon organwn sou ouk akousomai
kai kulisqhsetai wV udwr krima kai dikaiosunh wV ceimarrouV abatoV
mh sfagia kai qusiaV proshnegkate moi en th erhmw tessarakonta eth oikoV israhl
kai anelabete thn skhnhn tou moloc kai to astron tou qeou umwn raifan touV tupouV autwn ouV epoihsate eautoiV
kai metoikiw umaV epekeina damaskou legei kurioV o qeoV o pantokratwr onoma autw
ouai toiV exouqenousin siwn kai toiV pepoiqosin epi to oroV samareiaV apetrughsan arcaV eqnwn kai eishlqon autoi oikoV tou israhl
diabhte panteV kai idete kai dielqate ekeiqen eiV emaq rabba kai katabhte ekeiqen eiV geq allofulwn taV kratistaV ek paswn twn basileiwn toutwn ei pleona ta oria autwn estin twn umeterwn oriwn
oi ercomenoi eiV hmeran kakhn oi eggizonteV kai efaptomenoi sabbatwn yeudwn
oi kaqeudonteV epi klinwn elefantinwn kai kataspatalwnteV epi taiV strwmnaiV autwn kai esqonteV erifouV ek poimniwn kai moscaria ek mesou boukoliwn galaqhna
oi epikrotounteV proV thn fwnhn twn organwn wV estwta elogisanto kai ouc wV feugonta
oi pinonteV ton diulismenon oinon kai ta prwta mura criomenoi kai ouk epascon ouden epi th suntribh iwshf
dia touto nun aicmalwtoi esontai ap' archV dunastwn kai exarqhsetai cremetismoV ippwn ex efraim
oti wmosen kurioV kaq' eautou dioti bdelussomai egw pasan thn ubrin iakwb kai taV cwraV autou memishka kai exarw polin sun pasin toiV katoikousin authn
kai estai ean upoleifqwsin deka andreV en oikia mia kai apoqanountai kai upoleifqhsontai oi kataloipoi

kai lhmyontai oi oikeioi autwn kai parabiwntai tou exenegkai ta osta autwn ek tou oikou kai erei toiV proesthkosi thV oikiaV ei eti uparcei para soi kai erei ouketi kai erei siga eneka tou mh onomasai to onoma kuriou
dioti idou kurioV entelletai kai pataxei ton oikon ton megan qlasmasin kai ton oikon ton mikron ragmasin
ei diwxontai en petraiV ippoi ei parasiwphsontai en qhleiaiV oti umeiV exestreyate eiV qumon krima kai karpon dikaiosunhV eiV pikrian
oi eufrainomenoi ep' oudeni logw oi legonteV ouk en th iscui hmwn escomen kerata
dioti idou egw epegeirw ef' umaV oikoV tou israhl eqnoV kai ekqliyousin umaV tou mh eiselqein eiV emaq kai ewV tou ceimarrou twn dusmwn
outwV edeixen moi kurioV kai idou epigonh akridwn ercomenh ewqinh kai idou broucoV eiV gwg o basileuV
kai estai ean suntelesh tou katafagein ton corton thV ghV kai eipa kurie kurie ilewV genou tiV anasthsei ton iakwb oti oligostoV estin
metanohson kurie epi toutw kai touto ouk estai legei kurioV
outwV edeixen moi kurioV kai idou ekalesen thn dikhn en puri kurioV kai katefage thn abusson thn pollhn kai katefagen thn merida
kai eipa kurie kurie kopason dh tiV anasthsei ton iakwb oti oligostoV estin
metanohson kurie epi toutw kai touto ou mh genhtai legei kurioV
outwV edeixen moi kurioV kai idou anhr esthkwV epi teicouV adamantinou kai en th ceiri autou adamaV
kai eipen kurioV proV me ti su oraV amwV kai eipa adamanta kai eipen kurioV proV me idou egw entassw adamanta en mesw laou mou israhl ouketi mh prosqw tou parelqein auton
kai afanisqhsontai bwmoi tou gelwtoV kai ai teletai tou israhl exerhmwqhsontai kai anasthsomai epi ton oikon ieroboam en romfaia
kai exapesteilen amasiaV o iereuV baiqhl proV ieroboam basilea israhl legwn sustrofaV poieitai kata sou amwV en mesw oikou israhl ou mh dunhtai h gh upenegkein apantaV touV logouV autou
dioti tade legei amwV en romfaia teleuthsei ieroboam o de israhl aicmalwtoV acqhsetai apo thV ghV autou
kai eipen amasiaV proV amwV o orwn badize ekcwrhson eiV ghn iouda kai ekei katabiou kai ekei profhteuseiV
eiV de baiqhl ouketi mh prosqhV tou profhteusai oti agiasma basilewV estin kai oikoV basileiaV estin
kai apekriqh amwV kai eipen proV amasian ouk hmhn profhthV egw oude uioV profhtou all' h aipoloV hmhn kai knizwn sukamina
kai anelaben me kurioV ek twn probatwn kai eipen kurioV proV me badize profhteuson epi ton laon mou israhl
kai nun akoue logon kuriou su legeiV mh profhteue epi ton israhl kai ou mh oclagwghshV epi ton oikon iakwb

dia touto tade legei kurioV h gunh sou en th polei porneusei kai oi uioi sou kai ai qugatereV sou en romfaia pesountai kai h gh sou en scoiniw katametrhqhsetai kai su en gh akaqartw teleuthseiV o de israhl aicmalwtoV acqhsetai apo thV ghV autou
outwV edeixen moi kurioV kai idou aggoV ixeutou
kai eipen ti su blepeiV amwV kai eipa aggoV ixeutou kai eipen kurioV proV me hkei to peraV epi ton laon mou israhl ouketi mh prosqw tou parelqein auton
kai ololuxei ta fatnwmata tou naou en ekeinh th hmera legei kurioV poluV o peptwkwV en panti topw epirriyw siwphn
akousate dh tauta oi ektribonteV eiV to prwi penhta kai katadunasteuonteV ptwcouV apo thV ghV
oi legonteV pote dieleusetai o mhn kai empolhsomen kai ta sabbata kai anoixomen qhsaurouV tou poihsai mikron metron kai tou megalunai staqmia kai poihsai zugon adikon
tou ktasqai en arguriw ptwcouV kai tapeinon anti upodhmatwn kai apo pantoV genhmatoV emporeusomeqa
omnuei kurioV kaq' uperhfaniaV iakwb ei epilhsqhsetai eiV neikoV panta ta erga umwn
kai epi toutoiV ou taracqhsetai h gh kai penqhsei paV o katoikwn en auth kai anabhsetai wV potamoV sunteleia kai katabhsetai wV potamoV aiguptou
kai estai en ekeinh th hmera legei kurioV o qeoV kai dusetai o hlioV meshmbriaV kai suskotasei epi thV ghV en hmera to fwV

kai metastreyw taV eortaV umwn eiV penqoV kai pasaV taV wdaV umwn eiV qrhnon kai anabibw epi pasan osfun sakkon kai epi pasan kefalhn falakrwma kai qhsomai auton wV penqoV agaphtou kai touV met' autou wV hmeran odunhV
idou hmerai ercontai legei kurioV kai exapostelw limon epi thn ghn ou limon artou oude diyan udatoV alla limon tou akousai logon kuriou
kai saleuqhsontai udata ewV qalasshV kai apo borra ewV anatolwn peridramountai zhtounteV ton logon kuriou kai ou mh eurwsin
en th hmera ekeinh ekleiyousin ai parqenoi ai kalai kai oi neaniskoi en diyei
oi omnuonteV kata tou ilasmou samareiaV kai oi legonteV zh o qeoV sou dan kai zh o qeoV sou bhrsabee kai pesountai kai ou mh anastwsin eti

eidon ton kurion efestwta epi tou qusiasthriou kai eipen pataxon epi to ilasthrion kai seisqhsetai ta propula kai diakoyon eiV kefalaV pantwn kai touV kataloipouV autwn en romfaia apoktenw ou mh diafugh ex autwn feugwn kai ou mh diaswqh ex autwn anaswzomenoV
ean katorugwsin eiV adou ekeiqen h ceir mou anaspasei autouV kai ean anabwsin eiV ton ouranon ekeiqen kataxw autouV
ean egkrubwsin eiV thn korufhn tou karmhlou ekeiqen exereunhsw kai lhmyomai autouV kai ean kataduswsin ex ofqalmwn mou eiV ta baqh thV qalasshV ekei enteloumai tw drakonti kai dhxetai autouV
kai ean poreuqwsin en aicmalwsia pro proswpou twn ecqrwn autwn ekei enteloumai th romfaia kai apoktenei autouV kai sthriw touV ofqalmouV mou ep' autouV eiV kaka kai ouk eiV agaqa

kai kurioV kurioV o qeoV o pantokratwr o efaptomenoV thV ghV kai saleuwn authn kai penqhsousin panteV oi katoikounteV authn kai anabhsetai wV potamoV sunteleia authV kai katabhsetai wV potamoV aiguptou

o oikodomwn eiV ton ouranon anabasin autou kai thn epaggelian autou epi thV ghV qemeliwn o proskaloumenoV to udwr thV qalasshV kai ekcewn auto epi proswpon thV ghV kurioV o qeoV o pantokratwr onoma autw
ouc wV uioi aiqiopwn umeiV este emoi uioi israhl legei kurioV ou ton israhl anhgagon ek ghV aiguptou kai touV allofulouV ek kappadokiaV kai touV surouV ek boqrou
idou oi ofqalmoi kuriou tou qeou epi thn basileian twn amartwlwn kai exarw authn apo proswpou thV ghV plhn oti ouk eiV teloV exarw ton oikon iakwb legei kurioV
dioti idou egw entellomai kai likmiw en pasi toiV eqnesin ton oikon tou israhl on tropon likmatai en tw likmw kai ou mh pesh suntrimma epi thn ghn
en romfaia teleuthsousi panteV amartwloi laou mou oi legonteV ou mh eggish oud' ou mh genhtai ef' hmaV ta kaka
en th hmera ekeinh anasthsw thn skhnhn dauid thn peptwkuian kai anoikodomhsw ta peptwkota authV kai ta kateskammena authV anasthsw kai anoikodomhsw authn kaqwV ai hmerai tou aiwnoV
opwV ekzhthswsin oi kataloipoi twn anqrwpwn kai panta ta eqnh ef' ouV epikeklhtai to onoma mou ep' autouV legei kurioV o qeoV o poiwn tauta
idou hmerai ercontai legei kurioV kai katalhmyetai o alohtoV ton trughton kai perkasei h stafulh en tw sporw kai apostalaxei ta orh glukasmon kai panteV oi bounoi sumfutoi esontai

kai epistreyw thn aicmalwsian laou mou israhl kai oikodomhsousin poleiV taV hfanismenaV kai katoikhsousin kai katafuteusousin ampelwnaV kai piontai ton oinon autwn kai futeusousin khpouV kai fagontai ton karpon autwn

kai katafuteusw autouV epi thV ghV autwn kai ou mh ekspasqwsin ouketi apo thV ghV autwn hV edwka autoiV legei kurioV o qeoV o pantokratwr . ______________________________________________________________________________
orasiV abdiou tade legei kurioV o qeoV th idoumaia akohn hkousa para kuriou kai periochn eiV ta eqnh exapesteilen anasthte kai exanastwmen ep' authn eiV polemon
idou oligoston dedwka se en toiV eqnesin htimwmenoV su ei sfodra
uperhfania thV kardiaV sou ephren se kataskhnounta en taiV opaiV twn petrwn uywn katoikian autou legwn en kardia autou tiV me kataxei epi thn ghn
ean metewrisqhV wV aetoV kai ean ana meson twn astrwn qhV nossian sou ekeiqen kataxw se legei kurioV
ei kleptai eishlqon proV se h lhstai nuktoV pou an aperrifhV ouk an ekleyan ta ikana eautoiV kai ei trughtai eishlqon proV se ouk an upeliponto epifullida
pwV exhreunhqh hsau kai katelhmfqh autou ta kekrummena
ewV twn oriwn sou exapesteilan se panteV oi andreV thV diaqhkhV sou antesthsan soi hdunasqhsan proV se andreV eirhnikoi sou eqhkan enedra upokatw sou ouk estin sunesiV autoiV
en ekeinh th hmera legei kurioV apolw sofouV ek thV idoumaiaV kai sunesin ex orouV hsau
kai ptohqhsontai oi machtai sou oi ek qaiman opwV exarqh anqrwpoV ex orouV hsau
dia thn sfaghn kai thn asebeian thn eiV ton adelfon sou iakwb kai kaluyei se aiscunh kai exarqhsh eiV ton aiwna
af' hV hmeraV antesthV ex enantiaV en hmera aicmalwteuontwn allogenwn dunamin autou kai allotrioi eishlqon eiV pulaV autou kai epi ierousalhm ebalon klhrouV kai su hV wV eiV ex autwn
kai mh epidhV hmeran adelfou sou en hmera allotriwn kai mh epicarhV epi touV uiouV iouda en hmera apwleiaV autwn kai mh megalorrhmonhshV en hmera qliyewV
mhde eiselqhV eiV pulaV lawn en hmera ponwn autwn mhde epidhV kai su thn sunagwghn autwn en hmera oleqrou autwn mhde sunepiqh epi thn dunamin autwn en hmera apwleiaV autwn
mhde episthV epi taV diekbolaV autwn tou exoleqreusai touV anaswzomenouV autwn mhde sugkleishV touV feugontaV ex autwn en hmera qliyewV
dioti egguV hmera kuriou epi panta ta eqnh on tropon epoihsaV outwV estai soi to antapodoma sou antapodoqhsetai eiV kefalhn sou
dioti on tropon epieV epi to oroV to agion mou piontai panta ta eqnh oinon piontai kai katabhsontai kai esontai kaqwV ouc uparconteV
en de tw orei siwn estai h swthria kai estai agion kai kataklhronomhsousin o oikoV iakwb touV kataklhronomhsantaV autouV
kai estai o oikoV iakwb pur o de oikoV iwshf flox o de oikoV hsau eiV kalamhn kai ekkauqhsontai eiV autouV kai katafagontai autouV kai ouk estai puroforoV en tw oikw hsau dioti kurioV elalhsen
kai kataklhronomhsousin oi en nageb to oroV to hsau kai oi en th sefhla touV allofulouV kai kataklhronomhsousin to oroV efraim kai to pedion samareiaV kai beniamin kai thn galaaditin
kai thV metoikesiaV h arch auth toiV uioiV israhl gh twn cananaiwn ewV sareptwn kai h metoikesia ierousalhm ewV efraqa kai klhronomhsousin taV poleiV tou nageb
kai anabhsontai andreV seswsmenoi ex orouV siwn tou ekdikhsai to oroV hsau kai estai tw kuriw h basileia . ______________________________________________________________________________
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV iwnan ton tou amaqi legwn
anasthqi kai poreuqhti eiV nineuh thn polin thn megalhn kai khruxon en auth oti anebh h kraugh thV kakiaV authV proV me

kai anesth iwnaV tou fugein eiV qarsiV ek proswpou kuriou kai katebh eiV iopphn kai euren ploion badizon eiV qarsiV kai edwken to naulon autou kai enebh eiV auto tou pleusai met' autwn eiV qarsiV ek proswpou kuriou
kai kurioV exhgeiren pneuma eiV thn qalassan kai egeneto kludwn megaV en th qalassh kai to ploion ekinduneuen suntribhnai

kai efobhqhsan oi nautikoi kai anebown ekastoV proV ton qeon autwn kai ekbolhn epoihsanto twn skeuwn twn en tw ploiw eiV thn qalassan tou koufisqhnai ap' autwn iwnaV de katebh eiV thn koilhn tou ploiou kai ekaqeuden kai erregcen
kai proshlqen proV auton o prwreuV kai eipen autw ti su regceiV anasta kai epikalou ton qeon sou opwV diaswsh o qeoV hmaV kai mh apolwmeqa
kai eipen ekastoV proV ton plhsion autou deute balwmen klhrouV kai epignwmen tinoV eneken h kakia auth estin en hmin kai ebalon klhrouV kai epesen o klhroV epi iwnan
kai eipon proV auton apaggeilon hmin tinoV eneken h kakia auth estin en hmin tiV sou h ergasia estin kai poqen erch kai ek poiaV cwraV kai ek poiou laou ei su
kai eipen proV autouV douloV kuriou egw eimi kai ton kurion qeon tou ouranou egw sebomai oV epoihsen thn qalassan kai thn xhran
kai efobhqhsan oi andreV fobon megan kai eipan proV auton ti touto epoihsaV dioti egnwsan oi andreV oti ek proswpou kuriou hn feugwn oti aphggeilen autoiV
kai eipan proV auton ti soi poihswmen kai kopasei h qalassa af' hmwn oti h qalassa eporeueto kai exhgeiren mallon kludwna
kai eipen iwnaV proV autouV arate me kai embalete me eiV thn qalassan kai kopasei h qalassa af' umwn dioti egnwka egw oti di' eme o kludwn o megaV outoV ef' umaV estin
kai parebiazonto oi andreV tou epistreyai proV thn ghn kai ouk hdunanto oti h qalassa eporeueto kai exhgeireto mallon ep' autouV
kai anebohsan proV kurion kai eipan mhdamwV kurie mh apolwmeqa eneken thV yuchV tou anqrwpou toutou kai mh dwV ef' hmaV aima dikaion oti su kurie on tropon eboulou pepoihkaV
kai elabon ton iwnan kai exebalon auton eiV thn qalassan kai esth h qalassa ek tou salou authV
kai efobhqhsan oi andreV fobw megalw ton kurion kai equsan qusian tw kuriw kai euxanto eucaV
kai prosetaxen kurioV khtei megalw katapiein ton iwnan kai hn iwnaV en th koilia tou khtouV treiV hmeraV kai treiV nuktaV
kai proshuxato iwnaV proV kurion ton qeon autou ek thV koiliaV tou khtouV
kai eipen ebohsa en qliyei mou proV kurion ton qeon mou kai eishkousen mou ek koiliaV adou kraughV mou hkousaV fwnhV mou
aperriyaV me eiV baqh kardiaV qalasshV kai potamoi me ekuklwsan panteV oi metewrismoi sou kai ta kumata sou ep' eme dihlqon
kai egw eipa apwsmai ex ofqalmwn sou ara prosqhsw tou epibleyai proV ton naon ton agion sou
periecuqh udwr moi ewV yuchV abussoV ekuklwsen me escath edu h kefalh mou eiV scismaV orewn
katebhn eiV ghn hV oi mocloi authV katocoi aiwnioi kai anabhtw fqora zwhV mou kurie o qeoV mou
en tw ekleipein ap' emou thn yuchn mou tou kuriou emnhsqhn kai elqoi proV se h proseuch mou eiV naon agion sou
fulassomenoi mataia kai yeudh eleoV autwn egkatelipon
egw de meta fwnhV ainesewV kai exomologhsewV qusw soi osa huxamhn apodwsw soi swthriou tw kuriw
kai prosetagh tw khtei kai exebalen ton iwnan epi thn xhran
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV iwnan ek deuterou legwn
anasthqi kai poreuqhti eiV nineuh thn polin thn megalhn kai khruxon en auth kata to khrugma to emprosqen o egw elalhsa proV se
kai anesth iwnaV kai eporeuqh eiV nineuh kaqwV elalhsen kurioV h de nineuh hn poliV megalh tw qew wsei poreiaV odou hmerwn triwn
kai hrxato iwnaV tou eiselqein eiV thn polin wsei poreian hmeraV miaV kai ekhruxen kai eipen eti treiV hmerai kai nineuh katastrafhsetai
kai enepisteusan oi andreV nineuh tw qew kai ekhruxan nhsteian kai enedusanto sakkouV apo megalou autwn ewV mikrou autwn
kai hggisen o logoV proV ton basilea thV nineuh kai exanesth apo tou qronou autou kai perieilato thn stolhn autou af' eautou kai periebaleto sakkon kai ekaqisen epi spodou
kai ekhrucqh kai erreqh en th nineuh para tou basilewV kai para twn megistanwn autou legwn oi anqrwpoi kai ta kthnh kai oi boeV kai ta probata mh geusasqwsan mhden mhde nemesqwsan mhde udwr pietwsan
kai periebalonto sakkouV oi anqrwpoi kai ta kthnh kai anebohsan proV ton qeon ektenwV kai apestreyan ekastoV apo thV odou autou thV ponhraV kai apo thV adikiaV thV en cersin autwn legonteV
tiV oiden ei metanohsei o qeoV kai apostreyei ex orghV qumou autou kai ou mh apolwmeqa
kai eiden o qeoV ta erga autwn oti apestreyan apo twn odwn autwn twn ponhrwn kai metenohsen o qeoV epi th kakia h elalhsen tou poihsai autoiV kai ouk epoihsen
kai eluphqh iwnaV luphn megalhn kai sunecuqh

kai proseuxato proV kurion kai eipen w kurie ouc outoi oi logoi mou eti ontoV mou en th gh mou dia touto proefqasa tou fugein eiV qarsiV dioti egnwn oti su elehmwn kai oiktirmwn makroqumoV kai polueleoV kai metanown epi taiV kakiaiV
kai nun despota kurie labe thn yuchn mou ap' emou oti kalon to apoqanein me h zhn me
kai eipen kurioV proV iwnan ei sfodra leluphsai su
kai exhlqen iwnaV ek thV polewV kai ekaqisen apenanti thV polewV kai epoihsen eautw ekei skhnhn kai ekaqhto upokatw authV en skia ewV ou apidh ti estai th polei
kai prosetaxen kurioV o qeoV kolokunqh kai anebh uper kefalhV tou iwna tou einai skian uperanw thV kefalhV autou tou skiazein autw apo twn kakwn autou kai ecarh iwnaV epi th kolokunqh caran megalhn
kai prosetaxen o qeoV skwlhki ewqinh th epaurion kai epataxen thn kolokunqan kai apexhranqh

kai egeneto ama tw anateilai ton hlion kai prosetaxen o qeoV pneumati kauswnoV sugkaionti kai epataxen o hlioV epi thn kefalhn iwna kai wligoyuchsen kai apelegeto thn yuchn autou kai eipen kalon moi apoqanein me h zhn
kai eipen o qeoV proV iwnan ei sfodra leluphsai su epi th kolokunqh kai eipen sfodra leluphmai egw ewV qanatou
kai eipen kurioV su efeisw uper thV kolokunqhV uper hV ouk ekakopaqhsaV ep' authn kai ouk exeqreyaV authn h egenhqh upo nukta kai upo nukta apwleto

kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV micaian ton tou mwrasqi en hmeraiV iwaqam kai acaz kai ezekiou basilewn iouda uper wn eiden peri samareiaV kai peri ierousalhm
akousate laoi logouV kai prosecetw h gh kai panteV oi en auth kai estai kurioV en umin eiV marturion kurioV ex oikou agiou autou
dioti idou kurioV ekporeuetai ek tou topou autou kai katabhsetai kai epibhsetai epi ta uyh thV ghV
kai saleuqhsetai ta orh upokatwqen autou kai ai koiladeV takhsontai wV khroV apo proswpou puroV kai wV udwr kataferomenon en katabasei
dia asebeian iakwb panta tauta kai dia amartian oikou israhl tiV h asebeia tou iakwb ou samareia kai tiV h amartia oikou iouda ouci ierousalhm
kai qhsomai samareian eiV opwrofulakion agrou kai eiV futeian ampelwnoV kai kataspasw eiV caoV touV liqouV authV kai ta qemelia authV apokaluyw

kai panta ta glupta authV katakoyousin kai panta ta misqwmata authV emprhsousin en puri kai panta ta eidwla authV qhsomai eiV afanismon dioti ek misqwmatwn porneiaV sunhgagen kai ek misqwmatwn porneiaV sunestreyen
eneken toutou koyetai kai qrhnhsei poreusetai anupodetoV kai gumnh poihsetai kopeton wV drakontwn kai penqoV wV qugaterwn seirhnwn
oti katekrathsen h plhgh authV dioti hlqen ewV iouda kai hyato ewV pulhV laou mou ewV ierousalhm
oi en geq mh megalunesqe oi en akim mh anoikodomeite ex oikou kata gelwta ghn katapasasqe kata gelwta umwn
katoikousa kalwV taV poleiV authV ouk exhlqen katoikousa sennaan koyasqai oikon ecomenon authV lhmyetai ex umwn plhghn odunhV
tiV hrxato eiV agaqa katoikoush odunaV oti katebh kaka para kuriou epi pulaV ierousalhm
yofoV armatwn kai ippeuontwn katoikousa laciV archgoV amartiaV auth estin th qugatri siwn oti en soi eureqhsan asebeiai tou israhl
dia touto dwseiV exapostellomenouV ewV klhronomiaV geq oikouV mataiouV eiV kena egeneto toiV basileusin tou israhl

kai epequmoun agrouV kai dihrpazon orfanouV kai oikouV katedunasteuon kai dihrpazon andra kai ton oikon autou andra kai thn klhronomian autou
dia touto tade legei kurioV idou egw logizomai epi thn fulhn tauthn kaka ex wn ou mh arhte touV trachlouV umwn kai ou mh poreuqhte orqoi exaifnhV oti kairoV ponhroV estin

en th hmera ekeinh lhmfqhsetai ef' umaV parabolh kai qrhnhqhsetai qrhnoV en melei legwn talaipwria etalaipwrhsamen meriV laou mou katemetrhqh en scoiniw kai ouk hn o kwluswn auton tou apostreyai oi agroi hmwn diemerisqhsan
dia touto ouk estai soi ballwn scoinion en klhrw en ekklhsia kuriou
mh klaiete dakrusin mhde dakruetwsan epi toutoiV ou gar apwsetai oneidh
o legwn oikoV iakwb parwrgisen pneuma kuriou ei tauta ta epithdeumata autou estin ouc oi logoi autou eisin kaloi met' autou kai orqoi peporeuntai

dia thV diakophV pro proswpou autwn diekoyan kai dihlqon pulhn kai exhlqon di' authV kai exhlqen o basileuV autwn pro proswpou autwn o de kurioV hghsetai autwn
kai erei akousate dh tauta ai arcai oikou iakwb kai oi kataloipoi oikou israhl ouc umin estin tou gnwnai to krima
oi misounteV ta kala kai zhtounteV ta ponhra arpazonteV ta dermata autwn ap' autwn kai taV sarkaV autwn apo twn ostewn autwn
on tropon katefagon taV sarkaV tou laou mou kai ta dermata autwn apo twn ostewn autwn exedeiran kai ta ostea autwn suneqlasan kai emelisan wV sarkaV eiV lebhta kai wV krea eiV cutran

kai kataiscunqhsontai oi orwnteV ta enupnia kai katagelasqhsontai oi manteiV kai katalalhsousin kat' autwn panteV autoi dioti ouk estai o eisakouwn autwn
ean mh egw emplhsw iscun en pneumati kuriou kai krimatoV kai dunasteiaV tou apaggeilai tw iakwb asebeiaV autou kai tw israhl amartiaV autou
akousate dh tauta oi hgoumenoi oikou iakwb kai oi kataloipoi oikou israhl oi bdelussomenoi krima kai panta ta orqa diastrefonteV
oi oikodomounteV siwn en aimasin kai ierousalhm en adikiaiV

kai sthsetai kai oyetai kai poimanei to poimnion autou en iscui kuriou kai en th doxh tou onomatoV kuriou tou qeou autwn uparxousin dioti nun megalunqhsetai ewV akrwn thV ghV
kai estai auth eirhnh otan assurioV epelqh epi thn ghn umwn kai otan epibh epi thn cwran umwn kai epegerqhsontai ep' auton epta poimeneV kai oktw dhgmata anqrwpwn
kai poimanousin ton assour en romfaia kai thn ghn tou nebrwd en th tafrw authV kai rusetai ek tou assour otan epelqh epi thn ghn umwn kai otan epibh epi ta oria umwn
kai estai to upoleimma tou iakwb en toiV eqnesin en mesw lawn pollwn wV drosoV para kuriou piptousa kai wV arneV epi agrwstin opwV mh sunacqh mhdeiV mhde uposth en uioiV anqrwpwn

kai estai en ekeinh th hmera legei kurioV exoleqreusw touV ippouV sou ek mesou sou kai apolw ta armata sou
kai exoleqreusw taV poleiV thV ghV sou kai exarw panta ta ocurwmata sou

kai ekkoyw ta alsh sou ek mesou sou kai afaniw taV poleiV sou
kai poihsw en orgh kai en qumw ekdikhsin en toiV eqnesin anq' wn ouk eishkousan
akousate dh logon kuriou kurioV eipen anasthqi kriqhti proV ta orh kai akousatwsan oi bounoi fwnhn sou
akousate bounoi thn krisin tou kuriou kai ai faraggeV qemelia thV ghV oti krisiV tw kuriw proV ton laon autou kai meta tou israhl dielegcqhsetai
laoV mou ti epoihsa soi h ti eluphsa se h ti parhnwclhsa soi apokriqhti moi
dioti anhgagon se ek ghV aiguptou kai ex oikou douleiaV elutrwsamhn se kai exapesteila pro proswpou sou ton mwushn kai aarwn kai mariam
laoV mou mnhsqhti dh ti ebouleusato kata sou balak basileuV mwab kai ti apekriqh autw balaam uioV tou bewr apo twn scoinwn ewV tou galgal opwV gnwsqh h dikaiosunh tou kuriou
en tini katalabw ton kurion antilhmyomai qeou mou uyistou ei katalhmyomai auton en olokautwmasin en moscoiV eniausioiV
ei prosdexetai kurioV en ciliasin kriwn h en muriasin ceimarrwn pionwn ei dw prwtotoka mou asebeiaV karpon koiliaV mou uper amartiaV yuchV mou
ei anhggelh soi anqrwpe ti kalon h ti kurioV ekzhtei para sou all' h tou poiein krima kai agapan eleon kai etoimon einai tou poreuesqai meta kuriou qeou sou
fwnh kuriou th polei epiklhqhsetai kai swsei foboumenouV to onoma autou akoue fulh kai tiV kosmhsei polin
mh pur kai oikoV anomou qhsaurizwn qhsaurouV anomouV kai meta ubrewV adikia
ei dikaiwqhsetai en zugw anomoV kai en marsippw staqmia dolou
ex wn ton plouton autwn asebeiaV eplhsan kai oi katoikounteV authn elaloun yeudh kai h glwssa autwn uywqh en tw stomati autwn
kai egw arxomai tou pataxai se afaniw se epi taiV amartiaiV sou

su spereiV kai ou mh amhshV su pieseiV elaian kai ou mh aleiyh elaion kai oinon kai ou mh pihte kai afanisqhsetai nomima laou mou
kai efulaxaV ta dikaiwmata zambri kai panta ta erga oikou acaab kai eporeuqhte en taiV boulaiV autwn opwV paradw se eiV afanismon kai touV katoikountaV authn eiV surismon kai oneidh lawn lhmyesqe
oimmoi oti egenomhn wV sunagwn kalamhn en amhtw kai wV epifullida en trughtw ouc uparcontoV botruoV tou fagein ta prwtogona oimmoi yuch
oti apolwlen eulabhV apo thV ghV kai katorqwn en anqrwpoiV ouc uparcei panteV eiV aimata dikazontai ekastoV ton plhsion autou ekqlibousin ekqlibh
epi to kakon taV ceiraV autwn etoimazousin o arcwn aitei kai o krithV eirhnikouV logouV elalhsen kataqumion yuchV autou estin kai exeloumai
ta agaqa autwn wV shV ektrwgwn kai badizwn epi kanonoV en hmera skopiaV ouai ouai ai ekdikhseiV sou hkasin nun esontai klauqmoi autwn
mh katapisteuete en filoiV kai mh elpizete epi hgoumenoiV apo thV sugkoitou sou fulaxai tou anaqesqai ti auth
dioti uioV atimazei patera qugathr epanasthsetai epi thn mhtera authV numfh epi thn penqeran authV ecqroi androV panteV oi andreV oi en tw oikw autou
egw de epi ton kurion epibleyomai upomenw epi tw qew tw swthri mou eisakousetai mou o qeoV mou
mh epicaire moi h ecqra mou oti peptwka kai anasthsomai dioti ean kaqisw en tw skotei kurioV fwtiei moi
orghn kuriou upoisw oti hmarton autw ewV tou dikaiwsai auton thn dikhn mou kai poihsei to krima mou kai exaxei me eiV to fwV oyomai thn dikaiosunhn autou

h hmera ekeinh kai ai poleiV sou hxousin eiV omalismon kai eiV diamerismon assuriwn kai ai poleiV sou ai ocurai eiV diamerismon apo turou ewV tou potamou suriaV hmera udatoV kai qorubou
kai estai h gh eiV afanismon sun toiV katoikousin authn ek karpwn epithdeumatwn autwn
poimaine laon sou en rabdw sou probata klhronomiaV sou kataskhnountaV kaq' eautouV drumon en mesw tou karmhlou nemhsontai thn basanitin kai thn galaaditin kaqwV ai hmerai tou aiwnoV

qeoV zhlwthV kai ekdikwn kurioV ekdikwn kurioV meta qumou ekdikwn kurioV touV upenantiouV autou kai exairwn autoV touV ecqrouV autou
kurioV makroqumoV kai megalh h iscuV autou kai aqwwn ouk aqwwsei kurioV en sunteleia kai en susseismw h odoV autou kai nefelai koniortoV podwn autou
apeilwn qalassh kai xhrainwn authn kai pantaV touV potamouV exerhmwn wligwqh h basanitiV kai o karmhloV kai ta exanqounta tou libanou exelipen
ta orh eseisqhsan ap' autou kai oi bounoi esaleuqhsan kai anestalh h gh apo proswpou autou h sumpasa kai panteV oi katoikounteV en auth
apo proswpou orghV autou tiV uposthsetai kai tiV antisthsetai en orgh qumou autou o qumoV autou thkei arcaV kai ai petrai dieqrubhsan ap' autou

kai en kataklusmw poreiaV sunteleian poihsetai touV epegeiromenouV kai touV ecqrouV autou diwxetai skotoV
ti logizesqe epi ton kurion sunteleian autoV poihsetai ouk ekdikhsei diV epi to auto en qliyei
oti ewV qemeliou autwn cerswqhsetai kai wV smilax periplekomenh brwqhsetai kai wV kalamh xhrasiaV mesth
ek sou exeleusetai logismoV kata tou kuriou ponhra logizomenoV enantia

kai nun suntriyw thn rabdon autou apo sou kai touV desmouV sou diarrhxw
