kai kataiscunqhsontai en tw kairw ekeinw otan kalwV umin poihsw kai en tw kairw otan eisdexwmai umaV dioti dwsw umaV onomastouV kai eiV kauchma en pasin toiV laoiV thV ghV en tw epistrefein me thn aicmalwsian umwn enwpion umwn legei kurioV . ______________________________________________________________________________

en tw deuterw etei epi dareiou tou basilewV en tw mhni tw ektw mia tou mhnoV egeneto logoV kuriou en ceiri aggaiou tou profhtou legwn eipon dh proV zorobabel ton tou salaqihl ek fulhV iouda kai proV ihsoun ton tou iwsedek ton ierea ton megan legwn
tade legei kurioV pantokratwr legwn o laoV outoV legousin ouc hkei o kairoV tou oikodomhsai ton oikon kuriou
kai egeneto logoV kuriou en ceiri aggaiou tou profhtou legwn
ei kairoV umin men estin tou oikein en oikoiV umwn koilostaqmoiV o de oikoV outoV exhrhmwtai
kai nun tade legei kurioV pantokratwr taxate dh taV kardiaV umwn eiV taV odouV umwn
espeirate polla kai eishnegkate oliga efagete kai ouk eiV plhsmonhn epiete kai ouk eiV meqhn periebalesqe kai ouk eqermanqhte en autoiV kai o touV misqouV sunagwn sunhgagen eiV desmon tetruphmenon
tade legei kurioV pantokratwr qesqe taV kardiaV umwn eiV taV odouV umwn
anabhte epi to oroV kai koyate xula kai oikodomhsate ton oikon kai eudokhsw en autw kai endoxasqhsomai eipen kurioV

epebleyate eiV polla kai egeneto oliga kai eishnecqh eiV ton oikon kai exefushsa auta dia touto tade legei kurioV pantokratwr anq' wn o oikoV mou estin erhmoV umeiV de diwkete ekastoV eiV ton oikon autou
dia touto anexei o ouranoV apo drosou kai h gh uposteleitai ta ekforia authV

kai epaxw romfaian epi thn ghn kai epi ta orh kai epi ton siton kai epi ton oinon kai epi to elaion kai osa ekferei h gh kai epi touV anqrwpouV kai epi ta kthnh kai epi pantaV touV ponouV twn ceirwn autwn

kai hkousen zorobabel o tou salaqihl ek fulhV iouda kai ihsouV o tou iwsedek o iereuV o megaV kai panteV oi kataloipoi tou laou thV fwnhV kuriou tou qeou autwn kai twn logwn aggaiou tou profhtou kaqoti exapesteilen auton kurioV o qeoV autwn proV autouV kai efobhqh o laoV apo proswpou kuriou
kai eipen aggaioV o aggeloV kuriou tw law egw eimi meq' umwn legei kurioV

kai exhgeiren kurioV to pneuma zorobabel tou salaqihl ek fulhV iouda kai to pneuma ihsou tou iwsedek tou ierewV tou megalou kai to pneuma twn kataloipwn pantoV tou laou kai eishlqon kai epoioun erga en tw oikw kuriou pantokratoroV qeou autwn
th tetradi kai eikadi tou mhnoV tou ektou tw deuterw etei epi dareiou tou basilewV
tw ebdomw mhni mia kai eikadi tou mhnoV elalhsen kurioV en ceiri aggaiou tou profhtou legwn
eipon dh proV zorobabel ton tou salaqihl ek fulhV iouda kai proV ihsoun ton tou iwsedek ton ierea ton megan kai proV pantaV touV kataloipouV tou laou legwn
tiV ex umwn oV eiden ton oikon touton en th doxh autou th emprosqen kai pwV umeiV blepete auton nun kaqwV ouc uparconta enwpion umwn
kai nun katiscue zorobabel legei kurioV kai katiscue ihsou o tou iwsedek o iereuV o megaV kai katiscuetw paV o laoV thV ghV legei kurioV kai poieite dioti meq' umwn egw eimi legei kurioV pantokratwr
kai to pneuma mou efesthken en mesw umwn qarseite
dioti tade legei kurioV pantokratwr eti apax egw seisw ton ouranon kai thn ghn kai thn qalassan kai thn xhran
kai susseisw panta ta eqnh kai hxei ta eklekta pantwn twn eqnwn kai plhsw ton oikon touton doxhV legei kurioV pantokratwr
emon to argurion kai emon to crusion legei kurioV pantokratwr

dioti megalh estai h doxa tou oikou toutou h escath uper thn prwthn legei kurioV pantokratwr kai en tw topw toutw dwsw eirhnhn legei kurioV pantokratwr kai eirhnhn yuchV eiV peripoihsin panti tw ktizonti tou anasthsai ton naon touton
tetradi kai eikadi tou enatou mhnoV etouV deuterou epi dareiou egeneto logoV kuriou proV aggaion ton profhthn legwn
tade legei kurioV pantokratwr eperwthson touV iereiV nomon legwn

ean labh anqrwpoV kreaV agion en tw akrw tou imatiou autou kai ayhtai to akron tou imatiou autou artou h eyematoV h oinou h elaiou h pantoV brwmatoV ei agiasqhsetai kai apekriqhsan oi iereiV kai eipan ou
kai eipen aggaioV ean ayhtai memiammenoV epi yuch apo pantoV toutwn ei mianqhsetai kai apekriqhsan oi iereiV kai eipan mianqhsetai

kai apekriqh aggaioV kai eipen outwV o laoV outoV kai outwV to eqnoV touto enwpion emou legei kurioV kai outwV panta ta erga twn ceirwn autwn kai oV ean eggish ekei mianqhsetai eneken twn lhmmatwn autwn twn orqrinwn odunhqhsontai apo proswpou ponwn autwn kai emiseite en pulaiV elegcontaV
kai nun qesqe dh eiV taV kardiaV umwn apo thV hmeraV tauthV kai uperanw pro tou qeinai liqon epi liqon en tw naw kuriou
tineV hte ote eneballete eiV kuyelhn kriqhV eikosi sata kai egeneto kriqhV deka sata kai eiseporeuesqe eiV to upolhnion exantlhsai penthkonta metrhtaV kai egenonto eikosi
epataxa umaV en aforia kai en anemofqoria kai en calazh panta ta erga twn ceirwn umwn kai ouk epestreyate proV me legei kurioV
upotaxate dh taV kardiaV umwn apo thV hmeraV tauthV kai epekeina apo thV tetradoV kai eikadoV tou enatou mhnoV kai apo thV hmeraV hV eqemeliwqh o naoV kuriou qesqe en taiV kardiaiV umwn
ei eti epignwsqhsetai epi thV alw kai ei eti h ampeloV kai h sukh kai h roa kai ta xula thV elaiaV ta ou feronta karpon apo thV hmeraV tauthV euloghsw
kai egeneto logoV kuriou ek deuterou proV aggaion ton profhthn tetradi kai eikadi tou mhnoV legwn
eipon proV zorobabel ton tou salaqihl ek fulhV iouda legwn egw seiw ton ouranon kai thn ghn kai thn qalassan kai thn xhran
kai katastreyw qronouV basilewn kai oleqreusw dunamin basilewn twn eqnwn kai katastreyw armata kai anabataV kai katabhsontai ippoi kai anabatai autwn ekastoV en romfaia proV ton adelfon autou

en th hmera ekeinh legei kurioV pantokratwr lhmyomai se zorobabel ton tou salaqihl ton doulon mou legei kurioV kai qhsomai se wV sfragida dioti se hretisa legei kurioV pantokratwr . ______________________________________________________________________________
en tw ogdow mhni etouV deuterou epi dareiou egeneto logoV kuriou proV zacarian ton tou baraciou uion addw ton profhthn legwn
wrgisqh kurioV epi touV pateraV umwn orghn megalhn
kai ereiV proV autouV tade legei kurioV pantokratwr epistreyate proV me kai epistrafhsomai proV umaV legei kurioV

kai mh ginesqe kaqwV oi patereV umwn oiV enekalesan autoiV oi profhtai oi emprosqen legonteV tade legei kurioV pantokratwr apostreyate apo twn odwn umwn twn ponhrwn kai apo twn epithdeumatwn umwn twn ponhrwn kai ou prosescon tou eisakousai mou legei kurioV
oi patereV umwn pou eisin kai oi profhtai mh ton aiwna zhsontai

plhn touV logouV mou kai ta nomima mou decesqe osa egw entellomai en pneumati mou toiV douloiV mou toiV profhtaiV oi katelabosan touV pateraV umwn kai apekriqhsan kai eipan kaqwV paratetaktai kurioV pantokratwr tou poihsai kata taV odouV umwn kai kata ta epithdeumata umwn outwV epoihsen umin
th tetradi kai eikadi tw endekatw mhni outoV estin o mhn sabat en tw deuterw etei epi dareiou egeneto logoV kuriou proV zacarian ton tou baraciou uion addw ton profhthn legwn
ewraka thn nukta kai idou anhr epibebhkwV epi ippon purron kai outoV eisthkei ana meson twn duo orewn twn kataskiwn kai opisw autou ippoi purroi kai yaroi kai poikiloi kai leukoi
kai eipa ti outoi kurie kai eipen proV me o aggeloV o lalwn en emoi egw deixw soi ti estin tauta
kai apekriqh o anhr o efesthkwV ana meson twn orewn kai eipen proV me outoi eisin ouV exapestalken kurioV tou periodeusai thn ghn
kai apekriqhsan tw aggelw kuriou tw efestwti ana meson twn orewn kai eipon periwdeukamen pasan thn ghn kai idou pasa h gh katoikeitai kai hsucazei
kai apekriqh o aggeloV kuriou kai eipen kurie pantokratwr ewV tinoV ou mh elehshV thn ierousalhm kai taV poleiV iouda aV upereideV touto ebdomhkoston etoV
kai apekriqh kurioV pantokratwr tw aggelw tw lalounti en emoi rhmata kala kai logouV paraklhtikouV
kai eipen proV me o aggeloV o lalwn en emoi anakrage legwn tade legei kurioV pantokratwr ezhlwka thn ierousalhm kai thn siwn zhlon megan
kai orghn megalhn egw orgizomai epi ta eqnh ta sunepitiqemena anq' wn egw men wrgisqhn oliga autoi de sunepeqento eiV kaka
dia touto tade legei kurioV epistreyw epi ierousalhm en oiktirmw kai o oikoV mou anoikodomhqhsetai en auth legei kurioV pantokratwr kai metron ektaqhsetai epi ierousalhm eti
kai eipen proV me o aggeloV o lalwn en emoi anakrage legwn tade legei kurioV pantokratwr eti diacuqhsontai poleiV en agaqoiV kai elehsei kurioV eti thn siwn kai airetiei eti thn ierousalhm
kai hra touV ofqalmouV mou kai eidon kai idou tessara kerata
kai eipa proV ton aggelon ton lalounta en emoi ti estin tauta kurie kai eipen proV me tauta ta kerata ta diaskorpisanta ton ioudan kai ton israhl
kai edeixen moi kurioV tessaraV tektonaV

kai eipa ti outoi ercontai poihsai kai eipen proV me tauta ta kerata ta diaskorpisanta ton ioudan kai ton israhl kateaxan kai oudeiV autwn hren kefalhn kai eishlqon outoi tou oxunai auta eiV ceiraV autwn ta tessara kerata ta eqnh ta epairomena keraV epi thn ghn kuriou tou diaskorpisai authn
kai hra touV ofqalmouV mou kai eidon kai idou anhr kai en th ceiri autou scoinion gewmetrikon
kai eipa proV auton pou su poreuh kai eipen proV me diametrhsai thn ierousalhm tou idein phlikon to platoV authV estin kai phlikon to mhkoV
kai idou o aggeloV o lalwn en emoi eisthkei kai aggeloV eteroV exeporeueto eiV sunanthsin autw
kai eipen proV auton legwn drame kai lalhson proV ton neanian ekeinon legwn katakarpwV katoikhqhsetai ierousalhm apo plhqouV anqrwpwn kai kthnwn en mesw authV
kai egw esomai auth legei kurioV teicoV puroV kukloqen kai eiV doxan esomai en mesw authV
w w feugete apo ghV borra legei kurioV dioti ek twn tessarwn anemwn tou ouranou sunaxw umaV legei kurioV
eiV siwn anaswzesqe oi katoikounteV qugatera babulwnoV
dioti tade legei kurioV pantokratwr opisw doxhV apestalken me epi ta eqnh ta skuleusanta umaV dioti o aptomenoV umwn wV aptomenoV thV korhV tou ofqalmou autou
dioti idou egw epiferw thn ceira mou ep' autouV kai esontai skula toiV douleuousin autoiV kai gnwsesqe dioti kurioV pantokratwr apestalken me
terpou kai eufrainou qugater siwn dioti idou egw ercomai kai kataskhnwsw en mesw sou legei kurioV
kai katafeuxontai eqnh polla epi ton kurion en th hmera ekeinh kai esontai autw eiV laon kai kataskhnwsousin en mesw sou kai epignwsh oti kurioV pantokratwr exapestalken me proV se
kai kataklhronomhsei kurioV ton ioudan thn merida autou epi thn ghn thn agian kai airetiei eti thn ierousalhm
eulabeisqw pasa sarx apo proswpou kuriou dioti exeghgertai ek nefelwn agiwn autou
kai edeixen moi ihsoun ton ierea ton megan estwta pro proswpou aggelou kuriou kai o diaboloV eisthkei ek dexiwn autou tou antikeisqai autw
kai eipen kurioV proV ton diabolon epitimhsai kurioV en soi diabole kai epitimhsai kurioV en soi o eklexamenoV thn ierousalhm ouk idou touto wV daloV exespasmenoV ek puroV
kai ihsouV hn endedumenoV imatia rupara kai eisthkei pro proswpou tou aggelou
kai apekriqh kai eipen proV touV esthkotaV pro proswpou autou legwn afelete ta imatia ta rupara ap' autou kai eipen proV auton idou afhrhka taV anomiaV sou kai endusate auton podhrh
kai epiqete kidarin kaqaran epi thn kefalhn autou kai periebalon auton imatia kai epeqhkan kidarin kaqaran epi thn kefalhn autou kai o aggeloV kuriou eisthkei
kai diemarturato o aggeloV kuriou proV ihsoun legwn

tade legei kurioV pantokratwr ean en taiV odoiV mou poreuh kai ean ta prostagmata mou fulaxhV kai su diakrineiV ton oikon mou kai ean diafulaxhV kai ge thn aulhn mou kai dwsw soi anastrefomenouV en mesw twn esthkotwn toutwn
akoue dh ihsou o iereuV o megaV su kai oi plhsion sou oi kaqhmenoi pro proswpou sou dioti andreV teratoskopoi eisi dioti idou egw agw ton doulon mou anatolhn
dioti o liqoV on edwka pro proswpou ihsou epi ton liqon ton ena epta ofqalmoi eisin idou egw orussw boqron legei kurioV pantokratwr kai yhlafhsw pasan thn adikian thV ghV ekeinhV en hmera mia
en th hmera ekeinh legei kurioV pantokratwr sugkalesete ekastoV ton plhsion autou upokatw ampelou kai upokatw sukhV
kai epestreyen o aggeloV o lalwn en emoi kai exhgeiren me on tropon otan exegerqh anqrwpoV ex upnou autou
kai eipen proV me ti su blepeiV kai eipa ewraka kai idou lucnia crush olh kai to lampadion epanw authV kai epta lucnoi epanw authV kai epta eparustrideV toiV lucnoiV toiV epanw authV
kai duo elaiai epanw authV mia ek dexiwn tou lampadiou kai mia ex euwnumwn
kai ephrwthsa kai eipon proV ton aggelon ton lalounta en emoi legwn ti estin tauta kurie
kai apekriqh o aggeloV o lalwn en emoi kai eipen proV me ou ginwskeiV ti estin tauta kai eipa ouci kurie
kai apekriqh kai eipen proV me legwn outoV o logoV kuriou proV zorobabel legwn ouk en dunamei megalh oude en iscui all' h en pneumati mou legei kurioV pantokratwr
tiV ei su to oroV to mega pro proswpou zorobabel tou katorqwsai kai exoisw ton liqon thV klhronomiaV isothta caritoV carita authV
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn
ai ceireV zorobabel eqemeliwsan ton oikon touton kai ai ceireV autou epitelesousin auton kai epignwsh dioti kurioV pantokratwr exapestalken me proV se
dioti tiV exoudenwsen eiV hmeraV mikraV kai carountai kai oyontai ton liqon ton kassiterinon en ceiri zorobabel epta outoi ofqalmoi kuriou eisin oi epibleponteV epi pasan thn ghn
kai apekriqhn kai eipa proV auton ti ai duo elaiai autai ai ek dexiwn thV lucniaV kai ex euwnumwn
kai ephrwthsa ek deuterou kai eipa proV auton ti oi duo kladoi twn elaiwn oi en taiV cersin twn duo muxwthrwn twn cruswn twn epiceontwn kai epanagontwn taV eparustridaV taV crusaV
kai eipen proV me ouk oidaV ti estin tauta kai eipa ouci kurie
kai eipen outoi oi duo uioi thV piothtoV paresthkasin tw kuriw pashV thV ghV
kai epestreya kai hra touV ofqalmouV mou kai eidon kai idou drepanon petomenon
kai eipen proV me ti su blepeiV kai eipa egw orw drepanon petomenon mhkoV phcewn eikosi kai platoV phcewn deka
kai eipen proV me auth h ara h ekporeuomenh epi proswpon pashV thV ghV dioti paV o klepthV ek toutou ewV qanatou ekdikhqhsetai kai paV o epiorkoV ek toutou ewV qanatou ekdikhqhsetai

kai exoisw auto legei kurioV pantokratwr kai eiseleusetai eiV ton oikon tou kleptou kai eiV ton oikon tou omnuontoV tw onomati mou epi yeudei kai katalusei en mesw tou oikou autou kai suntelesei auton kai ta xula autou kai touV liqouV autou
kai exhlqen o aggeloV o lalwn en emoi kai eipen proV me anableyon toiV ofqalmoiV sou kai ide ti to ekporeuomenon touto
kai eipa ti estin kai eipen touto to metron to ekporeuomenon kai eipen auth h adikia autwn en pash th gh
kai idou talanton molibou exairomenon kai idou mia gunh ekaqhto en mesw tou metrou
kai eipen auth estin h anomia kai erriyen authn en mesw tou metrou kai erriyen ton liqon tou molibou eiV to stoma authV

kai hra touV ofqalmouV mou kai eidon kai idou duo gunaikeV ekporeuomenai kai pneuma en taiV pteruxin autwn kai autai eicon pterugaV wV pterugaV epopoV kai anelabon to metron ana meson thV ghV kai ana meson tou ouranou
kai eipa proV ton aggelon ton lalounta en emoi pou autai apoferousin to metron
kai eipen proV me oikodomhsai autw oikian en gh babulwnoV kai etoimasai kai qhsousin auto ekei epi thn etoimasian autou
kai epestreya kai hra touV ofqalmouV mou kai eidon kai idou tessara armata ekporeuomena ek mesou duo orewn kai ta orh hn orh calka
en tw armati tw prwtw ippoi purroi kai en tw armati tw deuterw ippoi melaneV
kai en tw armati tw tritw ippoi leukoi kai en tw armati tw tetartw ippoi poikiloi yaroi
kai apekriqhn kai eipa proV ton aggelon ton lalounta en emoi ti estin tauta kurie
kai apekriqh o aggeloV o lalwn en emoi kai eipen tauta estin oi tessareV anemoi tou ouranou ekporeuontai parasthnai tw kuriw pashV thV ghV
en w hsan oi ippoi oi melaneV exeporeuonto epi ghn borra kai oi leukoi exeporeuonto katopisqen autwn kai oi poikiloi exeporeuonto epi ghn notou
kai oi yaroi exeporeuonto kai epeblepon tou poreuesqai tou periodeusai thn ghn kai eipen poreuesqe kai periodeusate thn ghn kai periwdeusan thn ghn
kai anebohsen kai elalhsen proV me legwn idou oi ekporeuomenoi epi ghn borra anepausan ton qumon mou en gh borra
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV me legwn
labe ta ek thV aicmalwsiaV para twn arcontwn kai para twn crhsimwn authV kai para twn epegnwkotwn authn kai eiseleush su en th hmera ekeinh eiV ton oikon iwsiou tou sofoniou tou hkontoV ek babulwnoV
kai lhyh argurion kai crusion kai poihseiV stefanouV kai epiqhseiV epi thn kefalhn ihsou tou iwsedek tou ierewV tou megalou
kai ereiV proV auton tade legei kurioV pantokratwr idou anhr anatolh onoma autw kai upokatwqen autou anatelei kai oikodomhsei ton oikon kuriou
kai autoV lhmyetai arethn kai kaqietai kai katarxei epi tou qronou autou kai estai o iereuV ek dexiwn autou kai boulh eirhnikh estai ana meson amfoterwn
o de stefanoV estai toiV upomenousin kai toiV crhsimoiV authV kai toiV epegnwkosin authn kai eiV carita uiou sofoniou kai eiV yalmon en oikw kuriou

kai oi makran ap' autwn hxousin kai oikodomhsousin en tw oikw kuriou kai gnwsesqe dioti kurioV pantokratwr apestalken me proV umaV kai estai ean eisakouonteV eisakoushte thV fwnhV kuriou tou qeou umwn
kai egeneto en tw tetartw etei epi dareiou tou basilewV egeneto logoV kuriou proV zacarian tetradi tou mhnoV tou enatou oV estin caseleu
kai exapesteilen eiV baiqhl sarasar kai arbeseer o basileuV kai oi andreV autou tou exilasasqai ton kurion
legwn proV touV iereiV touV en tw oikw kuriou pantokratoroV kai proV touV profhtaV legwn eiselhluqen wde en tw mhni tw pemptw to agiasma kaqoti epoihsa hdh ikana eth
kai egeneto logoV kuriou twn dunamewn proV me legwn
eipon proV apanta ton laon thV ghV kai proV touV iereiV legwn ean nhsteushte h koyhsqe en taiV pemptaiV h en taiV ebdomaiV kai idou ebdomhkonta eth mh nhsteian nenhsteukate moi
kai ean faghte h pihte ouc umeiV esqete kai umeiV pinete
ouc outoi oi logoi eisin ouV elalhsen kurioV en cersin twn profhtwn twn emprosqen ote hn ierousalhm katoikoumenh kai euqhnousa kai ai poleiV authV kukloqen kai h oreinh kai h pedinh katwkeito
kai egeneto logoV kuriou proV zacarian legwn
tade legei kurioV pantokratwr krima dikaion krinate kai eleoV kai oiktirmon poieite ekastoV proV ton adelfon autou
kai chran kai orfanon kai proshluton kai penhta mh katadunasteuete kai kakian ekastoV tou adelfou autou mh mnhsikakeitw en taiV kardiaiV umwn
kai hpeiqhsan tou prosecein kai edwkan nwton parafronounta kai ta wta autwn ebarunan tou mh eisakouein

kai thn kardian autwn etaxan apeiqh tou mh eisakouein tou nomou mou kai touV logouV ouV exapesteilen kurioV pantokratwr en pneumati autou en cersin twn profhtwn twn emprosqen kai egeneto orgh megalh para kuriou pantokratoroV
kai estai on tropon eipen kai ouk eishkousan autou outwV kekraxontai kai ou mh eisakousw legei kurioV pantokratwr
kai ekbalw autouV eiV panta ta eqnh a ouk egnwsan kai h gh afanisqhsetai katopisqen autwn ek diodeuontoV kai ex anastrefontoV kai etaxan ghn eklekthn eiV afanismon
kai egeneto logoV kuriou pantokratoroV legwn
tade legei kurioV pantokratwr ezhlwsa thn ierousalhm kai thn siwn zhlon megan kai qumw megalw ezhlwsa authn
tade legei kurioV kai epistreyw epi siwn kai kataskhnwsw en mesw ierousalhm kai klhqhsetai h ierousalhm poliV h alhqinh kai to oroV kuriou pantokratoroV oroV agion
tade legei kurioV pantokratwr eti kaqhsontai presbuteroi kai presbuterai en taiV plateiaiV ierousalhm ekastoV thn rabdon autou ecwn en th ceiri autou apo plhqouV hmerwn
kai ai plateiai thV polewV plhsqhsontai paidariwn kai korasiwn paizontwn en taiV plateiaiV authV
tade legei kurioV pantokratwr dioti ei adunathsei enwpion twn kataloipwn tou laou toutou en taiV hmeraiV ekeinaiV mh kai enwpion emou adunathsei legei kurioV pantokratwr
tade legei kurioV pantokratwr idou egw anaswzw ton laon mou apo ghV anatolwn kai apo ghV dusmwn
kai eisaxw autouV kai kataskhnwsw en mesw ierousalhm kai esontai moi eiV laon kai egw esomai autoiV eiV qeon en alhqeia kai en dikaiosunh

tade legei kurioV pantokratwr katiscuetwsan ai ceireV umwn twn akouontwn en taiV hmeraiV tautaiV touV logouV toutouV ek stomatoV twn profhtwn af' hV hmeraV teqemeliwtai o oikoV kuriou pantokratoroV kai o naoV af' ou wkodomhtai

dioti pro twn hmerwn ekeinwn o misqoV twn anqrwpwn ouk estai eiV onhsin kai o misqoV twn kthnwn ouc uparxei kai tw ekporeuomenw kai tw eisporeuomenw ouk estai eirhnh apo thV qliyewV kai exapostelw pantaV touV anqrwpouV ekaston epi ton plhsion autou
kai nun ou kata taV hmeraV taV emprosqen egw poiw toiV kataloipoiV tou laou toutou legei kurioV pantokratwr
all' h deixw eirhnhn h ampeloV dwsei ton karpon authV kai h gh dwsei ta genhmata authV kai o ouranoV dwsei thn droson autou kai kataklhronomhsw toiV kataloipoiV tou laou mou panta tauta
kai estai on tropon hte en katara en toiV eqnesin oikoV iouda kai oikoV israhl outwV diaswsw umaV kai esesqe en eulogia qarseite kai katiscuete en taiV cersin umwn
dioti tade legei kurioV pantokratwr on tropon dienohqhn tou kakwsai umaV en tw parorgisai me touV pateraV umwn legei kurioV pantokratwr kai ou metenohsa
outwV paratetagmai kai dianenohmai en taiV hmeraiV tautaiV tou kalwV poihsai thn ierousalhm kai ton oikon iouda qarseite
outoi oi logoi ouV poihsete laleite alhqeian ekastoV proV ton plhsion autou kai krima eirhnikon krinate en taiV pulaiV umwn
kai ekastoV thn kakian tou plhsion autou mh logizesqe en taiV kardiaiV umwn kai orkon yeudh mh agapate dioti tauta panta emishsa legei kurioV pantokratwr
kai egeneto logoV kuriou pantokratoroV proV me legwn

tade legei kurioV pantokratwr nhsteia h tetraV kai nhsteia h pempth kai nhsteia h ebdomh kai nhsteia h dekath esontai tw oikw iouda eiV caran kai eiV eufrosunhn kai eiV eortaV agaqaV kai eufranqhsesqe kai thn alhqeian kai thn eirhnhn agaphsate
tade legei kurioV pantokratwr eti hxousin laoi polloi kai katoikounteV poleiV pollaV
kai suneleusontai katoikounteV pente poleiV eiV mian polin legonteV poreuqwmen dehqhnai tou proswpou kuriou kai ekzhthsai to proswpon kuriou pantokratoroV poreusomai kagw
kai hxousin laoi polloi kai eqnh polla ekzhthsai to proswpon kuriou pantokratoroV en ierousalhm kai tou exilaskesqai to proswpon kuriou

tade legei kurioV pantokratwr en taiV hmeraiV ekeinaiV ean epilabwntai deka andreV ek paswn twn glwsswn twn eqnwn kai epilabwntai tou kraspedou androV ioudaiou legonteV poreusomeqa meta sou dioti akhkoamen oti o qeoV meq' umwn estin
lhmma logou kuriou en gh sedrac kai damaskou qusia autou dioti kurioV efora anqrwpouV kai pasaV fulaV tou israhl
kai emaq en toiV orioiV authV turoV kai sidwn dioti efronhsan sfodra
kai wkodomhsen turoV ocurwmata eauth kai eqhsaurisen argurion wV coun kai sunhgagen crusion wV phlon odwn
dia touto kurioV klhronomhsei authn kai pataxei eiV qalassan dunamin authV kai auth en puri katanalwqhsetai
oyetai askalwn kai fobhqhsetai kai gaza kai odunhqhsetai sfodra kai akkarwn oti hscunqh epi tw paraptwmati authV kai apoleitai basileuV ek gazhV kai askalwn ou mh katoikhqh
kai katoikhsousin allogeneiV en azwtw kai kaqelw ubrin allofulwn
kai exarw to aima autwn ek stomatoV autwn kai ta bdelugmata autwn ek mesou odontwn autwn kai upoleifqhsetai kai outoV tw qew hmwn kai esontai wV ciliarcoV en iouda kai akkarwn wV o iebousaioV
kai uposthsomai tw oikw mou anasthma tou mh diaporeuesqai mhde anakamptein kai ou mh epelqh ep' autouV ouketi exelaunwn dioti nun ewraka en toiV ofqalmoiV mou
caire sfodra qugater siwn khrusse qugater ierousalhm idou o basileuV sou ercetai soi dikaioV kai swzwn autoV prauV kai epibebhkwV epi upozugion kai pwlon neon
kai exoleqreusei armata ex efraim kai ippon ex ierousalhm kai exoleqreuqhsetai toxon polemikon kai plhqoV kai eirhnh ex eqnwn kai katarxei udatwn ewV qalasshV kai potamwn diekbolaV ghV
kai su en aimati diaqhkhV exapesteilaV desmiouV sou ek lakkou ouk econtoV udwr
kaqhsesqe en ocurwmati desmioi thV sunagwghV kai anti miaV hmeraV paroikesiaV sou dipla antapodwsw soi
dioti eneteina se iouda emautw toxon eplhsa ton efraim kai epegerw ta tekna sou siwn epi ta tekna twn ellhnwn kai yhlafhsw se wV romfaian machtou
kai kurioV estai ep' autouV kai exeleusetai wV astraph boliV kai kurioV pantokratwr en salpiggi salpiei kai poreusetai en salw apeilhV autou
kurioV pantokratwr uperaspiei autwn kai katanalwsousin autouV kai katacwsousin autouV en liqoiV sfendonhV kai ekpiontai autouV wV oinon kai plhsousin wV fialaV qusiasthrion
kai swsei autouV kurioV en th hmera ekeinh wV probata laon autou dioti liqoi agioi kuliontai epi thV ghV autou
oti ei ti agaqon autou kai ei ti kalon par' autou sitoV neaniskoiV kai oinoV euwdiazwn eiV parqenouV
aiteisqe ueton para kuriou kaq' wran proimon kai oyimon kurioV epoihsen fantasiaV kai ueton ceimerinon dwsei autoiV ekastw botanhn en agrw
dioti oi apofqeggomenoi elalhsan kopouV kai oi manteiV oraseiV yeudeiV kai ta enupnia yeudh elaloun mataia parekaloun dia touto exhrqhsan wV probata kai ekakwqhsan dioti ouk hn iasiV
epi touV poimenaV parwxunqh o qumoV mou kai epi touV amnouV episkeyomai kai episkeyetai kurioV o qeoV o pantokratwr to poimnion autou ton oikon iouda kai taxei autouV wV ippon eupreph autou en polemw
kai ex autou epebleyen kai ex autou etaxen kai ex autou toxon en qumw ex autou exeleusetai paV o exelaunwn en tw autw
kai esontai wV machtai patounteV phlon en taiV odoiV en polemw kai parataxontai dioti kurioV met' autwn kai kataiscunqhsontai anabatai ippwn
kai katiscusw ton oikon iouda kai ton oikon iwshf swsw kai katoikiw autouV oti hgaphsa autouV kai esontai on tropon ouk apestreyamhn autouV dioti egw kurioV o qeoV autwn kai epakousomai autoiV
kai esontai wV machtai tou efraim kai carhsetai h kardia autwn wV en oinw kai ta tekna autwn oyontai kai eufranqhsontai kai careitai h kardia autwn epi tw kuriw
shmanw autoiV kai eisdexomai autouV dioti lutrwsomai autouV kai plhqunqhsontai kaqoti hsan polloi
kai sperw autouV en laoiV kai oi makran mnhsqhsontai mou ekqreyousin ta tekna autwn kai epistreyousin
kai epistreyw autouV ek ghV aiguptou kai ex assuriwn eisdexomai autouV kai eiV thn galaaditin kai eiV ton libanon eisaxw autouV kai ou mh upoleifqh ex autwn oude eiV
kai dieleusontai en qalassh stenh kai pataxousin en qalassh kumata kai xhranqhsetai panta ta baqh potamwn kai afaireqhsetai pasa ubriV assuriwn kai skhptron aiguptou periaireqhsetai
kai katiscusw autouV en kuriw qew autwn kai en tw onomati autou katakauchsontai legei kurioV
dianoixon o libanoV taV quraV sou kai katafagetw pur taV kedrouV sou
ololuxatw pituV dioti peptwken kedroV oti megalwV megistaneV etalaipwrhsan ololuxate drueV thV basanitidoV oti katespasqh o drumoV o sumfutoV
fwnh qrhnountwn poimenwn oti tetalaipwrhken h megalwsunh autwn fwnh wruomenwn leontwn oti tetalaipwrhken to fruagma tou iordanou
tade legei kurioV pantokratwr poimainete ta probata thV sfaghV
a oi kthsamenoi katesfazon kai ou metemelonto kai oi pwlounteV auta elegon euloghtoV kurioV kai peplouthkamen kai oi poimeneV autwn ouk epascon ouden ep' autoiV

dia touto ou feisomai ouketi epi touV katoikountaV thn ghn legei kurioV kai idou egw paradidwmi touV anqrwpouV ekaston eiV ceiraV tou plhsion autou kai eiV ceiraV basilewV autou kai katakoyousin thn ghn kai ou mh exelwmai ek ceiroV autwn
kai poimanw ta probata thV sfaghV eiV thn canaanitin kai lhmyomai emautw duo rabdouV thn mian ekalesa kalloV kai thn eteran ekalesa scoinisma kai poimanw ta probata
kai exarw touV treiV poimenaV en mhni eni kai barunqhsetai h yuch mou ep' autouV kai gar ai yucai autwn epwruonto ep' eme
kai eipa ou poimanw umaV to apoqnhskon apoqnhsketw kai to ekleipon ekleipetw kai ta kataloipa katesqietwsan ekastoV taV sarkaV tou plhsion autou
kai lhmyomai thn rabdon mou thn kalhn kai aporriyw authn tou diaskedasai thn diaqhkhn mou hn dieqemhn proV pantaV touV laouV
kai diaskedasqhsetai en th hmera ekeinh kai gnwsontai oi cananaioi ta probata ta fulassomena dioti logoV kuriou estin
kai erw proV autouV ei kalon enwpion umwn estin dote sthsanteV ton misqon mou h apeipasqe kai esthsan ton misqon mou triakonta argurouV

kai eipen kurioV proV me kaqeV autouV eiV to cwneuthrion kai skeyai ei dokimon estin on tropon edokimasqhn uper autwn kai elabon touV triakonta argurouV kai enebalon autouV eiV ton oikon kuriou eiV to cwneuthrion
kai aperriya thn rabdon thn deuteran to scoinisma tou diaskedasai thn katascesin ana meson iouda kai ana meson tou israhl
kai eipen kurioV proV me eti labe seautw skeuh poimenika poimenoV apeirou

dioti idou egw exegeirw poimena epi thn ghn to eklimpanon ou mh episkeyhtai kai to dieskorpismenon ou mh zhthsh kai to suntetrimmenon ou mh iashtai kai to oloklhron ou mh kateuqunh kai ta krea twn eklektwn katafagetai kai touV astragalouV autwn ekstreyei

w oi poimainonteV ta mataia kai oi kataleloipoteV ta probata macaira epi touV bracionaV autou kai epi ton ofqalmon ton dexion autou o braciwn autou xhrainomenoV xhranqhsetai kai o ofqalmoV o dexioV autou ektufloumenoV ektuflwqhsetai
lhmma logou kuriou epi ton israhl legei kurioV ekteinwn ouranon kai qemeliwn ghn kai plasswn pneuma anqrwpou en autw
idou egw tiqhmi thn ierousalhm wV proqura saleuomena pasi toiV laoiV kuklw kai en th ioudaia estai perioch epi ierousalhm
kai estai en th hmera ekeinh qhsomai thn ierousalhm liqon katapatoumenon pasin toiV eqnesin paV o katapatwn authn empaizwn empaixetai kai episunacqhsontai ep' authn panta ta eqnh thV ghV

en th hmera ekeinh legei kurioV pantokratwr pataxw panta ippon en ekstasei kai ton anabathn autou en parafronhsei epi de ton oikon iouda dianoixw touV ofqalmouV mou kai pantaV touV ippouV twn lawn pataxw en apotuflwsei
kai erousin oi ciliarcoi iouda en taiV kardiaiV autwn eurhsomen eautoiV touV katoikountaV ierousalhm en kuriw pantokratori qew autwn

en th hmera ekeinh qhsomai touV ciliarcouV iouda wV dalon puroV en xuloiV kai wV lampada puroV en kalamh kai katafagontai ek dexiwn kai ex euwnumwn pantaV touV laouV kukloqen kai katoikhsei ierousalhm eti kaq' eauthn
kai swsei kurioV ta skhnwmata iouda kaqwV ap' archV opwV mh megalunhtai kauchma oikou dauid kai eparsiV twn katoikountwn ierousalhm epi ton ioudan

kai estai en th hmera ekeinh uperaspiei kurioV uper twn katoikountwn ierousalhm kai estai o asqenwn en autoiV en ekeinh th hmera wV oikoV dauid o de oikoV dauid wV oikoV qeou wV aggeloV kuriou enwpion autwn
kai estai en th hmera ekeinh zhthsw tou exarai panta ta eqnh ta epercomena epi ierousalhm

kai ekcew epi ton oikon dauid kai epi touV katoikountaV ierousalhm pneuma caritoV kai oiktirmou kai epibleyontai proV me anq' wn katwrchsanto kai koyontai ep' auton kopeton wV ep' agaphton kai odunhqhsontai odunhn wV epi prwtotokw
en th hmera ekeinh megalunqhsetai o kopetoV en ierousalhm wV kopetoV rownoV en pediw ekkoptomenou

kai koyetai h gh kata fulaV fulaV fulh kaq' eauthn kai ai gunaikeV autwn kaq' eautaV fulh oikou dauid kaq' eauthn kai ai gunaikeV autwn kaq' eautaV fulh oikou naqan kaq' eauthn kai ai gunaikeV autwn kaq' eautaV
fulh oikou leui kaq' eauthn kai ai gunaikeV autwn kaq' eautaV fulh tou sumewn kaq' eauthn kai ai gunaikeV autwn kaq' eautaV
pasai ai fulai ai upoleleimmenai fulh kaq' eauthn kai ai gunaikeV autwn kaq' eautaV
en th hmera ekeinh estai paV topoV dianoigomenoV en tw oikw dauid
kai estai en th hmera ekeinh legei kurioV exoleqreusw ta onomata twn eidwlwn apo thV ghV kai ouketi estai autwn mneia kai touV yeudoprofhtaV kai to pneuma to akaqarton exarw apo thV ghV

kai estai ean profhteush anqrwpoV eti kai erei proV auton o pathr autou kai h mhthr autou oi gennhsanteV auton ou zhsh oti yeudh elalhsaV ep' onomati kuriou kai sumpodiousin auton o pathr autou kai h mhthr autou oi gennhsanteV auton en tw profhteuein auton
kai estai en th hmera ekeinh kataiscunqhsontai oi profhtai ekastoV ek thV orasewV autou en tw profhteuein auton kai endusontai derrin tricinhn anq' wn eyeusanto
kai erei ouk eimi profhthV egw dioti anqrwpoV ergazomenoV thn ghn egw eimi oti anqrwpoV egennhsen me ek neothtoV mou
kai erw proV auton ti ai plhgai autai ana meson twn ceirwn sou kai erei aV eplhghn en tw oikw tw agaphtw mou
romfaia exegerqhti epi touV poimenaV mou kai ep' andra polithn mou legei kurioV pantokratwr pataxate touV poimenaV kai ekspasate ta probata kai epaxw thn ceira mou epi touV poimenaV
kai estai en pash th gh legei kurioV ta duo merh exoleqreuqhsetai kai ekleiyei to de triton upoleifqhsetai en auth

kai diaxw to triton dia puroV kai purwsw autouV wV puroutai to argurion kai dokimw autouV wV dokimazetai to crusion autoV epikalesetai to onoma mou kagw epakousomai autw kai erw laoV mou outoV estin kai autoV erei kurioV o qeoV mou
idou hmerai ercontai tou kuriou kai diamerisqhsetai ta skula sou en soi

kai episunaxw panta ta eqnh epi ierousalhm eiV polemon kai alwsetai h poliV kai diarpaghsontai ai oikiai kai ai gunaikeV molunqhsontai kai exeleusetai to hmisu thV polewV en aicmalwsia oi de kataloipoi tou laou mou ou mh exoleqreuqwsin ek thV polewV
kai exeleusetai kurioV kai parataxetai en toiV eqnesin ekeinoiV kaqwV hmera parataxewV autou en hmera polemou

kai sthsontai oi podeV autou en th hmera ekeinh epi to oroV twn elaiwn to katenanti ierousalhm ex anatolwn kai scisqhsetai to oroV twn elaiwn to hmisu autou proV anatolaV kai to hmisu autou proV qalassan caoV mega sfodra kai klinei to hmisu tou orouV proV borran kai to hmisu autou proV noton

kai emfracqhsetai faragx orewn mou kai egkollhqhsetai faragx orewn ewV iasol kai emfracqhsetai kaqwV enefragh en taiV hmeraiV tou seismou en hmeraiV oziou basilewV iouda kai hxei kurioV o qeoV mou kai panteV oi agioi met' autou
en ekeinh th hmera ouk estai fwV kai yucoV kai pagoV
estai mian hmeran kai h hmera ekeinh gnwsth tw kuriw kai ouc hmera kai ou nux kai proV esperan estai fwV
kai en th hmera ekeinh exeleusetai udwr zwn ex ierousalhm to hmisu autou eiV thn qalassan thn prwthn kai to hmisu autou eiV thn qalassan thn escathn kai en qerei kai en eari estai outwV
kai estai kurioV eiV basilea epi pasan thn ghn en th hmera ekeinh estai kurioV eiV kai to onoma autou en

kuklwn pasan thn ghn kai thn erhmon apo gabe ewV remmwn kata noton ierousalhm rama de epi topou menei apo thV pulhV beniamin ewV tou topou thV pulhV thV prwthV ewV thV pulhV twn gwniwn kai ewV tou purgou ananehl ewV twn upolhniwn tou basilewV
katoikhsousin en auth kai ouk estai anaqema eti kai katoikhsei ierousalhm pepoiqotwV

kai auth estai h ptwsiV hn koyei kurioV pantaV touV laouV osoi epestrateusan epi ierousalhm takhsontai ai sarkeV autwn esthkotwn autwn epi touV podaV autwn kai oi ofqalmoi autwn ruhsontai ek twn opwn autwn kai h glwssa autwn takhsetai en tw stomati autwn
kai estai en th hmera ekeinh ekstasiV kuriou ep' autouV megalh kai epilhmyontai ekastoV thV ceiroV tou plhsion autou kai sumplakhsetai h ceir autou proV ceira tou plhsion autou
kai o ioudaV parataxetai en ierousalhm kai sunaxei thn iscun pantwn twn lawn kukloqen crusion kai argurion kai imatismon eiV plhqoV sfodra
kai auth estai h ptwsiV twn ippwn kai twn hmionwn kai twn kamhlwn kai twn onwn kai pantwn twn kthnwn twn ontwn en taiV parembolaiV ekeinaiV kata thn ptwsin tauthn

kai estai osoi ean kataleifqwsin ek pantwn twn eqnwn twn elqontwn epi ierousalhm kai anabhsontai kat' eniauton tou proskunhsai tw basilei kuriw pantokratori kai tou eortazein thn eorthn thV skhnophgiaV
kai estai osoi ean mh anabwsin ek paswn twn fulwn thV ghV eiV ierousalhm tou proskunhsai tw basilei kuriw pantokratori kai outoi ekeinoiV prosteqhsontai
ean de fulh aiguptou mh anabh mhde elqh ekei kai epi toutoiV estai h ptwsiV hn pataxei kurioV panta ta eqnh osa ean mh anabh tou eortasai thn eorthn thV skhnophgiaV
auth estai h amartia aiguptou kai h amartia pantwn twn eqnwn osa an mh anabh tou eortasai thn eorthn thV skhnophgiaV
en th hmera ekeinh estai to epi ton calinon tou ippou agion tw kuriw pantokratori kai esontai oi lebhteV oi en tw oikw kuriou wV fialai pro proswpou tou qusiasthriou

kai estai paV lebhV en ierousalhm kai en tw iouda agion tw kuriw pantokratori kai hxousin panteV oi qusiazonteV kai lhmyontai ex autwn kai eyhsousin en autoiV kai ouk estai cananaioV ouketi en tw oikw kuriou pantokratoroV en th hmera ekeinh . ______________________________________________________________________________
lhmma logou kuriou epi ton israhl en ceiri aggelou autou qesqe dh epi taV kardiaV umwn
hgaphsa umaV legei kurioV kai eipate en tini hgaphsaV hmaV ouk adelfoV hn hsau tou iakwb legei kurioV kai hgaphsa ton iakwb
ton de hsau emishsa kai etaxa ta oria autou eiV afanismon kai thn klhronomian autou eiV domata erhmou

dioti erei h idoumaia katestraptai kai epistreywmen kai anoikodomhswmen taV erhmouV tade legei kurioV pantokratwr autoi oikodomhsousin kai egw katastreyw kai epiklhqhsetai autoiV oria anomiaV kai laoV ef' on paratetaktai kurioV ewV aiwnoV
